text.description:
Kensei Stance Skill. Grants you Absolute Death Lv 10 (Permanent duration, but requires 10 FP every round.) When active, enemies damaged by Kensei Offensive skills that are already affected by your Sakki will cause you to swiftly move to slash all other enemies within 5 range of that target, dealing Protection-ignoring Bonus Slash damage equal to your kensei class (or 10, whichever is higher). Enemies can only be damaged this way once per skill use.

Small Note: There is an in-game typo in the word 'targeting'; it is instead written as 'targetting'.
Kensei Stance Skill. Grants you Absolute Fear Lv 10 (Permanent Duration, but require 10 FP every round). A stance useful for inflicting Fear on Enemies, and making them show their back to you.

Kensei Stance Skill. Grants you Absolute Pace Lv 10 (Permanent Duration, but requires 10 FP every round). A baiting stance focused on dodging, and parrying which can grant you Battle Flow.

Small Note: There is an in-game spelling mistake. Subtly is written as subtlely.
A strong ability that lets the Grand Summoner more actively take in focus from other dimensions. Causes you to regenerate FP every round based on Rank.

Open your mind and body to absorb power from the world around you. Can only be used while your FP is below 50% of your Maximum FP. You gain 20+(Rank*10) FP regeneration and reduce your Status Resistance by 15% for 3 rounds.

Break down your Void Energy into Focus, which you then absorb. Using this skill will restore FP equal to your current Void Energy, and reduce it to 0. You can also use this while you have Veil Off active to end the status prematurely, and regain FP equal to half of its LV

The Arbalest's oil becomes elemental reactive. Triggering Oil Chain's effect after a Cannon skill grants you Accelerant Lv X for 2 rounds. (Bow attacks made in melee range deal bonus elemental damage equal to Lv% of Elemental ATK. Gun attacks create an elemental burst in 3 range line from your position that deals bonus elemental damage equal to (75% of LV) of Elemental ATK.)

The book just isn't for show. It holds detailed reports of a number of battles, information about the types of soil various places have, and other such valuable information. It also shoots out magic, which a lot of people don't expect. Taking advantage of that will restore your Focus Points based on Rank when you hit an enemy with a Tome weapon attack. The bonus is also increased based on your Tactics Rank.

Rains acid down on a 2 Range circle of enemies within 5 Range, dealing Acid magic damage that ignores evasion to them. It also reduces their Phys. and Mag. Defense by X (X = 1+3*Rank%) for 3 rounds. For each enemy that is weak to Acid, your Tactics Rank increases by 1 level.
Rangers are skilled at moving swiftly and unpredictably, even while attacking. Grants a bonus to Evade until your next turn after using a Ranger Offensive skill that causes you to move.

extras: Equipping this skill does not take up a Skill Pool slot.
text.description:
You and your favorite companion are used to working together.

At the start of battle, you automatically summon the first equipped Animal Companion to a tile within 1 Range of you.

Druids often work in tandem with the forces of nature, as their goals are often aligned. As such, they often employ animal companions as allies, who protect the Druid and follow its instructions.

The Druid has access to a few different Animal Companion skills. Simply having these skills equipped will give them additional access to 3 'Call' skills that utilize the animal's talents, which briefly call the animal companion to the battlefield to perform an action.

These skills have a shared cooldown on a per-animal basis. For example, utilizing one of the Wolf's Call skills will put its other Call skills, and the ability to summon them, on cooldown (dependent on the skill). However, even if you use one of the Wolf's Call skills, you will still be able to use the Bear's Call skills (if they aren't also on CD).

You can also use the skill directly to summon the animal companion as a unit to battle. When summoned this way, its level is equal to your character level, and it will be summoned with 3M immediately available. While summoned, however, you will not be able to use the companion's Call skills. You can use the skill on the companion again to unsummon them.

Animal Companions do not carry over HP/FP between battles, or even through multiple summons; they will always be summoned with full HP and FP.

When defeated, all of an Animal Companion's skills (including Calls) are put on a 6 round CD. However, they also drop a Druid Totem at their current location. If you enter the same tile as this totem, you will pick it up and accelerate the companion's CD by 3 rounds. Enemies can attack it to destroy it, to deny you this bonus.

Utilize caution and unsummon your animal companion if they are in dire straits, or you may find yourself without them when it matters most.

If an Animal Companion's skill references Rank, it means the master's rank of the Animal Companion skill that grants access to it. If a monster, wild animal, or other unit uses those skills somehow, it defaults to max Rank (3).

Animal Companions may also have benefits to their skills if they are Invigorated or Quickened. These benefits do not apply when using the Call versions of their skills, only when they are used by the companion while summoned. See individual skills for further information.
Performing isn't just about playing the notes; it's about putting on a show. If you have used a Dance skill this round, the Range of your Bard and Performer songs increases by 2.

Toggle Skill. Evasive Reaction skill (only one takes effect at a time). While toggled on, when you evade an attack, you briefly fade into the void, causing you to move 1 tile towards the attacker. If you moved, you also generate Void Energy, based on Rank.
A holy ward that protects the holder and their allies. Allies within the Range gain a bonus to DEF and RES.

Can only target one of your Youkai. Transfers your Astral Aegis to them for 3 rounds (or until they are unsummoned), letting them gain the benefits, but also removing them from you for the duration. If the target is already under this effect, your Astral Aegis returns to you.

Bow skill. Fire a razor sharp arrow with great force in a line. Deals Pierce physical damage and inflicts Aerial Razor for 3 rounds. An enemy at the very end of the line takes 1.25x damage.

If Dynamic Shooting is at Rank 2 or higher, the length of the line can be adjusted.

Fire - Creates Cinder tiles. Ice - Creates Ice Sheet tiles. Earth - Increases damage by Rank * 2. Wind - Increases range. Lightning - May lightning critical. Dark - Creates Darkness tiles. Light - Creates Photon tiles.

Targets a 2 Size Circle up to 5 Range away and creates a violent squall within it. All enemies in it take Wind magic damage that can critical (+25% damage), and are spun around. +1 size of Mass is active.

Plant tiles (excluding Druid Plants) are torn from the ground, dealing armor-ignoring Earth bonus damage to 1 random enemy or other ally (max 3 per enemy, 1 per ally as Kickback Damage). Other tiles apply an Aero Shift (3) effect.

This is an effect typically created by wind element abilities, often listed as Aero Shift (X), where X is a number.

When applied to a tile, any movable field effects in that tile (such as rocks) are blown away tiles equal to the Aero Shift value. For example, Aero Shift (2) will blow the object away 2 tiles. The direction an object moves is usually away from the center of the effect.

Objects which collide with a unit may have additional effects; rocks, for example, can inflict stun. Other objects may be vulnerable to the wind and will dissipate from the Aero Shift; for example, Smokescreens, clouds of spores, etc. will disappear entirely.

Targets a 2 Size Circle in 5 Range and conjures a healing breeze. Allies and Druid Plants within it enhances it, recovering HP and giving HP Regeneration LV X (Rank x 8, 1 round) Heal and Regen duration increase based on enhancement (up to 150% wind ATK, 5 rounds); Druid Plants count as 'half' an ally. +1 size if Mass is active.

If 3+ allies affected, their enemy-caused effect durations are cut by 1 round, and all Druid Plants in the circle apply Growth 1.
Shows a particular compatibility with Avian-race Youkai, passively increasing all of their statistics based on Rank.
Shows a particular compatibility with Beast-race Youkai, passively increasing all of their statistics based on Rank.
Shows a particular compatibility with Dragon-race Youkai, passively increasing all of their statistics based on Rank.
Shows a particular compatibility with Fairy-race Youkai, passively increasing all of their statistics based on Rank.
Shows a particular compatibility with Mystic-race Youkai, passively increasing all of their statistics based on Rank.
Shows a particular compatibility with Night-race Youkai, passively increasing all of their statistics based on Rank.
Shows a particular compatibility with Plant-race Youkai, passively increasing all of their statistics based on Rank.

extras: This skill does not take up a Skill Pool slot.
text.description:
The Ghost thrives on drawing out hidden power from situations where they are at a disadvantage, but sometimes that doesn't always mean 'near death'. While this skill is equipped, the Ghost's maximum HP is increased by 5% for every negative status effect that are suffering from.

Small Note: There may be a spelling mistake in the skill's in game description. It might be 'that they're suffering from' as opposed to 'that are suffering from'.

Arcane skill. Fires a slithering arrow that deals Acid magic damage to the first enemy hit and applies Acidity LV X (X = 2+Rank). If it passes over an allied Rain Trap, it will apply its damage & effects in its range, create LV 20 Poison Pools for 3 rounds, and destroy the trap. (Enemies can only be damaged once per skill use.)

Annorum: The arrow will continue even after hitting an enemy and the Acidity LV is doubled.

When using Light Armor, increase your Critical Evade, based on Rank.

Main Class skill. Ranger only.

Targets yourself, or an ally within 5 Range. The target is healed based on your Scaled WIL (based on Rank). If the target was an ally and not yourself, you dash to an empty tile next to them and generate Ki, based on Rank.

Targets a circular location and pulses powerful wind gusts from it, dealing Wind magic damage to all enemies inside of it. It will also push certain field objects, such as rocks, away. If an enemy is hit by one of those objects, they are stunned, reducing their Momentum to 0 this turn and destroying that object. If you are enchanted with Talvyd, the object pushback is stronger.

text.powerRaw: 80%/90%/100% Fire ATK, 100% Scaled WPN ATK, LV: 5/9/13
text.description:
Ninjutsu. Throw flaming shuriken at a 2 Zie Crescent up to 4 Range away, dealing fire magic damage that can critically hit (25% damage) over 2 hits. Damaged enemies may be inflicted with Lingering Damage (Fire) (2 Rounds), or Burn instead (if critically hit). Size, total hits and status LV increase based on total Shuriken equipped (+1, +1, +3 respectively)

Furinkazan: Gain 1 Fire Mark

If you have a Handgun-type Gun as both your Main Weapon and Sub Weapon, when you use Attack or Sub-Attack, enables the Twin Dance skill from Rogue base class, even if you do not have it active. In addition, the sub-weapon will use all its rounds instead of just 1.

Spear skill. Elemental compatible. Dash in a 2-3 Range line, performing a basic attack with bonus damage on all enemies in that line. If you have Bonded Youkai summoned, they will duplicate the attack themselves in the direction they are facing. If you have only one Bonded Youkai, the Range of this skill is increased by 3. Must end in an unoccupied square. (Those who do not satisfy this condition will not attack.)

True monks know the value of time and being efficient, and therefore try to deal with as many enemies as possible at once. When damaging an enemy, if that enemy has not been damaged by the Monk in same round, the damage is increased by 5% and it generates 2 Ki for the user.

By snapping your fingers, you command all of your active Runes to fly forward 5 tiles. Moving this way can cause the rune to link with other runes, as well as trigger on enemies in it's effective range.

Deals 10 damage to the rune after forcing it to move.
With a wave of your finger, you point at a location within 6 range. All of your active Runes turn to face that location.

Unleash a black fog from your lantern, covering all enemies within 3 Range and dealing Dark magic damage to them. It can also inflict Blind for 2 rounds on affected enemies.

(Damage/Heal and Effect Power/Duration/Chance from Lantern Activations are more effective when close and less effective when far.)

Eternal Flame: WIL, RES

Your interest in changing things, namely yourself, leads you to perfect the art as much as you can.

Transformation effects (including Install) have increased duration based on Rank.

Both victories and defeats are important to learn from. For victories, you can learn strengths, and from defeats. You can learn flaws. The Tactician knows this well and passes that onto his allies. Increasing Experience Point gains for them by 10%.

Additionally, passively increases your WIL and GUI, based on Rank.
A new twist on an old favorite. When playing the Aria of Agility, all affected allies also gain +X Evade for 2 attacks/3 rounds. (x = 3*Aria of Agility's Rank)

extras: Range increased by 1 if a Tome is equipped.
text.description: The simplest way to win, in any scenario where victory is a possibility, is to exploit your enemy's weakness, and step one is to actually learn what it is. Targets an enemy within 3 Range and Analyzes them. You can only Analyze one enemy at a time. When Analyzed, the enemy will suffer increased damage from all party members. The duration of Analyze is (1+ Tactic Ranks) rounds. If your Tactics Rank A or better, you will also call out all of that enemy's elemental weaknesses, if any exist.

Engrave: Attempts to inflict the target with Immobilize until your next turn. (Cooldown 1 turn longer when used this way)

Trigger: Attempts to inflict Immobilize on all enemies within effective range for 2 rounds.

Allies within the effective range of this rune are immune to most push and pull effects.

A magic sigil that is inscribed on an arrow, filling it with enhanced power. Rangers have an Annorum gauge in battle, which is filled with charges when casting a Spell (3 for Ranger spells, 2 for other spells) up to a maximum of 9. When 9 are available, the next Arcane-class Ranger spell will be enhanced with a bonus effect (see specific skills for those). After activating a bonus effect, charges cannot be regained automatically during the same round.

Bard Song skill. A cheery, forceful tune to get allies excited. Play your instrument, gaining the Anthem of Enthusiasm aura (+2 WIL, +2 GUI, 5 Range), and giving all allies in 5 Range bonuses to Elemental ATK and Critical Damage for 3 rounds. (based on Rank).

Bard Song skill. A slow, methodical beat to make allies pay attention. Play your instrument, gaining the Dawr of Defense aura (+2 DEF, +2 RES, 5 Range), and giving all allies in 5 Range bonus Critical Evade and X% resistance to all elements for 3 rounds (based on Rank).
An innate property of the Ghost that wards off supernatural and magical effects. Passively increases your RES.

The Curate represents life in all of most of its forms. As such, they serve as the polar opposite to unlife; things that cling to the living realm unnaturally. Specifically, undead, and as such, all damage dealt to Undead and Ghost monsters is increased by a percentage, based on Rank. It is also effective against members of the Vampire and Possessed race, but only at half effectiveness, as they tip-toe the line between alive and undead.

extras: Equipping this skill does not take up a Skill Pool slot.
text.description:
A magical crest of governing water. The crest fills with magical energy by casting Aquamancer spells, increasing its LV by 1 (max. 9). Aquamancer skills interact with the Aquae Crest by gaining bonus effects if its LV is high enough, sometimes by consuming some of its levels.

Your Water ATK is increased by the crest's LV.

A true display of aquatic mastery. If Aquae Crest is equipped, you begin the battle with Aquae Crest levels equal to Rank. If Aquamancer is both your main class and sub class, you start with double the amount instead.

Ninjutsu. Targets all enemies in a 3 Size Diamond (+1 Size per 25 Ice ATK, max 5) around you, increasing your aerodynamic qualities with ki for an instant. Teleport next to each enemy you can and slash with a gusting blade, dealing Wind magic damage.

Trickery: If you have Kagebunshin active, each time before you teleport, you leave behind a Kagebunshin.

Furinkazan: Gain 1 Wind Mark.

extras: Does not take up a SP slot.
text.description: The character is used to close-range fight with disadvantageous weapons. While wearing heavy armor, the close quarters penalty for bow weapons is reduced by 10% (bringing it to 40% total hit penalty); This reduction is doubled if you are monoclassing.

Tactical Formation skill. Create a magical formation at a location within 5 range, which reduces FP costs for spells, and chance of invocations being broken for allies inside of it, for 3 rounds.

Range increased by 1 per 15 Scaled GUI. Duration increased by 1 round if a tome is equipped.

The Magic Gunner utilizes a special gun that has been modified with certain magical parts, letting them utilize what are called 'Magic Bullets'. Magic Bullets have three different effects listed: Shell, Bonus, and High Charge. You can only have 1 Bullet selected at a time. When you attack with a Gun weapon, on-hit, the Shell effect is applied. See Charge Shot and Overcharge for info on the other two effects.

A special kind of mage marking on the skin that invokes an incantation when supplied with focus, these tattoos are often found on battle-oriented magicians. This skill will reduce the FP cost of the first equipped Mage or Evoker spell in your Skill Pool by 25% if you are using Unarmored or Light Armor torso items. Unarmored torso items will instead reduce it by 40%.

The sign of a Ruler's power is their scourge, and as a being of Arcane skill. It would be nice to show that power, be it through a horse-driver or a cat's string toy. Allows you to use any whip weapon as a casting tool (Tome-whip are exempted as they're already tomes.)

extras: Reduces Skill Pool cost of Rune spells to 0.5
text.description: Rune Magicians are masters of runes, essentially arcane writings and patterns that can evoke predictable magic spells and effects. Runes can have a variety of effects; Placed effects activate when the rune is created on the battlefield. Resonate effects activate around the Rune at the start of a new round. Trigger effects activate when an enemy steps into the effective range of a Rune. Engrave effects activate if the Rune spell targets a unit instead of a location.

Bard Song skill. A light and airy tune that makes allies feel just as swift. Play your instrument, gaining the Aria of Agility aura (+2 CEL, +2 SKI, and 5 Range), and giving all allies in 5 Range additional bonuses to Hit and Evade for 3 rounds. (based on Rank).

Specializing in striking targets before they know what hit them is the shinobi way.

On Battle Start: If your party back attacked the enemy, all enemies take protection-ignoring damage equal to your Shinobi class level. (Only the highest Assassination Art takes effect, but all other units with the same skill increase the damage by 10. Damage dealt this way cannot defeat enemies.)

extras: If you have a Tome equipped, the bonus damage is increased by it's power, OR 50% of scaled GUI.
text.description: Tactical Order skill. Order all allies to attack this turn, boosting their next attack's damage based on Rank + Tactics Rank.
A strengthening of the spirit and body that is caused by summoned Youkai. If you have a Youkai summoned, you gain a bonus to DEF and RES. (This bonus is treated as a class bonus.)

Surrounds yourself or target ally with protective stones, increasing their DEF. If a magnetized enemy is pulled with 1 square of someone under this effect, they take Earth magic damage equal to 4x the DEF bonus and are knocked airborne via polarity reversal. This effect lasts for 3 rounds, but may be extended by effects that lengthen Magnetize. Also grants a special skill called Astral Gravity that uses up the buff to quickly pull nearby enemies closer.

Unleashes a blow of darkness in a 4 Range line. The projectile will deal Dark magic damage to the first enemy hit, and will increase your Schwarz Sturm level by 1 on use. Fist weapons are treated as valid casting tools for this spell.

Tactical Formation skill. Create an offensive formation at a location within 5 range, which boosts the Hit of Allies inside of it, for 3 rounds.

Range increased by 1 per 15 scaled GUI. Duration increased by 1 round if Tome is equipped.
Clap your hands, causing all summoned Bonded Youkai to face towards a tile you target within 5 Range.
Take a moment to focus your mind and abilities, giving yourself a good fighting form. Grants Poise and Perfect Poise for X rounds (based on Rank) at their normal values.

extras: Equipping this skill does not take up a Skill Pool slot.
text.description:
One of the greatest flaws of being a summoner is that it is very taxing to have a Youkai summoned at all times. But if you are caught off guard, summoning a Youkai to protect you can take time you don't have. Sometime it's good to have a contingency.

While this skill is equipped, when a battle starts, you automatically summon the first available Youkai from your contracts (it must have at least 1 HP however).
A toggle skill. When on, at the start of a battle, you have a chance to automatically use the first Mage enchant spell equipped in your skill pool on yourself, for free.

extras: Auto-starts the battle with first equipped bard support skill.
text.description: You know just when to kick in the music. At the start of battle, if you have a Bard base class Song skill equipped, you will automatically use the first skill of that type equipped in your Skill Pool. (You must still pay the FP cost and satisfy the conditions of that skill.)
Mimickry skill. Costs 1% of your maximum HP, can only be used by the Avian race. Quickly adjust the wind near you to become Airborne and glide in a 2 Range line (the last tile must be unoccupied).

Hare Discipline technique. Targets 1 enemy within 1 Range and deals physical Blunt damage, plus bonus Ice magic damage if Ice Point Guard is active (50% Ice ATK).

If you are airborne and have Ice Point Guard, the target is knocked down and knocked away 1 tile. The Ice Point Guard is then deployed in front of you.

A simple-looking movement that is actually quite challenging to pull off in practice. Upon using this skill, you can turn yourself in any direction, and when you confirm its usage, you will backflip 3 tiles away from the direction you are facing, without changing direction.

Backstabbing is an art; an art where you stab your enemies in the back. When you attack an enemy with a dagger while directly behind them, you deal bonus Damage and gain Critical for that attack based on Rank.

Besides a good voice and quick feet, what does a Bard need? An instrument.

Allows you to equip any Instrument weapon, regardless of weapon type.

A bard has to be dexterous to play their instruments well. Whether that be with fingers, teeth, or tongue depends on the situation.

Passively boosts Hit for Axe and Instrument weapons by 5.
Knocks away an enemy or ally within 1 tile. Using this on an enemy while you are Charging will knock back more and make you follow the target.
Axe skill. A tried and true method of getting things to work. Targets an Engineer device within 2 Range and hits on it, curing it of any negative status effects.

At the end of a round, if Eternal Flame is active, and you have not used Movement this turn, your flame glows quietly, causing you and all allies within 3 Range to gain damage resistance to its element for 2 rounds, based on Rank.

The discipline of the bear teaches that there is little one can do against overwhelming power. While in Bear Stance, when you deal Ice damage, you gain a stacking status that grants +5 Power and +5 Critical Damage (up to +30) for 10 rounds. (This status loses 5 LV every round you are not in Bear Stance. When it reaches 0, it ends.)
Mimickry skill. Costs 1% of your maximum HP, can only be used by the Beast race. Move in an agile fashion along a darting line; all tiles in the way must be unoccupied.

Trained in hunting animals, among other things. For Beast and Avian race enemies: +10% Damage Dealt, -10% Damage Taken. Also half effective versus Kaelensia.

Main Class skill. Ranger only.

Cannot be used until Round 2. You know, I think it would be best if we just left...

Avoid paying bar tabs and angry fathers by having you and the boys flee from the battle immediately. Can only be used in battles against monsters, however (which might raise more than a few questions...) Certain enemies, such as bosses, cannot be run from.

text.powerRaw: 50% Dark ATK + 100/110/120% Scaled Weapon ATK + 15% Rage Energy
text.description: Matador stance. Requires at least 10 Rage Energy and consumes 15% of your total Rage Energy on use. You let out a mighty bellow, inflicting Dark magic damage based on Rank + Rage Energy consumed to all enemies in a 2 Range circle. If a damaged enemy is Airborne, they are knocked away 3 tiles and knocked down by the roar.

Performer Song skill. Let them give into the music. Tagets 1 enemy within 5 Range under the Song of Susceptibility; effect differs if the target is a monster or not.

Monster: Tries to Convert Enemy (Performer) Other: Attempts to inflict Pacify until your next turn. (Skill enters 2 round CD if used this way.)

This skill can make a monster into an ally temporarily. If successful, the monster that is converted will be treated as a member of your party for the rest of the battle, will be cured of Confusion, and it will give EXP at the end of it as if you defeated it normally. Bosses, minibosses, and undead-race monsters are immune. You also cannot convert enemies with a level higher than (your level + 10). Only one Converted Enemy can be in your party at a time.

Your success rate is equal to the following: Scaled GUI + (Galdr talent Rank * 2) + (your level - target's level, or 0 if less than 1) + 25 if target is Charmed by you + 25 if target is Confused = success percent.

Cannot use basic attacks or Offensive skills. Taking non-status, non-bonus damage will reduce its duration by 1 round.
The skill to apply the term to your enemies, and the resistance to avoid the reverse. Increases SKI and RES passively based on Rank.

extras: Rank 2: Silences for 2 roundsRank 3: Teleports to random squareRank 4: Inflicts Interference for 3 roundsRank 5: Covers ground near target in Void Pollution, doubling spell costs
text.description: Target enemy takes Dark magic damage equal to your current Void Energy. This will consume all Void Energy you have accumulated. Gains bonus effects based on Rank if enough Void Energy is consumed (10*Rank Effect). Can also be used with Veil Off active; It'll use its LV instead, and then end the effect.

Targets a 3 Range circle area within 4 Range. All enemies within the area of effect take magic damage split between Water and Dark. All damaged enemies may be Silenced for 2 rounds.

All tiles in the radius will be covered in Dark Water for 3 rounds (which reduce the Faith of those who stand in it to 0.), but it will take until the start of the next round for it to puddle and take effect.
Black Knights are capable of turning their foe's momentum against them. When you successfully trigger your own Parry skill, you gain +5 Hit for 2 rounds.

Sap the strength from your foes using the mysterious power of the Black Knight's gale. If you have invoked the Black Wind, physical damage dealt from Soldier class skills drains the target of their Scaled Weapon ATK, as a stacking status effect (1 LV, 3 rounds per damage instance, max LV 1+(Rank*3), 10 rounds). You gain the same amount of Scaled Weapon ATK. (The drain effect can apply to multiple enemies, but you only gain this status once.)
Consumes 20 Void Energy. Targets 1 Ally within 4 Range and wraps them in a healing-accelerating energy, granting them Regeneration LV X (based on Rank) for 5 rounds.

Creates a strong jolt of energy in a 2 Range circle around you, dealing magic damage split between Lightning and Dark. There is also a chance that all enemies damaged will suffer from Interference for 3 rounds.

Sometimes, we put our faith in unorthodox sources. For priest spells, spells that utilize Light ATK and deal light damage are changed to use Dark ATK and deal Dark damage respectively (there is no change to the scaling values). Some invocation may be altered in similar way if they deal with Light ATK or light damage.

Deflection Skill. You become capable of spinning your katana so fast that it deflects bullets. When attacked by a Gun weapon by an enemy you are facing, there is a percentage chance based on Rank to negate the attack and reduce your Katana's durability by 1. This skill will fail if your katana's durability is 0, and can only successfully activate once per round. (Only one Deflection Skill can apply at a time.)

Shell: 5 x S.P. Armor-Ignoring Fire DMG Bonus: 10 x B.P. Fire DMG, chance to inflict Burn LV (3 x B.P.)/3 rounds High Charge: In 5 Range - 10 x H.P. Fire DMG, and create Cinders LV X (25% of Fire ATK)/3 rounds

extras: Does not take up a SP slot.
text.description: Ignite your arrows like the sun streaking across the sky. At the start of a new round, if you are wearing heavy armor, in firing posture and Special Armament is not on cooldown, you take 30 Fire bonus protection-ignoring damage and activate Weapon Autocharge.

Requires at least 2 Solcharges (but does not consume them). Infuse yourself with divine might, gaining Blazing Sol for X rounds. (X = 1 per 2 Solcharges when used.)

Requires 15 FP per round to maintain. You can reactivate this skill to end the effect for free. When Blazing Sol ends, you lose all Solcharges and this skill enters a 5 round CD.

+3 to all stats and gain Holy Aura at the start of a new round. Cannot gain or lose Solcharges. Drains 15 FP every round.

extras: Equipping this skill does not take up a Skill Pool slot.
text.description: Leave your foes wondering where you went. Teleporting to a Voidgate that is not in the line of sight of an enemy will grant you Sneak for 2 rounds.

By targeting an empty square, you briefly disappear into the void and reappear at that square. Using Blink will not break any Invocations you are casting.

Small Note: There is an in-game spelling mistake. Targeting is written as targetting.

Costs 8% of your maximum HP. Targets a 2 Range circle up to 3 Range away. All enemies in that circle take ice and water damage (split evenly) and have claret call applied to them twice.

The range of the spell is increased based on your Rising Game level. Sword and Axe weapons are valid casting tools.

Performer song skill. More worries than just stepping on toes. Play your instrument, causing all Confused enemies within 7 range to use their main weapon's attack skill on a random enemy within its attack range (except your allies and themself). This attack gains a bonus to Critical (based on Rank).
When it rains, it pours. Blood. From your enemies. For every Curse effect enemies you attack are suffering, you gain increased Critical, based on Rank.

Take the lead by going for full offense, regardless of the cost.

Upon scoring a critical hit with a basic attack, you gain Bloody Shift for 1 round. Bloody Shift decreases the Momentum cost of Youkai Evoke skills by 1, but makes them cost 1% of your maximum HP when used. (This effect does not stack.)

Consumes 10 Void Energy to use. Targets 1 Enemy or 1 Ally (or yourself). Enemy: Reduces their Hit based on Rank for 3 rounds. Ally: Increases their Evade based on Rank for 3 rounds and increases their Dark ATK.

Arbalest Cannon skill.

Launches your Special Armament in a powerful burst. Targets a 5 size wide line in cardinal Direction from you, scatters certain field objects in those tiles, and all enemies in those tiles take Pierce damage (can critically hit), and are knocked back several tiles (based on Rank). Enemies who were within 3 range of you are also knocked down afterward.

Give an enemy within 1 Range a stern and magical look and steal FP from them equal to 5 + (Rank*5) (or their current FP, whatever is lower). Requires a stat-based roll and is modified by bonuses to steal (and counts as stealing if successful). Can only be used once per round.

Do you feel lucky, punk?

Can only be used if you have an Invocation spell in your skill pool. When toggled on, when you use Snatch Spell, you will pretend to be invoking a random Invocation spell in your skill pool, which just might bait your enemy into casting a spell for you to steal. (Note: This will cause Snatch Spell to use up 6 Momentum to keep up the illusion.)

text.powerRaw: 110/125/140% Earth ATK + 50/60/70% Scaled WPN ATK + Torso Weight
text.description:
Slam something heavy, be it your weapon or foot, into the ground, causing it to shake. All enemies in a 4 Range Circle around you take Earth magic damage (this damage is increased by your Torso's weight). Enemies who take damage may also be inflicted with Clumsy for 2 rounds. (Clumsy prevents the use of movement skills besides basic Movement.)

Does not affect flying or airborne units.

Cover your body in a barrier of ki harder than diamond. You gain the 'Body of Isesip' status, which negates all damage, but halves your Evade. If you take damage, the duration is reduced by 1, and if it reaches 0, the status ends. The base duration is 1 round. If 10 Ki is available, it will be consumed and increase the duration by 2 rounds.

Kenpo. Targets 1 Knocked Down or Grappled (by you) enemy in 1 Range. Perform a painful joint strike, dealing evasion-ignoring Blunt damage. If target is Knocked Down, inflicts Cripple Leg (LV X, 2 rounds). If Grappled, inflicts Cripple Arm (LV X, 2 rounds). Regardless, they're cured of the effect (except non-boss monster or summoned units).

Shukuchi: Range increases by its LV and teleports you next to the target.

extras: This skill does not take up a Skill Pool slot.
text.description: Turn slashing into style. At the start of a new round (excluding the start of battle), if you are in Reaver stance and do not have an elemental effect active, you gain a 1 round Elemental status based on your Starsign. (Nerhaven, if none of that element doesn't have an enchantment.)

Stay strong, stay safe, stay close, stay quick. During battle, after using 1 each of Offensive, Defensive, Support, and Utility class skills, gain 30 Magical Feathers immediately. (This effect then resets and can be gained again. Only applies if the skill costs at least 3M or is from Firebird.)

The icy chill of your movements locks down your enemies. When you evade a basic attack, a random skill the attacker has equipped is put on a 1 round cooldown (or 2 rounds if you have an Ice Point Guard active).
Keep the electricity of your charged mind active for longer. Increases the duration of Charge Mind based on Rank.
Almost as good as dealing the finishing blow. When you deal a critical hit with Cutthroat, the enemy is also Knocked Down.

Sword, Axe, or Spear skill. Fires a cross of light in a diagonal line, travelling up to 5 Range. The first enemy hit takes elemental magic damage (based on enchanted element, or Light if none), and is inflicted with Glowing LV X (3 * Rank). It will also leave behind Light Shafts with LV X for 3 rounds on each space it passes over (unless an Elemental Impact effect leaves behind a different special tile).

Shell: 5 x S.P. Armor-Ignoring Light DMG Bonus:10 x B.P. Light DMG, chance to inflict Glowing LV (3 x B.P.)/3 rounds. Creates Light Shafts LV X (3 x B.P.)/3 rounds in a line to target. High Charge: Fires a powerful laser at the target dealing 15 x H.P. Light DMG that ignores evasion, and chance to inflict Blind/3 rounds.

A spell that causes a light of protection or debilitation to be created. Can target an ally, an enemy, or a battlefield tile. All effects last for 3 rounds.

Ally: Grants Brighten status. (An ally's light is protecting you. Increases RES by 1 + LV*3, Light resistance by LV*5%, and deals unresistable Light damage to attackers equal to LV*5.)

Enemy: Inflicts Glowing on the enemy. (Evade is reduced by LV.)

Location: Creates a light shaft for 3 rounds.

Enchants a target ally's weapons within 5 Range with a biting torrent for 3 rounds. While active, their basic attacks will deal Water magic bonus damage equal to a percentage of your Water ATK (based on Rank).

Aquae Crest: If LV 3 or higher, consumes 3 levels and extends the duration to 5 rounds.

extras: This skill does not take up a Skill Pool slot.
text.description: Parry skill. The ultimate counter to bullets will always be more bullets; swords be damned. While you are in Desperado Stance and have a Gun equipped, you gain a chance to parry Gun and Bow weapons (skills & attacks, excluding spells). (25% + half of Scaled GUI chance to activate, 50% damage reduction.)

One of the most basic combat rules is 'always have your shield up', and true Soldiers follow this discipline religiously. When you have a shield equipped, all damage you take from enemies you are facing is reduced by 15%.

Tactical Formation skill. Create a defensive formation at a location within 5 Range, which boosts the Armor and Magic Armor of allies inside of it, for 3 rounds.

Range increases by 1 per Scaled GUI, Duration increased by 1 round if a tome is equipped.

Uses 5 Magical Feathers. Targets a different allied unit within 5 Range and inflicts 30 protection-ignoring Fire magic damage to them. Afterwards, the burning strips away impurities and reduces the duration of the longest negative status effect caused by an enemy by 3 rounds.

Targets 1 tile within 5 Range and plants a Burning Bush Sapling at it. If Mass is Active, you can target 2 tiles.

Growth Period: 3

Created by the Druid skill Burning Bush. A magical plant that can grow from druidic magics.

These plants secrete an oil that ignites from friction of the vines rubbing together, producing smoke that attracts and incapacitates insects, which it then consumes.

HP: 20

Bloom: Deals Fire magic damage equal to 25 + (LV x 10)% of your Fire ATK to all enemies within 4 Range.

On New Round: Lashes out with a burning vine at an enemy within 2 Range, which deals 25 + (LV x 5)% of your Fire ATK as Fire magic damage (with Great Accuracy). If it hits, the target may be inflicted with Burn (LV 10, 2 rounds).

Special: These blazing vines are immune to fire-based effects that destroy plants.

Special 2: Aero Shift effects will spread the plant's oil onto enemies within 2 Range, inflicting them with Dangerous Liquid (2 rounds).

With the skill Druidic Tending, the plant gets the following bonuses:

Invigoration Tending - Effective LV is increased by 25%.

Quickness Tending - Effective Range is increased by 1.

Arbalest Cannon skill.

Send your Special Armament forward to bust through enemies. Target a 5 size wide line in cardinal direction from you. All enemies in those tiles take Pierce damage (Based on Rank, plus a bonus equal to Special Armament's Power, can critically hit), and are inflicted with a Buster Cannon Lv30 for 3 rounds. Buster Cannon: Reduce Armor by LV and Phys. and Magic Defense by (Half of LV)%. Cannot be cleansed.

This skill requires a Rank D Invocation.

Creates a localized Rainstorm on the battlefield for 5 rounds. If your Rainstorm is already active, its duration is extended by 5 rounds, and it gains additional effects.

Aquae Crest: If Invoking the skill and LV 6 or higher, consumes 6 levels and refunds 3 Momentum.

Rainstorm

This is a weather-based battlefield effect. While active, Flooded Water tiles do not lose duration when a new round occurs, and allies of the caster gain Water ATK. In addition, Aquamancer Support spells that target an ally will affect all allies instead (applies to all Aquamancers - not just the caster). The Rainstorm can also be powered up twice by casting the spell again:

True Curates know that violence isn't always the answer. This skill targets 1 enemy, but has differing effects.

Player Character: Luck-based chance to reduce the duration of anger-based effects, such as Rage Energy, Soul Rage, etc.

NPC/Monster: Luck-based chance to inflict Pacify for 3 rounds.

Boss: May have a special effect or no effect.

Song skill. Targets 1 tile within 5 Range, which has a flower, Druid Plant or Plant ally in it, and fills it with galdric energies. Flowers will grow in size, increasing their effective range, while Druid Plants will apply Growth 1. Plant allies gain Encourage LV X (X = Rank) for 5 rounds.

If the skill only affects a flower or Druid Plant, the skill refunds 2M.

Bard Song skill. A soothing melody that'll make everything feel alright. Play your instrument, removing any active Bard aura, and healing all allies in 5 Range for X HP (based on Rank), plus 25 HP for every active Bard song buff they have.

Tactical Order Skill. Order all allies to utilize spells, boosting their next Offensive Category spell's damage based on Rank+Tactic Rank.

Rank 3+: Damage is further boosted by an equipped tome's power, or 50% of scaled GUI (whichever is higher.)

A protective move to get an ally out of danger. Targets 1 ally within 2 Range and switches place with them. You and that ally also gain a Defense buff based on Rank for 3 rounds.

If the Black Wind has been invoked this round, the duration of the buff is doubled. Otherwise, the Range of the skill increases by 5, and you invoke the Black Wind to utilize it.

Shell: 5 x S.P. Armor-Ignoring Ice DMG Bonus: 10 x B.P. Ice DMG, chance to inflict Frostbite LV (3 x B.P.)/3 rounds High Charge: In 5 Range - 10 x H.P. Ice DMG, and create Ice Sheets/3 rounds. Original Target: Inflicts Frozen LV 20 x H.P./ 2 rounds. Other Targets: Inflicts Celsius LV2 until your next turn.

Shell: 5 x S.P. Armor-Ignoring Lightning DMG to target + 1 other in 3 Range Bonus: 8 x B.P. Lightning DMG to target + 2 others in 3 Range High Charge: 15 x H.P. Lightning DMG, and chance to inflict Immobilize until your next turn. If successful, also inflict Lingering Damage (Lightning) LV X (5 x H.P.)/3 rounds (Note: Effect will only apply to one enemy at a time during an AoE basic attack.)

Targets 1 Youkai you control within 5 Range and unsummons the target. Any of your Youkai within 2 Range of that Youkai, and any Youkai that are affected by this effect, are also unsummoned.

This effect cannot be used if you have Skipped your turn this round.

Requires a special armament. Swing your armament toward an opponent, performing a basic attack on that enemy with it from up to 5 Range away with a penalty to Hit (based on Rank). An oiled chain will reduce the Momentum cost of this skill by 1.

Cannot be used while Special Armament is on cooldown.

Targets 2 locations within 3 range. In location 1, there must be an enemy, and location 2 must be an unoccupied tile. Using a portion of your chain, you lasso the enemy in L1, who is then pulled X (X = rank) tiles toward L2. If the target was a non-boss monster, they are slammed into L2 instead. An oiled chain will reduce momentum cost of this skill by 1.

Throw a portion of your chain forward in a 5 size line, where it latches onto the first dense tile, field object or unit it encounters. You then pull yourself towards it. An oiled chain will reduce the momentum cost of this skill by 1.

Spin your chain around in a whirlwind, affecting all enemies in an X (based on rank) Size circle, pulling them towards you Y tiles (based on rank), an oiled chain wil reduce the momentum cost of this skill by 1. If Special Armanent is not on cooldown, for each enemy; Trickery - Performs a basic attack on that enemy with your armament that deals 50% damage (and does not trigger critical or on-hit)
Kensei perform better when not burdened by things like armor. When you are using an Unarmored torso, you regain X FP every round, based on Rank.

Costs 1% of your maximum HP. Can only be used if you are Installed with a Youkai. Burst a target within 5 Range with a strange energy, dealing magic damage to them (based on Rank; any weapon can use this skill) based on the element of the installed Youkai, which can critically hit. If it does, it triggers Bloody Shift.

Damage is dealt in a number of hits equal to 1 + 1 per Grow Appendage.

Constant shifting makes your form hard to predict, and when you're hard to predict, you're hard to hit.

When you trigger Chaotic Form, you gain or power up a status called Chaos Reflex LV 8 for 3 rounds (Max LV based on Rank/5 rounds max). Chaos Reflex increases your Evade by LV, but will end at the start of a round you are not Installed with a Youkai.

Shapeshifting is a dangerous art, but the one the Shapeshifter is known for. Requires Install to be in your skill pool. After you use the Evoke skill of a Youkai you do not have Installed, you Install them (any active Install effects will be replaced). Secondly, while you have a Youkai Installed, your form changes to match theirs.

Gather your energy in a charge, which boosts your Move based on rank for 1 turn. If you use Movement and are not within 3 Range of an enemy, the effect ends and this skill is put on a 3 Round cooldown. Ends similar movement effects from class skills.

If you Bash an enemy while under the effect of Charge, you will move along with that enemy in a line, pushing them away and pinning yourself against them in the same motion. (The Bash Charge Distance and the Move Bonus are the same.)

Rev up your mind into a magical battery, gaining Charge Mind LV 3 for 2 rounds. When casting spells from Mage classes that have Excel Crash capabilities, Charge Mind will be expended as if it were Weapon Charges equal to it's LV, then its LV will decrease by 1. (For example, at LV3, it will grant one spell its 3 Charge effect, then become LV2. he next spell will gain its 2 Charge effects, etc. Doesn't stack with Weapon charges.

extras: If you have a Tome equipped or 30 scaled GUI, allies who end their Movement within 1 range of an enemy inflict Fear on them for 2 rounds.
text.description: Tactical Order skill. You give an order to all allies to charge, increasing their next Move based on Rank + (Tactics Rank/2).

By feeding Focus into the Magic Gunner's gun, they increase its power output, causing the next basic attack with a Gun that hits to trigger the current bullet's Bonus Effect on the target. The power of the Bonus Effect increases with additional ranks of Charge Shot.

Learning to put your momentum behind an attack can have impressive results. When you use Charge and Movement during the same round, in that order, your next basic attack with a melee weapon, or your next Soldier Offensive skill, will end Charge's effect, but deal bonus damage based on Rank, and may have an additional effect.

Targets a 3-5 Size Line in front of you. You create a shield of light in front of you and fly forward in that line. The first enemy you encounter slams into the shield and is pushed along with you the rest of the distance, taking damage once the flight is over.

If you have the following effects active, gain bonuses: Charge gives +2 Max Range. Holy Shield cause Guard Break. Holy Aura increases damage dealt by 15%, knocks the enemy back 2 tiles and makes them Airborne.
With a reputation for being more charismatic than reliable, the Bard is a natural charmer, increasing their Status Infliction when inflicting Charm status by 10%.
Taint fire with darkness. When you create a Cinder tile, if you have at least 1 Void Energy, it will be consumed and turn it into a Dark Cinder. (Happens on a per-tile basis.)

Sword skill. Targets a 5 Range line in a cardinal direction from you and you move along it. The first enemy hit takes weapon-based damage, and on-hit effects are applied to them.

If used while Airborne, movement will continue until you hit an Airborne enemy (you still damage enemies). Airborne enemies are knocked back by the full range of the skill and knocked down.

A heavy attack iconic to the Black Knights, using their heavy armor to crush their opponent with power. On use, attacks a nearby target. If the attack hits, you deal bonus damage equal to your Scaled DEF.

If the target is Immobilized or Flatfooted, the attack cannot miss. If they are defeated by this attack, the unit is inflicted with Certain Defeat for 6 rounds. (Certain Defeat prevents defeated enemies from being revived.

Arcane skill. A cherry blossom blooms at a tile in 7 range, which boosts the stats of those near it (only one can be active). Enemies beneath it will take Earth magic damage, be knocked airborne, and one tile away. An enemy damaged by Cherry Blossom while within 3 range of it are covered in Cherry Petals for 3 rounds.

Annorum: Targets a Cherry Blossom. Destroys it, but deals this skill's damage to all enemies, and restores all allies' HP by 50+(50*Rank.)

Cherry Petals

Additionally treated as plant race, due to being covered in petals. Because that's all it takes.

Placed: Covers tiles in effective range (+1) in Ice Sheets for 2 rounds.

Triggered: Covers tiles in effective range in Ice Sheets for 3 rounds. Enemies in those tiles may be inflicted with Frostbite LV X for 3 rounds. (X = Rune Level * 3)

Engrave: Attempts to inflict Frostbite LV X (X = Rank * 5) for 3 rounds.

Can only be used if you are Installed with a Youkai. Targets 1 of your summoned Youkai (who is not Installed with a Youkai) within 5 Range and installs them with your Installed Youkai, restoring their HP by X% of their maximum HP (based on Rank) and giving them Chimera Install for 5 rounds. You gain Lockout for the Youkai you transferred for 3 rounds, which prevents you from summoning them.
When you use a Verglas discipline skill, the Momentum cost of all skills of a different discipline are reduced by 1 for the rest of the round. (You can only gain this effect once per round.)

Linked Runes do not trigger normally. Rune Level increased by Chronos count. When Chronos count is 4, effective range is increased by 3.

Engrave: Attempts to inflict the target with Slow LV X (X = Rank) for 2 rounds.

Resonate: Increased Chronos count by 1 if not at 4. If it was at 4, the rune will trigger, unless a Null rune was linked with it.

A red mark that increases pain. When Claret Call is applied to an enemy, it gives them or powers up a status by LV X (X = 1, or 2 if below 50% HP) that lasts for 3 rounds. Claret Call boosts the damage of basic attacks, as well as the damage of Ghost skills.

Claret Call is applied by dealing physical damage to an enemy, or by various Ghost skill effects. (Max LV is equal to 5 + Ghost level.)
Make your enemies into little more than targets to shoot. While you are in Desperado Stance:

Enter a meditative posture and channel ki to remove harmful effects from your body. If you are affected by certain status effects (based on Rank), they are immediately healed. (The listed status removals are cumulative, so you will remove both Slow and Poison at Rank 2, for example.)

Status effects with a LV higher than your WIL will not be cured.

The Cobra is a slippery fighter, capable of getting out of any tight danger and avoiding deadly attacks as if they were nothing. A fast, free-flowing style, much like an agilie snake's approach.

When you use this skill or a Cobra stance skill, your active stance becomes Cobra. Cobra stance increases your Evade by 5.

Become a blur, switching between multiple stances with beautiful ease. All Stance changing skills become Airborne Compatible, and their first use in a Round will restore 1 Momentum.

When Auto-Stance Swapping, you gain a stacking buff for 1 Round that increases Scaled Weapon Power by 2.

Bear Discipline technique. Targets an enemy in 1 Range, or a tile in 1 Range (if you have Ice Point Guard, or one exists in it), launching it up up to X tiles (2 + Rank) or until it encounters an enemy. The enemy hit by this skill takes Blunt damage and is knocked back based on how close they are when hit.

Bonus effects may occur while Ice Point Greaves, or if an enemy collides into an Ice Point.

An extra cold burst of water wraps around an enemy within 5 Range, dealing Ice magic damage to them.

Aquae Crest: If LV 9 or higher, has an infliction-based chance to cause Frozen LV100 for 3 rounds. If successful, consumes 9 LV.

extras: This skill does not take up a Skill Pool slot.
text.description: Make a masterful dance of blows that leave your enemies bewildered and jealous. Toggle skill. While toggled on, using Demon Hunter Offensive skills (excluding skills with a base Momentum cost of 1, Retaliate, and Wild Ride) or a Soldier Offensive skill reduces the Momentum and FP cost of all skills of those types that you have not used this round by 1, but reduces their damage by 25%. This effect can stack up to 2 times (to a minimum of 1 Momentum and a maximum penalty of 50%.)

When it comes to fighting a worthy foe, true Martial Artists know that two things are true; first, if you keep using the same technique over and over, your opponents will undoubtedly create counter-measures against it. Secondly, using various techniques in combination often results in a stronger front.

This skill increases the total Power of all Offensive skills by 15%, provided it is the first time you have used it this round, and only if you've used a different Offensive skill from the same class in the same round.

The Druid is skilled in commanding the forces of nature, and at times, earning their loyalty.

Plant and Beast enemies can be converted by your Convert skill without being Calmed first. Furthermore, any attempts to Convert one of those races gain a +10% success rate bonus.

Targets an enemy within X range (based on Rank), and performs a basic attack on the target with your whip which deals magic damage. If the target is Crystalized, the attack gains a bonus to Hit, and if it hits, the Crystal shatters into 2 gemstones for 2 rounds, landing at random tiles within 2 range of the target.

The unseen blade is the deadliest.

When attacking with Small size weapons, the Shinobi has +5 Hit and +5 Critical.

Targets 1 of your Youkai within 10 Range and commands them to preform a diving attack. They will move up to 4 tiles in the direction they are facing, dealing Pierce damage to all enemies encountered, based on the Youkai's SKI. (The Youkai will travel through enemies as long as the last tile in the line is a valid battle tile.) Bonded Youkai will move 1 extra tile.

Targets 1 of your Youkai within 10 Range and commands them to preform a rushing attack. They will move up to 3 tiles in the direction they are facing, dealing Blunt damage to the first enemy encountered, based on the Youkai's STR. Bonded Youkai move 1 extra tile.

Targets 1 of your Youkai within 10 Range and commands them to preform a spinning attack. They will move up to 2 tiles in the direction they are facing, dealing Slash damage to all enemies within 1 Range at the start of the skill and after each step based on the Youkai's CEL. Bonded Youkai move 1 extra tile.

Performer Song skill. Give the players some guidance. Targets 1 tile within 5 Range containing an enemy or Converted enemy and 1 unoccupied tile within that same Range, and play your instrument, forcing that enemy to take X steps towards it (based on Rank). (Non-Converted, non-Confused enemies require an infliction check for this effect to activate.)
Illusion skill. Target 1 enemy within 7 Range and attempts to inflict them with Confusion for 3 Rounds.

While equipped, all Youkai except for the first 3 Youkai in your contract list will be ignored. (You can't summon or install them, and they will not count against you for the purposes of determining Bonder benefits. You can rearrange the order of your contracts list in the Companions menu. If Contract Uno is equipped as well, this skill has no effect.)

While equipped, all Youkai except for the first Youkai in your contract list will be ignored. (You can't summon or install them, and they will not count against you for the purposes of determining Bonder benefits. You can rearrange the order of your contracts list in the Companions menu.)

More used to dealing with heavy objects, the Arbalest is capable of easily calculating how that weight will affect their long-range shots. Reduces penalty by 1 (Doubled while in firing posture). Additionally, when using a cannon skill, enemies at your sides are pushed one tile in the direction you are facing before damage and other effects are applied.

True Curates know that the path they follow is the right one, and are capable of convincing others of that. Targets 1 Pacified monster within 4 Range and attempts to convert them to your side. (Bosses, minibosses, and undead-race monsters are immune.) If successful, the monster joins your party for the rest of the battle. (It will still give EXP as if it were defeated.)

Your success rate is equal to the following:

Total FAI + (Devotion talent Rank * 2) + (your level - target's level, or 0 if less than 1) = success percent.

You can only have one converted enemy at a time.

Treatment skill. Targets 1 ally (or yourself) within 1 Range and removes any Burn effect they are suffering from, as long as it has a LV equal to or lower than X (based on Rank). If you have a Staff-type weapon equipped, the Range of this skill is increased by 3.

By releasing a certain valve on their Gun, the process of cooling down the gun takes less time. Using this skill reduces the cooldown of both Overcharge and Spark Drive by X Rounds (based on Rank), and reduces the LV of any Burn status you are suffering from.
Spear skill. Surprise an enemy with a spear strike from a distance. You perform a basic attack from 3 Range, gaining bonus Hit (based on Rank) due to the swiftness of the strike.
Attacks made through Riposte and Sheath Sword receive bonus damage based on Rank.
Gun skill. Target an enemy in range and shower it with bullets. For 3 rounds, the target suffers a penalty to Hit and Critical (based on Rank) when they are attacking any target but you.

Unleash the wild cries of the swift hunters of the night; coyotes hunt in packs, after all.

While you are using two Shotgun weapons, you gain the ability to Twin Dance with them, even at range. If you have the Akimbo skill active, you can also gain the effect while wielding a Shotgun and a Handgun.

Spend a moment to crack your knuckles, your neck, and all that good stuff. Grants Loosened body LV X (Based on rank) for 5 rounds. If you have no torso equipped, or your total weight is 5 or less. This skill costs 1M less.
Weakens the wall between your youkai and yourself, letting energies from the astral plane flow into you. Recovers FP based on Rank every round.

Can only be used once per round. A simple jump that causes you to move to a nearby tile and become Airborne in the same motion. Since it's so simple, it has low Momentum and FP costs. If you target a tile with an enemy in it, before you land, you will flip them into the air, causing them to become Airborne instead of you.

Matador stance. Requires 15 Rage Energy. Can only be used while Airborne. You come crashing down to the ground, dealing Dark magic damage to all enemies within a 2 Range Circle, as well as launching them Airborne.

If you are Grappling an enemy: You throw that enemy to the ground insteaad, increasing damage to all enemies by 15%, and damage the Grappled target takes ignores evasion.

Fox Discipline technique. Targets a line; spikes travel along that line. If it encounters an Ice Point, it will move in another line to another Ice Point within 5 Range, or an enemy within 5 Range.

*Tiles crossed are covered in Ice Sheets (2 rounds).

*Enemies hit take Ice magic damage (+50% if hit more than once, to a max of +200%).

*Can jump a maximum of 5 times.

Dark Bard Song skill. Use up all of your Momentum to really shred your instrument. All allies (including yourself) within a 5 range Circle around you take Sound Kickback Damage and restore FP based on the amount of Momentum used (based on Rank).

If at least 3+ Momentum was used, Trickery: Automatically activate Pyrotechnics if the skill was equipped.

Illusion spell. Targets 3 separate tiles in a triangle pattern that can be sized. At each target location, you create a shade and hide yourself as one. Shades are illusions and have 1 HP, and at the start of your next turn, they will vanish. However, enemies will not be able to examine shades and tell them apart from you, making them useful decoys, especially against monsters.

Sword, Axe, or Spear skill. Unleashes a projectile in a line that deals elemental magic damage to the first enemy hit (based on enchanted elemental).

If you have invoked the Black Wind this round, the target may also be inflicted with Interference for 3 rounds. Otherwise, you invoke the Black Wind to appear either nearby the enemy hit, or if none, the tile the projectile expired at.

Overwhelm enemies with arcane power, thanks to your Aquae Crest. When Aquae Crest LV is at 9, you ignore 10% of elemental resistance of enemies. If Aquamancer is both your main class and sub class, this effect is doubled.

Requires 3 Geomaterial. Create a magic sigil that enchants an ally within 5 range, granting them Crest of Bishop for 5 rounds. If the target is one of your Pawn Automatons, if you do not have a Bishop Automaton, they instead gain it permanently and are transformed into a Bishop automaton and gain 1 LV of Automaton Energy. Trickery - Target's negative status effect caused by enemies are reduced by 1 round. Crest of Bishop's buff: LVx2 Light ATK. Decreases the duration of status effect by 1 round.

Require 3 Geomaterial. Create a magic sigil that enchants an ally within 5 Range, granting them Creste of Knight for 5 rounds. If the target is one of your Pawn Automatons, if you do not have a Knight Automaton, they instead gain it permanently and are trained into a Knight Automaton and gain 1 LV of Automaton Energy. Trickery effect - Automaton targets use their main weapon's atack skill on a target in its range (Deal 50% damage.) Crest of Knight buff gives guard skill, and LVx25 chance to counter-attack once per round for 50% damage.

Requires 5 Geomaterial. Create a magic sigil that enchant an ally within 5 range, granting them Crest of Rook for 5 rounds. If the target is one of your pawn Automatons, if you do not have a Rook automatons. They instead gain it permanently and are transformed into a Rook Automaton and gain 1 LV of Automaton energy. Trickery - Target also gains Swift Guard Lv30 until their next turn. Crest of Rook: LvX2 Earth ATK. When within 1 range of Status causer, intercept damage for them and gains Scaled WPN UP LV X ( 5xLV) for 2 rounds.

This skill requires a Rank D Invocation.

Immediately imbue your focus into the Aquae Crest, increasing its LV to 9. In addition, you gain a status for 5 rounds, which regenerates 1 LV of Aquae Crest at the start of a new round.

Bow/Gun skill. Performs a basic attack (only 1 Round for Guns), aiming at the arms (or facsimile) of a target within your weapon's attack range with a 20% penalty to Hit. If it hits, the target's STR and SKI are reduced by X (X = Rank), and have the use of any Hands slot item they have disabled for 3 rounds.

Bow/Gun skill. Performs a basic attack (only 1 Round for Guns), aiming at the legs (or facsimile) of a target within your weapon's attack range with a 20% penalty to Hit. If it hits, the target's CEL is reduced by X (based on Rank), their move is reduced by X, and they suffer a damage penalty to certain Kick skills equal to Y (based on Rank), for 3 rounds.

Curse skill. Curse skills will apply a curse to yourself for 3 rounds, and while active, you will suffer the effects of the curse. However, if an enemy damages you while a Curse is active, it will transfer to them. (Once transferred, the curses remain on the victim and the duration is refreshed.) Muysig will cripple the victim, reducing their SKI and CEL.

Whip Skill. Flows the arcane energy of Enchantment through your whip, delivering your support in rather violent fashion. Changes your Mage/Ruler enchant spells to target a 4 size diamond, allowing them to affect multiple allies at once, for 1 round. Allies other than yourself who receive that spell take kickback damage, as you whip them to cast it.

Sword skill. You charge the edge of your weapon with focus and cut in the air, channeling ice magic and causing the air to freeze and shatter, dealing Ice physical damage to all enemies in the area of effect. Freezing variation also has a chance to inflict Frozen LV 20 for 2 rounds.

A new twist on an old favorite. When playing the Cantus of Consideration, all affected allies are also healed of 1 or more random negative status effects. (Maximum healed = 1 + half of Cantus of Consideration's Rank; 3 at Rank 5. Your LUC improves the chance of more statuses healed.)

The end of the show. Can be used by any weapon.

All enemies within X Range (X = 3 + Tempo) take Dark magic damage, which is boosted by 15% per Tempo level, and then your Tempo is reset to 0. This skill will also trigger One-Two Steps on damaged enemies.

If used at 6+ Tempo, the damage ignores immunity, reflect, and absorb.

Axe Skill. Two quick swings from your axe on an enemy in 1 Range. The first swing applies Claret Call, and the second consumes it, deals damage, and inflicts Cut Down LV X (X = half of Claret Call's level) for 3 rounds. Cut Down reduces the targets Phys and Magic Defense by LV%.

Dagger skill. Can only target an enemy that you are directly behind. Performs a basic attack on the target with a modifier to your Hit, which if successful, may inflict Silence on the target for 2 rounds (3 rounds on Critical Hit). If Veil Off is active, the effect is guaranteed.

Spear skill. Throw your spear high into the air, where it will fall at a nearby location within 5 Range. Upon landing, it creates a cyclone, dealing Wind damage to all enemies within a 3 Range circle.

All enemies within 5 Range of the spear will be pulled towards it one tile, and all battlefield objects in the damage range will be blown 3 tiles away. If they impact with enemies, they may have special effects.

text.powerRaw: Cures Clumsy and Immobilization. Grants Immunity for 3 rounds.
text.description:
When it's time to dance, nothing will stop you.

Cures you of Immobilize and Clumsy, and grants immunity to those status effects for 3 rounds.

Even weapons and claws can serve as dance partners.

Using a Dance skill gives you a bonus to Evade for 1 attack/2 rounds (based on Rank). This effect can stack, up to a maximum of 6 attacks/3 rounds.

Just pretend your mistakes were part of the show.

Damage dealt by Dance skills do not cause a Momentum penalty when hitting resistances, absorbs, or immunities.

Not everyone can keep up with a true dancer.

Damage dealt by Dance skills has a chance to critically hit for 25% extra damage.

Dance skill. Invite your foes close for a dance with a saucy move or two.

Targets all enemies within 8 Range, inviting them to move towards you X tiles (based on Rank). Player characters require a Status Infliction check to be lured, unless they're Charmed. Boss units are immune.

You are adept at building up a rhythm into a wonderful performance.

Using a Dance skill increases your Tempo by 1 (max: 6). The damage of your Dance skills is amplified by (Tempo*5)%, but increases their FP cost by (Tempo*2). Furthermore, provides a bonus to all Elemental ATK equal to Tempo*2. Using a non-Dance skill resets your Tempo to O, but it will persist between rounds. (Basic actions will not reset Tempo. These include Movement, Attack, Skip, and End Turn.)

extras: Learn skill, Chance: 25% Scaled CEL + 10% Per Tempo
text.description:
The power of a dancer's flexibility in full force, making fools of foes.

When an enemy with 1 Range of you performs a basic attack on you, while at least 1 other enemy is also within 1 Range of you, there is a chance that you will swerve out of the way, redirecting the attack to one of those other enemies but halving its damage. Triggering this effect requires 10 FP, and an enemy can only be affected by Master of the Stage once per round (unless you are monoclassing Dancer).

Toggle skill. While toggled on, damage you deal (except from One-Two Step) will not defeat enemies, leaving them at 1 HP instead. Furthermore, damage taken from enemies with 10 HP or less is reduced by 50%, as being so weak gives them two left feet.

Animate water in a tile within 6 Range, creating an attackable Dancing Tentacle there (LV based on duration and Rank).

Aquae Crest: If LV 5 or higher, +2 duration, +20 HP.

Dancing Tentacle

This is a special effect tile created by Aquamancer skills. At the start of a new round, it will attempt to attack an enemy within its attack range (1 Range if not on a Flooded Water or Dark Water tile, 2 Range otherwise), dealing damage to them that ignores evasion equal to its LV (Water damage by default, Dark damage if on Dark Water). It also has a chance to inflict Slow LV 2 (if not on water) or Immobilize (if on water) to the damaged enemy for 2 rounds.

When created, if there are any monsters in its attack range, it will attack one.

extras: This skill does not take up a Skill Pool slot.
text.description: Instantly tell where the enemy is hitting you. While you are in Cobra Stance, if you take damage from an enemy you are not facing, you turn to face them immediately afterwards.

By exposing yourself to the void while teleporting, you can gain valuable Void Energy, but it's a risk. When you teleport to a Voidgate, you generate 3 Void Energy, but take 5 unresistable Null damage.

Pledge allegiance to the state of rock and roll.

Passively increases SAN and STR. Also grants you immunity to damage dealt by Dark Bard skills from other non-Confused allied units. (Effects like Darkness Hype will still be given, even if the damage is ignored.)

Target 3 separate tiles in a triangle pattern that can be sized. At each target location, you summon a Dark Eye. Dark Eyes have a self-detonate skill that marks enemies with Dark Eye and deals Dark magic damage to them (if they do not already have Dark Eye). Enemies marked by Dark Eye will be affected by your Analyze Weakness and Enemy Evaluation skill when it's used on any enemy, regardless of range, and increase its effect by 50%. (This skill can only be used if you do not have Dark Eyes active.)

Axe skill. Causes your Axe to extend with a dark blade similar to a scythe, increasing its Hit with Axe weaponsand dealing Dark magic damage when you hit an enemy with a basic attack with an Axe weapon, or with a Ghost Axe skill.

This effect lasts for 4 rounds. At Rising Game LV 3, it lasts for an additional round. At Rising Game LV 6, its Momentum cost is reduced by 2.

By honing your skills with the dark arts, you increase the chance you have of successfully inflicting status ailments. In addition, increases your Dark ATK by 2*Rank. The status infliction rate is doubled if your main hand weapon is Cursed or Doomed.

A little bit of pain just makes the music more rockin'.

Allies who take damage from your Dark Bard skills gain Darkness Hype LV 10 (max LV: 300, max 10 rounds).

Darkness Hype: This is a stacking buff given by taking damage from allied Dark Bard skills. On its own, the effect grants +1 to all Elemental ATK per 10 LV. At the end of a battle, allies with Darkness Hype recover HP equal to its LV.

In addition, Darkness Hype may be used or consumed by other Dark Bard skills to gain bonus effects.

Passive: Grants Dark resistance based on Rank. Active: Consumes all available Void Energy and envelops yourself or target ally in a Dark Shield which increases RES by 1 + 1 per 5 Void Energy consumed. This shield lasts for 2 Rounds + 1 Round per 10 Void Energy consumed.

Give yourself the perfect place to play. In a circle around you, creates Dark Stage tiles, with a LV based on Rank (infinite duration). (This will end other Dark Stage tiles you currently have active).

Dark Stage: This is a special effect tile created by Dark Bard skills. After playing a Song or using a Dance skill, if you are on a Dark Stage tile, you create 2 Shadow Moshes at random unoccupied locations near your Dark Stage tiles (if you are at the edge of a Dark Stage, it will prefer to spawn them within 1 Range of you.)

Furthermore, allies standing on a Dark Stage tile boosts their own Fire, Dark, and Sound ATK by (LV*3), and DEF & RES by LV.

extras: Does not require a Skill Pool slot.
text.description:
Requires 1 Solcharge. Targets 2 locations within 6 Range

Location 1 must have your Solsphere, and Location 2 must be an unoccupied tile. Utilize the magic stored in the Solcharge to instantly teleport the Solsphere into Location 2.

Flick your hand and release droplets of water that quickly expand. Targets a 2-Size Circle up to 5 Range away and creates Flooded Water tiles there for 3 rounds.

Aquae Crest: If LV 4 or higher, increases duration by 1 round. (If Dark Water, it instantly activates.)
Inspires all allies in a 3-size circle, granting them bonuses to Hit and Critical damage based on Rank, for five rounds.
The Void Assassin is particularly adept at using daggers, capable of hurting people with them like almost no one else. Increases Critical Damage of Daggers by 10%.

A piercing gaze that seems to come from the grim reaper itself. The target of this skill must be marked by Claret Call and be Feared, and both must be caused by you. The target loses the Claret Call marking and becomes Unmarkable for 2 rounds, but is Silenced for 2 rounds. They also take Dark damage that ignores armor and evasion equal to 100% (+25% per additional Rank) of your Dark ATK.

Requires a Rank D Invocation. After casting, you will temporarily change into a Spectre Knight for 5 rounds. While you are a Spectre Knight, you gain access to the skills Calling, Hellspike, and Fallcall. You are also treated as the Possessed racial type for the same duration.

"Deliver death, become death..."
A new twist on an old favorite. When playing the Dawr of Defense, all affected allies also gain Swift Guard LV X until their next turn. (X = 2*Dawr of Defense's Rank)

A spinning kick that targets an enemy within 1 range, dealing blunt physical damage.

Ki: Knocks them away 1 tile per 3 Ki, to a max of 8, using 1 Ki per tile. Deals Sound magic damage to all enemies in 3 Range equal to half of the original damage if they run into an object. Otherwise, if Shukuchi is active, teleport next to them if the next tile in the same direction is empty, and apply the same effect (half effectiveness).

Creates four arrows of light in 2-long lines of tiles on either side of you. After a turn of priming, they will launch at the nearest enemy every round there after, one at a time, dealing Light magic damage. They can be attacked and destroyed, however; if so, the attacker recovers 20 FP.

Annorum: Danzai arrows gain an additional hit of durability and have no priming time.

Deploys a mobile platform at a target location within 5 range. Your machines can attach to this platform; when you use basic Movement skill, all machines within 1 range also move along with you.

Useful for keeping your machines at effective and useful ranges.

Deploys a robot carrying special medical supplies on it at a location within 5 Range, and is most effective when used while Total Control is on.

When a Bot is destroyed, it will leave behind Scrap at its current location. You can pick it up to reduce the FP cost of the next Deploy skill you use.

Deploys a robot primarily made for protecting you at a target location within 5 Range. The robot will intercept attacks if it is next to you, can create a Reflector to bounce back projectile skills, and is most effective when used while Total Control is on.

When a Bot is destroyed, it will leave behind Scrap at its current location. You can pick it up to reduce the FP cost of the next Deploy skill you use.

Deploys a robot with long-range capabilities at target location in 5 range. Although it cannot move, it has access to a powerful long-range rail shot that deals Light magic damage, provided it can charge up for a turn.

When a Bot is destroyed, it will leave behind Scrap at its current location. You can pick it up to reduce the FP cost of the next Deploy skill you use.

Deploys a robot primarily made for shooting at a target location within 5 Range. The robot can move and attack with special guns it has, and is most effective when used while Total Control is on.

When a Bot is destroyed, it will leave behind Scrap at its current location. You can pick it up to reduce the FP cost of the next Deploy skill you use.

Cobra Stance. Can only be used while Airborne. Targets 2 tiles in 3 Range; in Location 1, there can be an airborne enemy (optional), and Location 2 must be an unoccupied tile. You move towards Location 2, landing and regaining FP based on Rank.

If you targeted an Airborne enemy, you wrap your legs (or facsimile) around them, carrying them along for the ride, before slamming them into the ground, knocking them down and dealing 35 armor-ignoring Blunt damage to them.

The Rune Magician follows through on simple pre-planned patterns at a target location within 5 Range, using equipped Rune spells in order at that location. These uses all require the proper FP cost, use the appropriate amount of Momentum, and so on - this simply serves as a quick 'shortcut' method. The effect will continue until you have 1 Momentum left, or when no more Rune spells can be used.

Order: Same order as Rune spells equipped.

The Desperado is a man with nothing to lose, whose life and death is determined by how quick he draws his gun. They masterfully manipulate the art of gunplay and can take on large quantities of enemies effortlessly.

When you use this skill or a Desperado stance skill, your active stance becomes Desperado. Desperado stance increases your Hit by 5.

Turn your whip into a spinning drill and rush in a 3 to 5 range line. You move until stopped, each step affecting enemies and natural resources in 1 range. Enemies take Pierce Magic damage, and resources are refined. (Enemies are damaged once.) Can guard-break guarding or crystalized units at X% chance ( X = 10 x Ruler/Mage Buffs), on success digs up a rock near the enemy.

Placed: Destroys enemy-created special effect tiles with a Hardiness of 1 or less in it's effective range (+1).

Linked runes that deal damage have +30% increased damage.

Being up close and personal with someone you're treating often allows for a better level of care. When you are within 1 Range of a target you are using a Healing or Treatment skill on (Curate and Priest only), the power of the heal or cure is increased by 10% per Rank. (This does not apply when you are the target. This will affect the maximum LV healed by Treatment skills.)
