Targets one of your Voidgates within 7 range, and causes it to explode, dealing Dark magic damage to all enemies within 4 range of it. They will also be teleported to a random battlefield tile.

Dark Bard Song skill. Play your instrument, creating an explosion at a 3 size Circle within 3 Range, dealing Fire and Sound damage to all units inside of it. Enemies may be inflicted with Burn LV X (X = Rank * 10) for 3 Rounds.

Enemies take full damage, while allies take Kickback Damage.

extras: Equipping this skill does not take up a Skill Pool slot.
text.description: Let the power of faith see you through. While this skill is equipped, whenever you are invoking a Mercana spell, any chance for the Invocation to break upon taking damage is reduced by half of your Scaled FAI.

Create a vitality-stealing burst of darkness that hits 1 enemy within 5 range, dealing Dark magic damage to them. If it hits, you recover HP (based on rank). If the enemy was weak to Dark damage, you recover 50% more.

Exercise your Authority as Ruler and give the order to dig, which washes over all your other allies (Except Rulers), and confused enemies you have damaged this round. All affected units will Pillage the tile they are standing on, digging up rocks and other objects valid that can be refined. A unit charmed by the Ruler digs up 2 objects instead of 1. Enemies affected also are inflicted with Muddy for 2 rounds.

Attack enemies with powerful dimension shifts. Every time a Youkai you control is unsummoned, after the effect of Impact Dismiss applies, you gain Dimension Resonance LV1 (stacks up to LV2+Rank). The damage of Impact Dismiss is multiplied by Dimension Resonance's LV. However, the damaged caused by it will become resistable.
A type of martial arts mastery that instills the importance of patience and precision. Passively increases SKI and CEL.

Dip your partner back, as in any tasteful dance... but then let them hit the ground.

Targets 1 enemy within 1 Range that is not Airborne or Flying, and inflicts Knocked Down on them. If you have Tempo, this skill's cooldown is reduced by its level when using this skill. (Note: This is not a dance skill, so you will lose your Tempo afterwards.)

Pull back from your current location, hopping backwards up to 3 tiles (or until something blocks you). Upon landing, you recover HP (based on Rank) and gain a bonus to Evade for one attack (lasts 3 rounds).

extras: Equipping this skill does not take up a SP slot.
text.description:
There's just something a little different about this song...

Bard base class Song skills now deal Kickback Damage to allies when played, but those allies also gain Dark Distortion LV5 for 3 rounds, 1 attack.

Dark Distortion: +LV*2 Evade, +LV Armor and Magic Armor. Expires after being attacked.
Illusion skill. Manipulates waves of light around a target ally within 6 Range for 5 rounds, increasing their Evade (based on Rank).

Spear skill. Can only be used while airborne. Targets 1 enemy within 1 Range and dives down on them, spear first, performing a basic attack on them with a bonus to Hit. If the target is Airborne, if the attack hits, they are knocked down. If they are not, you inflict Aerial Razor LV X (X = Rank * 2) before the attack hits, which lasts until your next turn. Afterwards, you land.

This skill requires a Rank D Invocation (see the Invocation talent for more details).

Targets 1 enemy within 8 Range. For 5 rounds, that enemy's Faith is used instead of Defense/Resistance when calculating Phys/Magic Def for Mercalan domain spells respectively. In addition, the target's Light resistance is also negated, they become vulnerable to Antithesis, Blessed and Holy enchants, and lost elemental ATK equal to LV * 2. This effect cannot be dispelled.

The holy light cleanses all it touches.

While you have Holy Aura active, enemies you pass over take protection-ignoring Light magic bonus damage, based on Rank. (Only applies once per action, per enemy.)

This skill requires a Rank D Invocation (see the Invocation talent for more details).

Targets all enemies on the battlefield and deals Light magic damage that ignores evasion to them equal to WIL + a bonus based on rank. At Rank 5, all enemies damage also have a chance to be Blinded for 2 rounds. After being successfully casts, goes on a 3 round Cooldown.

extras: Equipping this skill does not take up a SP slot.
text.description: While equipped, this skill changes all Solblader effects and skills that deal Light damage and scale with Light ATK to deal Lightning damage and scale with Lightning ATK respectively, and changes the appearance of the Solsphere.

Rogues are, without saying, naturals at avoiding things, whether that be the law, or a swift kick to the jewels. Increases your base Evade (this is considered a base increase, and is not affected by the +50 Evade bonus cap.)
Everyone's a critic. While you are Singing, your Evade is increased by X (based on Rank).

Targets 1 enemy within 1 Range and deals Sound magic damage to them. The damaged enemy will also be knocked 1 + Rank tiles away in a cardinal direction, and then knocked down. If they encounter any other enemies while being knocked back, the effect will also apply to the enemy, and so on. If an enemy is weak to Sound, your Tactics Rank increases by 1 level.

Dance skill. A deadly dance, with an even deadlier partner.

Targets 1 ally (except yourself) or 1 Charmed enemy within 5 Range. Both you and your target will spin around, attacking all enemies (of yours, if an enemy is selected) within 1 Range of each other. This attack deals X% normal attack damage (based on Rank).

Sword skill. Can only be used while Airborne. Swing down your weapon on a foe in a downward arc, using your fall to build up momentum. Performs a basic attack on a target within 1 Range; if it hits, inflicts Wear Down LV X (X = 2 + Rank) for 2 Rounds (3 Rounds on critical hit). If the target is Airborne, it also has a chance to inflict Knocked Down.

This skill will bring you and the target down to the ground, ending Airborne.

Targets 2 tiles in 8 Range. Location 1 must contain one of your bloomed Druid Plants, and Location 2 must contain a unit within 5 Range of it. Grasping vines outreach from the plant, pulling the target unit 3 tiles closer to it.

If Predator and Prey is active and the target is an enemy, it deals 30 protection-ignoring Darkness damage, and restores 30 HP to you.

Targets 1 tile within 5 Range and plants a Devil Vines Sapling at it. If Mass is Active, you can target 2 tiles.

Growth Period: 1

Created by the Druid skill Devil Vines. A magical plant that can grow from druidic magics.

These thorn-covered vines seemingly feed on the suffering of those who move through them, and are notorious for spreading like weeds.

HP: 30

Bloom: Creates another Devil Vines Sapling at a valid tile within 2 Range of itself.

Stepped On: Any unit who steps on a tile containing Devil Vines take armor-ignoring Pierce damage equal to its LV. This also damages the plant for 10 HP, however; boss enemies will deal 30 HP instead, as they completely trample the vines.

Special: An allied unit of the placer that is within 1 Range of Devil Vines gains a chance to parry physical damage (35% Reduction, 50% Chance) as the vines move to protect them.

With the skill Druidic Tending, the plant gets the following bonuses:

Invigoration Tending - Effective LV is increased by 25%.

Quickness Tending - Parry success chance increased to 60%.

A heavy punch followed by a roundhouse kick, dealing damage based on Rank over two hits, to an enemy within 1 Range.

Ki: Gains +1 Range per 3 Ki, to a max. of 6. If you target an enemy outside of melee range, 2 Ki will be consumed per tile, but will launch a ki dragon at the target, applying the effect of this skill, creating air shafts for 3 rounds, but doing Wind magic damage (and bonus damage equal to 100% of Wind ATK).

Mimickry skill. Costs 1% of your maximum HP, can only be used by the Dragon race. Infuse yourself with a divine Draconic energy, increasing your Critical by 15 and Critical Damage by 15% for 2 rounds.

Your chaotic installing causes even the environment to change.

Triggering Chaotic Form will cause you to create a special effect tile at all tiles within 1 Range of you for 2 rounds (LV X, based on Rank), based on the element of the Youkai that was just Installed (only applies at the time you are Installed).

Sing a cursed song that fills a specific listener's mouth (within 5 Range) with water. Attempts to inflict Silence for 2 rounds on them, with a lower percentage of your Status Infliction, based on Rank. If successful, the song takes its toll, and you also inflict Silence on yourself for 2 rounds.

Aquae Crest: If LV 8 or higher, +10% Status Infliction, and if successful, consumes 8 levels for +1 duration (enemy only).

extras: Equipping this skill does not take up a Skill Pool slot.
text.description:
The Druid's Invigoration & Quickness spells become effective on their own Druid Plants. These spells grant the same type of Tending, which enhances the plant permanently; see plant descriptions for details.

But, Invigoration & Quickness gain a 1 round CD, and can only affect a number of your plants per single cast equal to the skill's Rank.

Druids are knowledgeable in special natural magic rituals that manipulate or grow plants. They have several skills that plant magical saplings at certain locations.

Each sapling has a Growth Stage and a Growth Period.

• Growth Stage - Starts at 0, and increases by 1 at the start of a new round. Certain Druid skills can accelerate this, listed as 'apply Growth X', where X is a number. Growth 1, for example, increases Growth Stage by 1.

• Growth Period - When the plant's Growth Stage reaches this value, it will Bloom.

Generally, saplings have no effect until they bloom. Once they do, they may trigger a Bloom effect (only once) and may have other additional effects, for example those that apply when a new round happens.

After blooming, these plants can also be attacked and destroyed, and most have 20 HP, letting them survive 2 attacks. However, plants created by these effects typically only last 10 rounds, unless prolonged by another effect.

extras: Equipping this skill does not take up a Skill point slot.
text.description: Toggle skill. Sometimes power doesn't need to be raw. It is far more effective if it is tempered by experience. While toggled on, increases the STR scaling of Tomes by 10%, and the WIL scaling of Swords by 10%.

The art of pulling off tricky shots; whether that requires bending at weird angles, firing in an odd angle, etc. Passively increases the Hit of Bow and Gun attacks, but also grants bonus effects to certain Archer skills if at a certain rank.

Mist Skill. This sill requires a Rank D Invocation. When cast, the battlefield is covered in a purple mist that seems to induce uneasiness. The purple mist lasts for 5 rounds, and while active, enemies cannot use Attack (or Sub-Attack) or any Offensive-class skill during the same turn they use Movement. Boss enemies do not have actions prevented, but instead have -15% Dark Resistance. (Only one Mist skill can be activate on the battlefield at a time.)

"Stand your ground and fight into the grave..."

Requires a Rank D Invocation. When cast, the ground gains shadowed faces of vengeful spirits. The vengeful spirits will remain for 5 rounds, and while they are active, enemies who use Attack (or Sub-Attack) or any Offensive-class skill suffer Dark damage that ignores armor based on Rank.

"Spirits of the fallen, deliver your grudge on these fools who dare to live..."

Gain a blessing from the eastern winds of agility, increasing the target's accuracy and speed. If you are closer to the east edge of the battlefield than the west edge, the stat bonus is higher. This bonus lasts for 3 rounds.

Sword skill. An attack requiring a great amount of focus, you release a golden X-shaped energy projectile that pierces enemies and travels 6 tiles away, which deals Slash magic damage to all enemies it touches. Upon reaching the end of its path, it will grow and explode, dealing Light magic damage to all enemies within a 4 Range Circle of that location.

Cannot be used during the same turn as basic Movement. Enemies hit by the projectile will take 50% damage from the explosion.

LV1 - +10% Damage per Charge Level

LV2 - Tiles the projectile passes over also receive the explosion effect.

LV3 - Ignores Evasion.

Any weapon that uses this skill can consume active Weapon Charges to gain these effects, depending on the amount consumed

extras: This skill does not take up any Skill Pool slots.
text.description: A true duelist's first strike should be their most beautiful. When attacking with a Spear or Sword, you gain bonus damage equal to twice your Momentum.

Generate a shield of electricity around you for rounds equal to 2+Rank. While active, the shield will shock any enemy who attacks you with a melee weapon, dealing Lightning magic damage to them, based on Rank.

You can reactivate this skill while it's active to overload it, which will deal Lightning damage to all enemies in a 3 Range circle around you equal to 3x the level of the shield, but will also put it on a 3 round CD.

Allows you to utilize elementals offensively while enchanted with them. When you (or someone enchanted with one of your Elementals, in which case it will use their Elemental ATK instead of yours.) hit with a basic attack, your basic attacks will deal elemental Magic damage to the target, based on Rank. The damage type depends on the elemental you are enchanted with (for example, you will deal Fire damage if Nerhaven, etc). If applied by a Gun attack, the damage is divided by the Gun's total rounds.

extras: This skill does not take up a Skill Pool slot.
text.description: Mind over matter, the saying goes. Why not both? After using Charge mind, you also gain Elemental overtime for the same duration, which increases the damage dealt by Elemental Augment by 100%.

Sword skill. Airborne Compatible. Deals physical Slash damage over 4 hits to one enemy within 1 Range.

If you and your target are both Airborne, the damage becomes magic damage and alternates between Fire, Ice, Wind and Lightning, and is increased by 10% of those respective ATKs.

text.powerRaw: 100% Scaled Weapon Attack (+100% Elemental attack based on tome)
text.description:
Engrave: Deals elemental magic damage to the target.

Triggered: Deals elemental magic damage to enemies in range, increasing with Rune Level.

Damage dealt is based on your currently tome (Or fire, by default),(100% of SWA + 100% Elemental Attack).

Rip apart all defenses and let the songs flow like blood.

While you are under the effect of Volume Up, skills from Bard classes that deal Fire, Dark, or Sound damage ignore up to 15% of enemies' elemental resistance. (This does not reduce those resistances below 0%.)

Dagger skill. Uses up 3+M and consumes all Void Energy. Targets 1 enemy within 1 Range (or 7 Range if Airborne; you move next to them) and deals Slash damage, and then Pierce damage, which ignores evasion. Damage is increased by (Void Energy consumed)%, plus 40% if you are Sneaking. If the target is a non-boss, non-player character, it also has a chance equal to the damage bonus to instantly kill the target (if the target's level is equal or less than your level +10).

If a target is defeated by this attack, all enemies will be inflicted with Fear for the rest of the battle.

While some Martial Artists prefer to employ gauntlets and other such hand-based weaponry, some still prefer to use absolutely no weapon at all. These users of the empty palm receive a bonus to Power, Hit, and Critical when using their bare fists, based on Rank.

Shield skill. Requires you to be enchanted with an elemental (item effects that treat you as if you were enchanted with one will not work). Transfers the elemental from you to your shield, ending the effect for you, but granting you an Elemental Shield for 3 rounds of the same element.

The elemental shield will grant resistance to the same element equal to X% (X = Rank*5) and will deal damage (ignores armor) to enemies who attack you or that you Bash equal to X. Guarding will double the elemental resistance and retaliation damage, but no effect is given when under Guard Break.

Sometimes a song is so good, people want to listen to it over and over. When one of your Bard song effects expires due to its duration on you or an ally), there is a chance (based on Rank and SAN) that the same effect will reapply itself with a 2 round duration automatically. (NOTE: Songs reapplied this way will not trigger this effect.)
Targets a 3 Size Diamond within 4 Range. All allied youkai in that area gain Encourage LV X (2 + Rank) for 5 rounds, which boosts all of their stats by LV.
The type of body necessary to take a beating. Increases your maximum HP by 10% while equipped.

extras: Range increased by 1 if a Tome is equipped.
text.description: Knowing your enemy is more important than knowing yourself. You perform an evaluation on a target enemy within 3 Range. The evaluation's effectiveness is based on Skill Rank and your Tactics Rank. Evaluated enemies suffer a penalty to Hit, Evade, Critical, and damage they deal (equal to 10+Tactics Rank+Skill Rank%). The duration of the evaluation is equal to 1 + Tactics Rank rounds. (If you are defeated, the evaluation immediately ends.).

Move your leeched energy through various legitimate businesses and right into your pocket.

Requires Leeched Energy. Ends your Leeched Energy status and restores FP equal to the LV* X (based on Rank).

Supplement a summoned youkai's focus with even more of your own. By targeting a Youkai within 5 Range with this skill, you restore the FP of it by the FP cost of this skill plus a bonus (based on Rank). In addition, if you have the appropriate Affinity skill, the FP restore will be increased by the growth bonus it gives that Youkai.

The Ruler has studied the basics time and time again, letting their mage enchantment effects become a little more potent. Enhances your mage base class enchant spells. When removed before expiring, they create a 2-range magic burst. Deals (LV x 10) armor-ignoring bonus magic damage. Furthermore, if defensive category, casting it on a single target increases its LV by 2.

Requires a Rank D Invocation. After casting, all enemies take Dark magic damage. The damage is increased by 2% for every 1% of the target's missing HP. After being successfully cast, goes on a 3 round Cooldown.

"Judge of hell, your verdict, please..."

Creates a protective bubble, like that of a legendary water dragon's, around an ally within 5 Range for 3 rounds. The bubble increases the target's Armor and Magic Armor by LV X (X = Rank), Fire Resistance equal to LV * 3%, and Burn status resistance by LV * 5%.

Aquae Crest: If LV 6 or higher, LV increases by 1 and duration by 2 rounds, and can cure Burn effects from the target.

Places an entangle trap at an unoccupied square within 2 range for 3 turns. If an enemy walks within 2 cardinal squares of the trap, it triggers, which halts the triggerer's Movement action (if any), will cause all tiles in its Range to be covered in Thick Vines for 3 rounds, as well as dealing Earth physical damage to the one who triggered it.

Focus your mind to the highest level possible. While equipped, when you use Charge Mind while you already have Charge Mind active, you gain Ephemeral Insight for 2 rounds (your Charge Mind duration also becomes 2 rounds). Ephemeral Insight causes the next spell to deal Akashic damage instead of its original damage type and then ends. When Ephemeral Insight ends, you gain Worn Out LV 10 for 2 rounds.
By absorbing the spiritual energy of defeated enemies, you restore your own Focus. At the end of a battle, you regain FP for every enemy that was defeated based on Rank.
Attacks the target with pure shadow, dealing Dark magic damage. If the target is suffering from Blind, the duration of that status effect is extended by 1 Rounds (to a maximum of 2 rounds).

A magical flame that resides in the lantern of the Lantern Bearer. It causes lantern spells to have a lingering effect that increases certain statistics equal to the Flame Strength. If Lantern Bearer is your Main Class, Eternal Flame is always active as long as it is equipped. If it is your Sub Class, you must activate this skill, and it is active for a certain number of rounds.

An invitation to the underworld. Targets an enemy within 1 Range and pulls all Claret Calls on all enemies to them, stacking them together. Afterwards, you perform a basic attack on the target, which deals bonus damage equal to 20% of your missing HP. If it hits, and they are marked with Claret Call, the Claret Call explodes in the wound, consuming it and making them Unmarkable for 2 rounds, but giving them Cursed Wound LV X (X = damage dealt by the attack).

When you duck out of the way of a punch, the only proper thing to do is hit them back. Serves them right! When you successfully evade an attack from an enemy within 1 Range, you deal Blunt physical damage to them based on Rank. This damage is not affected by their Defense.

A mastery of tainted powers, in a sense. Increases the damage you deal with basic attacks if the weapon is Cursed or Doomed (based on Rank). The bonus is halved if Hexer is not your Main Class. Gun attacks will only receive a maximum of (Rank) bonus damage.

Toggle skill. Parry skill (only one takes effect at a time).

While on, you will begin using one of your melee weapons (sub by default; else main) as a parrying tool. At a chance equal WPN durability (unbreakable = 40) + a bonus, you can parry attacks and skills (excluding spells) from monster, Sword, Axe, and Spear weapons. Success reduces the damage taken by 50% and WPN durability by 1. Protection from Arrows will let you parry Bows (easier at longer range). You can only parry attacks that you can see, and only if the parrying weapon isn't broken.

The art of utilizing focus in the air around your body to increase the power of Arcana, by drawing it into your body, for which the Evoker is named. While utilizing Light Armor or Unarmored torso items, the damage of all your spells increases based on Rank. Unarmored torso items will grant you twice the bonus.

extras: Reduces the FP cost associated with Evoking by 5/10/15/20/25 %
text.description: A mastery of utilizing evoking skills. While not on the level of the Miashima, it does reduce the FP cost associated with the art.

Play with fire, and... you know the rest. When you evade a basic attack, you gain Evoke Retaliation for 2 rounds, which increases the power of your spells by 10, as well as critical by 10 (But only for lightning criticals)

extras: Equipping this skill does not take up a SP slot.
text.description:
Toggle skill. Utilizes your Solcharges in destructive ways. While on, allows them to be consumed when you use a Soldier base class skill as if they were Weapon Charges for Excel Crash effects.

Weapon Charges will be prioritized and cannot be used with Solcharges. Skills enhanced by Solcharges gain Great Accuracy instead of being evasion ignoring.

A new twist on an old favorite. When playing the Anthem of Enthusiasm, all affected allies also deal Sound bonus magic damage on hit equal to 5+X% of your Sound ATK (up to 3 times) for 3 rounds. (X = 10*Anthem of Enthusiasm's Rank.)

Can only target 1 enemy within 1 Range that is Knocked Down. Deals physical damage that ignores evasion to the target, increased by a percentage of their missing HP (max +100 damage), but cures their knockdown, making it a good idea to make sure they won't get back up after this blow.

This skill requires a Rank D Invocation (see the Invocation talent for more details).

Targets 1 enemy within 6 Range and fires 6 fireballs at them, dealing Fire magic damage to them. Every fireball has an even chance of dealing plus or minus 5*Rank extra damage. (Positive effect chance increases with LUC.) If you are enchanted with Nerhaven, two extra fireballs are fired.

"Burn the body, count the ashes..."

Fox Discipline technique. Targets all areas in a cardinal direction from any Ice Sheets you or allies have created. Any enemies within the affected area take Ice magic damage. (Enemies cannot be damaged more than once). Furthermore, all affected areas are covered in Ice Sheets for 3 rounds, and the duration of your existing Ice Sheets becomes 3 rounds.

A steady hand makes for a steady shot. If you have Longdraw equipped, it activates automatically (for free) at the start of a round. However, using any movement skill will cause it to end (while this skill is equipped).

Most Ranger Arcane spells benefit from Longdraw's Range increase.

Targets a Circular location, and begins rapidly compressing air inside as a Fuse Field Objective (X turn, +1 per extra circle size, X = numbers of battle participants or 8, whichever is lower.), when it explodes, it deals Fire magic damage to all enemies inside of it. If enchanted with Nerhaven, the Explosion may inflict burn, and will knock enemies airborne, and then away from the center by 3 tiles.
While dangerous, making your own tweaks to explosives gives them that personal touch, making them more deadly. Increases the damage of your Bombs.
When you're constantly exposed to things like danger and magic, you tend to build up a resistance to them. Passively increases CEL and RES based on Rank.
Consumes 20 Void Energy. Extends the duration of all of your Voidgates by 3 rounds, and all positive status effects you have by 2 rounds.

Hare Discipline technique. Targets 1 enemy within 3 Range that is Knocked Down and has an unoccupied tile next to them, and deals Blunt physical damage to them.

If Ice Point Guard is active, it is deployed to the target's tile. Otherwise, the target is cured of Knocked Down (without paying Momentum).

Mimickry skill. Costs 1% of your maximum HP, can only be used by the Fairy race. Hide you and target Ally within 6 Range with fairy dust. When the dust clears, the two of you will have swapped locations.

Spear skill. Targets a location within 6 Range that is unoccupied, which you swiftly dash towards in a flexible line of tiles, faster than the eye can see. All enemies in those tiles take Pierce physical damage, which ignores evasion. Afterwards, if 3 Magical Feathers are available, they are consumed, and all of your feathers on the battlefield immediately resonate.

Parry skill. If you can use movement skills, at a chance of 25% + (higher of 25% CEL & 50% DEF) + 15% (if enemy is under your Genpo), you can parry incoming physical damage (35% reduction).

Once per round, when this triggers, you teleport to an empty tile within 3 Range (except in 1 Range of an enemy) and leave behind a Ninja Trick.

Deals Ice magic damage to all enemies within the area of effect. All tiles in the area are also covered in ice, which will prematurely end movement by 1 tile for every ice sheet walked upon. These ice sheets will last up to 3 turns.

Fan skill. Toss your fan, sending it out as a projectile in a 5 Size Line. The first enemy it encounters takes armor-ignoring damage equal to 5 + its Power, of its damage type, and applies on-hit effects to them.

This skill is not a Dance, but it will not stop your Singing nor alter your Tempo.
The Lantern Bearer's lantern burns more brightly, increasing the reach of all auras, Lantern Bearer spells, and Lantern Bearer bonus effects.

Imbues yourself with quick arcane energies. For 2 rounds, when you summon a Youkai, it gains Momentum equal to 1+Rank, allowing it to act immediately. (Youkai must normally wait a turn after being summoned to act.) If you have only one Bonded Youkai, it gains an additional 2 Momentum.

Dark Bard Song skill. An end to the show that they'll never forget. All of your Shadow Moshes explode with dark energy, dealing Dark magic damage to all units within 1 Range of them. (Allies take Kickback Damage. Enemies can only be hit once per use.)

Uses 10 Magical Feathers. Creates a spinning shield of feathers around you, which helps you move quickly and protects you from afflictions, granting you +X (based on Rank) Evade and Status Resist for 5 rounds.

Note: There's an in-game typo. "[...] which helps you move [...]" is written as "[...] which help you move [...]".

Fist skill. Sweep the legs or whatever counts of target enemy, knocking them down. Cannot target Airborne enemies or enemies with the Flying attribute. This skill has a lengthy cooldown, but is reduced by half of your Schwarz Sturm level.

Fist skill. A weighty hook punch that sets the target off-balance.

Deals Blunt Damage to the target and inflicts them with Flatfoot. If you are Swaying, this skill can critically hit (25% damage).

Curse skill. Curse skills will apply a curse to yourself for 3 rounds, and while active, you will suffer the effects of the curse. However, if an enemy damages you while a Curse is active, it will transfer to them. (Once transferred, the curses remain on the victim and the duration is refreshed.) Fellel will cause the next attack of the target to always miss. Its LV will then be reduced by 1 (and if it reaches 0, the effect ends.)

Finisher (resets Schwarz Sturm to 0 when used). Deal a crushing blow to the ground in a 3 Range circle around you, dealing Earth magic damage to all enemies inside of it.

It will also create pillars of rock at the edge of the circle, which last for rounds equal to your Schwarz Sturm level.

The ice wolf releases a chilling howl, dealing Ice magic damage to all enemies within 3 Range, and slowing their Move by 2 for 2 rounds.

(Damage/Heal and Effect Power/Duration/Chance from Lantern Activations are more effective when close and less effective when far.)

Eternal Flame: STR, SKI

extras: Removes one debuff caused by an enemy.
text.description: Sometimes, there is no time to move someone to a safer location; They need treatment then and there. Target 1 ally within 1 range (or yourself), restoring HP based on rank, plus (Tactic Rank * 2)% of the target's max HP.

When you and your Bonded Youkai are within 2 Range of each other, all of you gain a bonus to Hit, Evade, Critical, and Critical Evade, based on Rank. (All of your Bonded Youkai must be summoned for this to take effect.) If you have only one Bonded Youkai, the effect is doubled.

Sometimes you just need a breather.

Ending your turn with unspent Momentum restores 3 FP per momentum point.

Dagger skill. Must have at least one non-Invocation Copy spell. Loads up your dagger with magical energy for 3 rounds. The next target you hit with a basic attack deals no damage, but instead releases up to Rank Copy Spells (excluding Invocations) on the target randomly. Spells cast this way deal only 75% damage and are lost after being cast (until the end of the battle).

After the magical energy is expended, or time runs out, your dagger explodes, reducing its durability to 0, knocking you back from the target by 7 tiles and knocking you down.

extras: Can be enhanced with weapon charges.
text.description:
Unleashes a fireball in a line in one direction that travels up to 4 Range. First enemy hit takes Fire damage. If enchanted with Nerhaven, the fireball explodes when it hits an enemy or at the end of its travel, dealing its damage to all enemies in an AoE.

This spell can be enhanced with the usage of weapon charges.

Special Arrows skill.

Fire Arrows deal Fire damage equal to Rank + (5*Rank)% of your Fire ATK, and have a chance to inflict Burn LV X. Being enchanted with Nerhaven improves the chance by 50%.

Dance skill. You target an unoccupied tile within 4 Range and move in a line to it. Every time you move through a tile, you deal Fire magic damage (based on your Fire ATK and Rank) to a random enemy within 2 Range. Enemies hit multiple times take 50% damage from additional hits.

A fairy made of fire floats near yourself or target ally, increasing their STR. After each movement step, they will destroy all Ice sheets within 1 range (up to Rank*2 Ice Sheets). Also grants a special skill called Fairy Fly that uses up the buff to destroy a circle of Ice sheets up to 6 Range away.

Places a fire trap at an unoccupied square within 2 range for 10 rounds. If an enemy walks within 2 cardinal squares of the trap, it triggers, dealing Fire physical damage to them. They may also be inflicted with Burn LV X (X= Rank * 10) for 3 rounds.

Traps become stronger every round they are active.

A hand-made trigger is something you use to detonate a trap from a longer range at will. Using this skill will do just that; cause all traps you have set to detonate automatically. Naturally, any enemies within range of the trap will be affected by it.

Targets 1 enemy within 6 Range and deals Fire magic damage to them, based on Rank, and has a chance to inflict Hesitation LV X (X = Rank*5, plus 10). If the enemy is weak to Fire, your Tactics Rank increases by 1 level.

Drop down into a position to take a more careful aim (Reactivate to cancel, refund 2M). While activate, you cannot move, but you gain +5 Hit, +2 Attack range with bow and gun weapon, and at the start of a new round, accelerate the cooldown of Special Armament by 1. Additionally, it increases the size or range of Cannon skills by 2, Great Accuracy, and applies their bonus effects even if they glance.

Ghosts, as in the spectres, do not typically carry a lot of weight in their appearance, so it is only fitting when Ghost duelists follow suit. Increases the base LV of Claret Call applications for each weapon and torso you have that is 5 Weight or less.

Gun skill. Shoot a stream of fire from your gun in a line, dealing Fire physical damage to all enemies hit, and melting all ice tiles in the path. Any enemies hit may also be Burned and/or Feared for 3 rounds (LV = Rank * 5).

Attacking a target from a vulnerable angle is quite beneficial, letting you hit them harder in softer spots. When attacking an enemy from the side or behind, you gain damage based on Rank. (Guns do not receive a damage bonus from Flank.) If the attack is from a Dagger weapon, you also ignore up to 6 Armor from the target.

Solblader Style skill (only 1 can be equipped, doesn't take up a skill pool slot). A spell and blade type of Solblading.

Passive: Soldier base class Offensive skills can use any weapon type. Soldier base class Offensive skills and weapon attack skills that target your Solsphere grant a stacking buff that reduces the Momentum cost of your next Mercalan domain spell by LV (max: 6). Holy Aura Bonus: +5 to all Elemental ATK and -15% FP cost for spells. Holy Aura Triggered: Recover 15 FP and deal protection-ignoring Light bonus magic damage to all enemies within 3 Range. The damage is equal to your Solblader level.

A true Soldier knows that there's more to combat than just hitting your opponent until they stop moving, even though that's a big part of it. You need to use tactics, use terrain and your non-weapon body parts to create openings to hit your opponent, because they sure aren't going to do it for you.

When you use Bash on an enemy, infict the enemy with LV1 Flatfoot (-5 evade -1 move) until the start of their next turn. If you are charge bashing, there is a 50% chance to knock them down instead.

Causes ghastly spirits to flee from every direction around you for up to 7 Range, dealing magic damage split between Wind and Dark. There is also a chance that enemies damaged will be Feared for 3 rounds.

A flowery style that cuts the opponent apart like rose thorns. When you successfully score a Critical Hit with a weapon for the first time in a round, you gain an additional +1 Momentum. (This effect can only trigger on a specific enemy once per round.)
An acrobatic shot that targets two locations. While moving toward location (2), you fire at location (1), performing a basic attack on any enemy on that location with a bonus to Hit (based on Rank).

Toggle skill. Evasive reaction skill (only one takes effect at a time).

While on, you will step one tile away from attackers you can see within X Range (X = Rank) who miss you with attacks. Upon triggering, you gain Voltiger LV X (or power up an existing status). Voltiger increases the Range of Sidecut and Sillcut by LV and increases the damage they deal by a percentage.

(Max: 25% bonus damage, 10 duration)

Dagger skill. Throw a barrage of daggers in a line, which will travel up to 3+Rank tiles away and inflict unresistable Piercing damage to the first enemy hit equal to Dagger Power + Rank. Can only be used once per turn.
Send out a pulse of focus that merges with your Runes. All your currently active Runes trigger their Resonate effects.

Can only be used if Eternal Flame is active. Focus the light of your lantern into an arcane beam at a target within Range, dealing damage to the target. The damage type is equal to the damage type of the Lantern's flame (Phoenix will deal Light damage.)

When firing a critical shot, it's important to be completely accurate. While the Magic Gunner has a Charged Shot prepared, they gain a bonus to Hit while attacking with a Gun. If they are Overcharged, the bonus is doubled.

Utilize sheer force to manipulate your enemies into making unwise moves. Inflicts Forced Move LV X (X = Rank) on all enemies within a circle until your next turn, reducing their Move by LV.

If you have invoked the Black Wind this round, all those enemies are also pushed back 1+X tiles. Otherwise, you invoke the Black Wind to draw them closer, pulling them 1+X tiles towards you.

Arcane skill. Targets 1 tile within 5 Range and deals Fire magic damage to any enemy, and destroys any plant field objects in that tile. Deals 10% bonus damage to Plant/Doriad race enemies.

Annorum: Effect is applied in a 5 Range circle instead, can inflict burn LV X (X = Rank * 10) for 3 rounds, and may stun Plant/Doriad enemies.
Can only be used while on a tile with a Nest or a plant on it, and can only target an unoccupied tile with the same conditions. You disappear into the brush and reappear at the target location.

Requires 2 Geomaterial. Targets 2 unoccupied tiles within 3 range, and use the Geomaterial to create 2 Pawn Automatons at those locations. Pawn Automatons are not particularly strong, but they do not suffer from normal Servant Automaton restrictions. Cannot be used if you already had 3 or more Servant Automatons active.

The shinobi is a shadow; a shape without form, ever changing and ever moving.

The Shinobi has 10% FP Efficency for any movement skill. They also passively gain 10% Status Resistance versus Immobilize, Frozen and Slow effects.
A life on the front-line offers some benefits, namely that you learn how to stay alive longer on them. Increases your maximum HP.

A spell that protects the target in a wrap of wind. The target gains Evade equal to X (Based on Rank) + 50% the caster's Scaled LUC. Lasts for 5 rounds. If used on a target that already has the effect, the effect will end, but all enemies with 4 Range will take Wind magic damage equal to Wind ATK + 3x the Evade bonus and be knocked back 1 square. The caster will also be refunded for the second cast's FP cost.

The discipline of the Fox teaches that knowledge can act as a wedge. While in Fox Stance, when you deal Ice damage, you gain a stacking status that grants +5 Ice ATK (up to +30) for 10 rounds. (This status loses 5 LV every round you are not in Fox Stance. When it reaches 0, it ends.)

Curse skill. Curse skills will apply a curse to yourself for 3 rounds, and while active, you will suffer the effects of the curse. However, if an enemy damages you while a Curse is active, it will transfer to them. (Once transferred, the curses remain on the victim and the duration is refreshed.) Credwa's frailty will cause the DEF and RES stats of the victim to decrease.

Dagger skill. Targets 1 Enemy or 1 Voidgate in Range.

Enemy: You slash the target wildly, dealing physical Slash damage. Their Phys. DEF is also reduced by 2*Rank for 3 rounds. If Veil Off is active, it also reduces Mag. Def by same amount.

Voidgate: The Voidgate becomes unstable, preventing teleportation, but causing it to release bolts of void energy (on activation and every round) which deal Dark magic damage. If you are in the path of a bolt, you will gain Void Energy equal to half its damage.
Is there anything better than getting something for free? Every round, recover 2 FP for every positive status effect you have that was caused by an enemy.

Arcane skill. Deals Ice magic damage to an enemy within 5 Range. It can also target a Rain Trap instead; doing so will apply this skill's damage & effects in its range, create ice sheets for 3 rounds, and destroy the trap.

Annorum: Inflicts Frozen LV X (X = Rank *75) for 3 rounds, and Heavy Frost for 2 rounds.

Heavy Frost

Your armor type is being treated as heavy armor, due to being covered in heavy chunks of ice.

Targets all tiles your party currently has formation tiles on. All enemies in those tiles take Ice magic damage that ignores evasion. For each enemy that is weak to Ice, your Tactics Rank increases by 1 level.

Targets 1 enemy within 6 Range, and creates a burst of static energy, dealing Lightning magic damage that can critically hit (+25% damage). If the target is hit and has a copiable effect, and an ally is within 3 Range of them, the lightning jolts to 1 of those allies randomly, dealing 25% of the damage as Kickback Damage, but they copy one of those effects (same duration, half LV).

If Mass is active, you can target 2 different tiles.

Targets a 2 Size Circle up to 5 Range away and charges the area with polarized electricity, while also planting a Fulgurbloom Sapling in the center (Druids only). +1 Size if Mass is active.

In that area; all units take 15 Lightning magic Kickback Damage, are cured of Knocked Down (and gain immunity if so), go Airborne, recover X FP (Rank x 15), cut the duration of Interference, and Elemental Pierce (Wind) LV X (Rank x 5, 3 rounds).

Growth Period: 3 Created by the Druid spell Fulgur of Flight. A magical plant that can grow from druidic magics.

The pollen of this plant manipulates electrical charges in the air it flows through, creating a deadly atmosphere of static.

HP: 20

Bloom: Creates Static Fields LV X (LV x 2, 2 rounds) at all tiles within 5 Range. (Deals armor-ignoring Lightning damage when created, stepped on, and at the start of a new round.)

On New Round: Creates Static Fields LV X (LV, 2 rounds) at all tiles within 2 Range.

Static Field tiles will only be created in tiles which do not already have them.

With the skill Druidic Tending, the plant gets the following bonuses:

Invigoration Tending - Effective LV is increased by 25%.

Quickness Tending - Effective Range is increased by 1

Toggle Skill. While on, the shinobi can gain elemental marks; Fire, Forest, Mountain, and Wind. A maximum of 4 total marks, and 2 of each type, can be accumulkated by utilizing various Shinobi skills. Once 4 marks have been acquired, an Elemental Art based on the combination of marks automatically activates (no marks can be gained during this round after).

Marks can be gained by casting spells gained via Scrolls; the type gained depends on the spell's domain.

Enchants yourself or a target party member with an elemental, increasing Earth ATK, RES and DEF, and causing all Earth damage to inflict Magnetize (LV = 1 + Rank*3) for 2 rounds. However, hosting an elemental also has its drawbacks; you take 1.25x Water damage while enchanted. This effect lasts for 3 rounds. You cannot cast this spell on a character already enchanted with an elemental.

Because of the circumstances, limitations, and available resources for any mission are wildly different, Shinobi are trained in the use of a variety of tools.

As such, item-based skills (such as bombs), most damaging skills give nby their equipment (except basic attacks), and Item Potentials gain a damage bonus when used by them. This bonus is also applied to the EXP gained towards Item Potentials.

A common type of dash used by close-range fighters. You dash in a 3-6 Range line that must end in an unoccupied tile. Only 1 Geist Schritt skill can be used per turn.

Drei style. The dash also attempts to scare your opponent; at the end of the turn, if you have not been targeted by an enemy at all, the follow-up dash activates, moving you towards the attacker, restoring 3 Momentum and increases your Schwarz Sturm level by 1.

A common type of dash used by close-range fighters. You dash in a 3-6 Range line that must end in an unoccupied tile. Only 1 Geist Schritt skill can be used per turn.

Eins style. The dash also attempts to bait out basic attack skills; if you are targeted by one, it is negated, and the follow-up dash activates, moving you towards the attacker, restoring 3 Momentum and increases your Schwarz Sturm level by 1.

A common type of dash used by close-range fighters. You dash in a 3-6 Range line that must end in an unoccupied tile. Only 1 Geist Schritt skill can be used per turn.

Zwei style. The dash also attempts to bait out non-basic attack skills; if you are targeted by one, it is negated, and the follow-up dash activates, moving you towards the attacker, restoring 3 Momentum and increases your Schwarz Sturm level by 1.

Fist skill. A sweeping tiger strike that cracks through an enemy's defenses. Performs a basic attack on the target with a bonus to damage equal to 2*Rank. If it hits, the target loses DEF and RES for the duration. This lasts for 3 rounds. If the attack is a critical hit, the status power and duration are increased by 1.5x.

Urawaza: Inflicts Fear and knocks back the target on a successful hit.

extras: No longer takes up a skill slot when equipped.
text.description: A pacifist's approach to lantern bearing. While toggled on, lantern activations will not deal damage or inflict status effects. Instead, all allies in the lantern's aura will gain immunity to the status it normally inflicts, if any, for 2 rounds. It will also reduce the FP cost of Lantern spells (except General domain ones) by 50%.
Can only target an allied unit within 2 Range of a plant field object. Releases natural healing energies from a nearby plant, healing the target's HP for 50 + X (X = the target's level * Rank)

Sends out a bubble of water as a projectile in a 7 Range line, which washes over enemies and allies alike. If it passes over an ally, all negative status effects the ally has are reduced by 1 round in duration. If it hits an enemy, they take Water magic damage, and the projectile will stop.

Targets a 2 Size Circle up to 5 Range away and creates an eroding quake. All enemies within that circle take Earth magic damage that can critically hit (+25% damage). Enemies that are hit suffer from Wear Down LV X, if critically hit they suffer from Lingering Damage (Earth) LV X instead. This lasts for 3 rounds. +1 size if Mass is active.

Trickery: All enemy-placed attackable field objects in the circle take 10 damage.

(Wear Down reduces armor by LV.)

Targets a 2 Size Circle in 5 Range and dries out the air in it, while also planting a Bristleblade Sapling in the center (Druids only). +1 Size of Mass is active.

The target area is subjected to an instantaneous Natural Drought.

Growth Period: 3 Created by the Druid spell Geo of Drought. A magical plant that can grow from druidic magics.

A hardy, leafless plant with extremely sharp branches. It is capable of thriving in environments other plants cannot.

HP: 20

Bloom: Deals X armor-ignoring Slash damage (LV x 10) to all enemies in 4 Range.

On New Round: Deals X armor-ignoring Slash damage (LV x 2) to all enemies in 2 Range.

Special: Aero Shift effects will sway the plant in place, applying its On New Round effect.

With the skill Druidic Tending, the plant gets the following bonuses:

Invigoration Tending - Effective LV is increased by 25%.

Quickness Tending - Effective Range is increased by 1.

This is a magical effect created by the Druid spell Geo of Drought.

Within that area, the duration of all water-based effects and tiles are cut, such as;

• Soaked

• Brine Blade

• Refreshing Flow

• Water Veil

• Dancing Tentacles, Dark Water, Flooded Water, etc.

This applies to all units and tiles. If you are a Monoclass Druid, your control of the magic is stronger; field tiles are affected the same, but only negative effects for allies and positive effects for enemies receive the duration cut.

Additionally, enemies within the drought suffer from Elemental Pierce (Fire) LV X (Rank x 5, 3 rounds), and if they're a water-based monster, they may be inflicted with Burn of the same LV and duration.

extras: Equipping this skill does not take up a SP slot.
text.description:
An enemy absorbing, reflecting, or being immune to your Fire, Dark, or Sound damage triggers the following effects for 2 Rounds (3 if Volume Up is active):

1) Disables absorb, reflect, and immunity for that element.

2) Inflicts Lingering Damage LV X (X = half of damage) of the same type, and Battle Rush LV 5.

3) Infliction-based chance to apply Confusion.

Sword skill. Attack an enemy in 1 range with a quick sword strike, then fake a follow up. Deals Slash physical damage to the target. If you have inflicted Fear on them, they may try to protect themselves from the fake hit, having the chance to inflict Guard LV 1 on them. The overall success rate is increased by the LV of you Claret Call the target has (if any).

Arcane skill. Fires a ghastly arrow which will pass through enemies for 3 tiles, before becoming tangible and traveling until it hits an enemy. An enemy hit by it takes Dark magic damage. If it passes over an allied Rain Trap, it will apply its damage & effects in its range, create delayed Dark Water tiles for 3 rounds, and destroy the trap. (Enemies can only be damaged once per skill use.)

Annorum: If the enemy hit is reduced to 0 HP, summons a Ghost ally.
A staff is a common symbol attributed to priests and bishops, and through it, they channel their holy power. Lets Staff weapons be used as casting tools for Mercalan domain spells.

Targets a 5 Size Line in front of you. You quickly dash through those tiles until you encounter an enemy in the tile you are facing. That enemy takes weapon-based damage and is knocked Airborne.

Holy Aura increases the amount of tiles you move by 2, and will cause the skill to check all tiles within 1 Range of you every step for an enemy, instead of just the tile you are facing. (Applies even if you gain Holy Aura mid-attack.)

A golden glow associated with legends. When using Power Up, if your Ki is increased to the upper limit of 30, you gain Golden Glow for 3 rounds. Golden Glow increases your Phys. and Mag. Def based on Rank.

Unleash a shockwave from your lantern, staggering all enemies within 3 Range and dealing Earth magic damage to them. All enemies damaged are also Magnetized for 2 rounds.

(Damage/Heal and Effect Power/Duration/Chance from Lantern Activations are more effective when close and less effective when far.)

Eternal Flame: DEF, RES
It turns out that building your machines out of things other than scrap makes them last longer. Boosts the maximum HP and FP of your Engineer bots by a percentage.

Dagger skill. Dig your dagger into an enemy within 1 Range, dealing unresistable Pierce damage equal to Rank + Weapon Power. Afterwards, if you are behind the target, they suffer -X (X = Rank) to all stats for 3 rounds. (If you are not behind them, they suffer half of that instead.)

Leave a mark your foes won't forget. Enemies damaged by Matador skills have their maximum HP reduced for X Rounds (based on Rank). This effect can stack infinitely, but maximum reduction per damage instance is capped at 50 (excluding Retaliate, which has no cap).

A powerful aesthetic surpassing magic.

When your Schwarz Sturm level is 4 or higher, you ignore resistance, immunity, absorb, and reflect for Blunt damage. (Does not affect Phys. or Magic Def, nor Armor).
It's a miracle you weren't hurt. When you evade a basic attack, you gain Grace of God for 3 rounds. When you Pray, Grace of God is consumed to guarantee it will activate a bonus effect.
Healing skill. Can only be used once per round. Holy energy envelops the target, curing wounds. Restores a target ally's HP.

Requires Parted Pain. Defeating a monster in melee range that was within Parted Pain's HP threshold restores 3M and resets Repeat Action for you, but your damage against monsters outside of Parted Pain's HP threshold is reduced by 30%.

If Heaven Below is active, triggering this effect increases it's active LV by 3.
The Grand Summoner earns their 'Grand' title, if for no other reason but numbers. Increases the number of active Youkai contracts you have by 1.

A sharp mind is a deadly weapon. Increases your Hit with Greatsword, Greataxe, and Greatlance weapons by half of your scaled GUI.

Additionally, your Tactician's class's Tactics Rank boosts the range of Black Knight projectiles and skills that can invoke the Black Wind to gain increased range (by half of its value). Furthermore, Tactics Rank cannot decrease due to taking damage during a turn your Parry skill triggered, or have invoked the Black Wind.

Finisher (resets Schwarz Sturm to 0 when used). The strongest punch a Boxer has. Deals Blunt damage to one enemy within 1 Range. If your Schwarz Sturm level is 8 or higher, an additional effect occurs:

If the target is a non-Player Character and non-boss, it is instantly reduced to 0 HP. If they are, they are knocked into the air and removed from the battle for 1 turn; afterwards, they land in the battle again, and take Blunt damage equal to half of the original damage.

Creates up to one impassable but attackable Gravestone at target location for 3 rounds. Enemies in that tile take Earth magic damage and are knocked airborne. Enemies within 3 range of a Gravestone take double bonus damage from Claret Call, and Wraiths within 3 range of a Gravestone take no damage from enemies.

Your invocations become powerful enough to channel the power of death itself. All spells you cast which require Invocations have their total damage (before resistances are applied) increased based on the Rank of this skill.

Gun skill. Fires a grenade, which functions like a mini-bomb, to target location within X Range (based on Rank). At the end of the round, it explodes, dealing Fire damage to all enemies within 3 Range. This bomb gains the effects of all skills that affect bombs, but only at 75% effectiveness.

Mimickry skill. Costs 1% of your maximum HP, and can only be used if you are Installed with a Youkai. You gain an appendage of your installed Youkai's race, which can give a variety of benefits, and extends all other effects from Grow Appendage by 1 round (2 if monoclassing). The effect's duration varies based on Rank.

If Bloody Shift was triggered this round, this skill costs 1 less Momentum to use.

extras: If you have a Tome equipped, the HP Recovery is increased by it's power, or 50% of Scaled GUI.
text.description: Tactical Order skill. Order allies to protect themselves this turn, granting them access to the Guard Skill. Allies who guard will recover HP based on Rank + Tactic Ranks.

Even one person can fight an army with the right strategy. Attacks made while you are in a Nest have increased critical (based on rank). If you have used the move skill in the same round while this skill's effect are activate. Critical chances have a chance to inflict confusion LV5 for 2 rounds.
Targets an ally within 2 Range that is suffering from a Blind status effect and fills them with light, curing the Blind. However, this skill cannot be used if you are Blinded yourself.

Special Arrows skill.

Gust Arrows increase the range of your Bow attacks and skills that use Special Arrows by Rank. Being enchanted by Talvyd will cause enemies hit by the arrows to be knocked back 1 tile from you.

Places a gust trap at an unoccupied square within 2 range for 10 turns. If an enemy walks within 2 cardinal squares of the trap, it triggers, deals Wind physical damage, causes the triggerer to stop their movement, and knocks them away from the trap 1 square. They may also be inflicted with a Poison LV X (X = Rank * 5) for 3 rounds.

Traps become stronger every round they are active.

Kenpo. Become airborne and burst forward in a 4 Size line (+1 under Shukuchi), using your knee, spear or shuriken as a bird's beak. The first enemy you encounter takes weapon-based damage. If that enemy was Airborne, they can be critically hit and are inflicted with Spinning (as an Airborne substatus). Otherwise, they are knocked Airborne.

One of the shinobi's hidden arts. Using hand signs and ki, the Shinobi can sidestep the need for verbal components. As long as they aren't immobilized and have at least 40 CEL, they can cast Spells (excluding invocations) and Ninjutsu even while Silenced.

Additionally, Shinobi can utilize fist weapons as casting tools.

Can only target an enemy with no adjacent allied units. Exploit your target's lack of protection, performing a basic attack with a bonus to Hit. (This bonus is higher the further away you were from the enemy.)

If you have invoked the Black Wind this round, gains +15% Critical Damage for the attack. Otherwise, invokes the Black Wind to change skill Range and teleports you near the target.
The warmth of your lantern creates a protective barrier around you. While Eternal Flame is active, you gain X% (based on Rank) resistance to the element of the last lantern flame you invoked.

Dark Bard Song skill. The hardest of notes leaves the deepest impression. In a size 6 Circle around you; destroys Ice Sheets, deals Sound magic damage (allies take Kickback damage), and breaks Invocations (of allies and enemies).

The discipline of the Hare teaches that not every battle is worth fighting. While in Hare Stance, when you deal Ice damage, you gain a stacking status that grants +5 Evade (up to +30) for 10 rounds. (This status loses 5 LV every round you are not in Hare Stance. When it reaches 0, it ends.)

Resonate: All allies in X range gain +2 Move for 1 round.

Engrave: Target Ally gains + Rank Move until your next turn.

Linked Runes that deal damage are given Great Accuracy.

Disappear into the mist and reappear at target empty square. Any enemies you have marked with Claret Call within 1 Range of that location are Feared for the duration. Lasts 2 rounds.

If Rising Game level is 3 or higher, the cooldown of this skill is reduced by 1 round.

extras: Equipping this skill does not take up a Skill Pool slot.
text.description: Sustained by the power of the Aquae Crest, the Aquamancer's healing is accelerated. At the start of battle, grants a permanent (but dispellable) buff that grants HP Regeneration equal to Aquae Crest LV.

Releases a pulse of healing energy, healing yourself and all allies within a 3 Range circle. If you have only one Bonded Youkai, they will receive the effects of the skill while summoned regardless of where they are on the battlefield.

Requires Parted Pain. At the start of every round, grants or increases Heaven Below at LV2 (max 10). LV decreases by 1 upon taking non-bonus non-status, non-field effect damage. Increases damage against enemies within Parted Pain's threshold by LV * 2%, and upon defeating them, restores LV * 5 FP, and heals all summoned Bonded Youkai's HP and FP for that same amount. Every enemy you defeat that procs this effect increases the maximum level by 10. If you end the battle with a maximum level of 30 or more, all allies gain 10% bonus EXP and 10% drop rate boost.

Fist skill. Launch yourself into the air and fall down onto the target enemy, dealing more damage the further away they are. The Range of this skill is equal to your Move.

Urawaza: Enemies within 5 Range of the target are also affected by this skill as if targeted normally.

By utilizing the increased bulk of their weapon, the Arbalest can fire shots harder than anybody else. Increases your Power with Bow weapons that have at least 20 Weight based on rank. They also have reduced Battle Weight equal to this skill's Rank.

Just run at them. That'll be a surprise. Targets 1 enemy within 1 range, and ram your shoulder into them, causing them to take Blunt physical damage equal to your battle weight, plus a bonus (based on rank). They are also knocked back by 1 tile for every 15 battle weight, and if they are knocked back +3 tiles, they trip and become knocked down. (This knockback ignores immunity effect.)

You're not a fan of big, rocky monsters. Maybe you're just an artist. Maybe you want to surround yourself with something soft and sweet. Changes your Servant Automatons into Sweet Automatons. Target 2 tiles within 6 range. One must have your sweet Automaton, and one must be monster enemy with Sweet Seduction LV5+. Attempt to convert Enemy (Sweet) it to your side; if successful, they are served a slice of Selected Automaton.

When a Bonded Youkai deals damage to an enemy, you inflict Hell Above on that target for 3 rounds. When an enemy with Hell Above takes damage from you, the status is consumed and deals protection-ignoring Akashic damage to the target equal to 5% of the damage dealt. (If you have only one Bonded Youkai, it does 10% instead.)

Instrument skill. Take a swing at an enemy within 1 Range with your instrument, with greatly increased Critical Damage. If it hits, all other units within a 3 Range Circle take Sound magic damage (allies take Kickback Damage), and enemies may be inflicted with Hesitation LV X (X = Rank * 5) for 3 rounds, as that probably really hurt.

Hex skill. Hex skills can only target those with a specific status effect, and it will then reset the duration of the status effect (based on Rank; the duration of the Hex is the same) and inflict a Hex on the target. Uorate's wrath will prevent the target's Burn from being cured, and cause it to nullify bonus RES the target has.

Sometimes your enemies don't realize they've been cut until after you put your sword away. When you use Sheath Sword, all enemies you have attacked and hit with a Katana-type Sword, or used a Kensei Sword skill on this turn take Slash damage that ignores armor, based on Rank.

Temporarily accelerate your spellcasting abilities, letting you utilize invocations at a much faster speed than normal. For 3 rounds, when casting an Invocation spell from a Mage class, the Momentum cost is 3M, regardless of if the spell is being invoked or casted.
Causes lightning to behave more aggressively, increasing your Critical rate if it is triggered by a lightning effect (such as Redgull Elemental Impacts, or Ryemei).

Kensei Combo Skill. Stab your target and run with them in a line, carrying them with you. Run forward, dealing pierce Physical damage to the first enemy you hit, pushing them along until you reach the end of the line. If the sword you are using is a Katana-type, the Momentum cost is reduced by 1. The size of the line can be changed using the +/- keys.

Sacred Art Effect: Fire physical damage.

Combo Effect: Skewer the target several times, inflicting Fray LV X (X = Rank * 3) on them until your next turn, before damage is dealt.
Launches an arrow of divine light in a 4-8 Range line, dealing magic Light damage to the first enemy hit. Bows are also treated as valid casting tools for this spell.

Requires 2 Solcharges. Targets 1 allied unit within 5 Range.

Utilize the magic of the Solcharges to manifest or enchant a shield of light around the target's arm, giving them the radiance of a Holy Shield for 5 rounds.
Targets a 2 Range circle up to 7 Range away from the caster and deals magic damage to all enemies within it. The damage is split evenly between Light and Lightning.

Requires 2 Solcharges. Targets 1 allied unit within 5 Range.

Utilize the magic of the Solcharges to bless the target's weapon, giving them the divinity of a Holy Sword for 5 rounds.

Requires 2 Solcharges. Targets 1 allied unit within 5 Range.

Utilize the magic of the Solcharges to manifest or develop angelic feathers, giving them the splendor of Holy Wings for 5 rounds.
A mastery-type skill that shows affinity with hitting your mark. Increases SKI passively. If at max Rank, SKI is further increased by +1.

Requires you to have Final Flare active. Unequips your dagger and tosses it to a nearby location up to X (based on Rank) Range away. At the start of the next round, it will explode, treating all units (friend or foe) as if they were hit by Final Flare (however spells cast do only 50% damage instead of 75%). Enemies who step onto the same location as the dagger will kick it 5 tiles away in the direction they are moving.

Kenpo. An unrelenting flash of swift attacks on an enemy within 1 Range, dealing your wepano's damage type over a barrage of 8 hits. If any hit, the target is inflicted with Critical Evade Down LV X (X = Hits x 2) until your next turn.

Special Arrows skill.

Ice Arrows deal Ice damage equal to Rank + (5*Rank)% of your Ice ATK, and cover tiles arrows launched by basic attacks and skills that use Special Arrows in Ice Sheets for 3 rounds. Being enchanted with Kraken also gives a chance to inflict Frostbite LV X for 3 rounds.

A fairy made of ice floats near yourself or target ally, increasing their SKI. It will also lower their next instance of Fire damage taken by 50%. Also grants a special skill called Fairy Fall that uses up the buff to destroy a circle of Cinders up to 6 Range away.

Create an Ice Point (3 rounds) at target location in 4 Range. Enemies at that location are pushed back away from it and take Ice magic damage equal to your Ice ATK. Afterwards, all tiles within 1 Range are covered in Ice Sheets (3 rounds).

If there is already an Ice Sheet at that location and no enemy is hit, Ice Sheets spawn in 3 Range instead and 2 Momentum is refunded.

Targets an Ice Point within 5 Range, leaps to it, and turns it into a pair of icey boots (5 rounds). For the duration, the user does not trigger Ice Sheets, leaves behind Ice Sheets for 2 rounds while moving, and deals bonus Ice magic damage (50% of Ice ATK) that ignores armor (based on Rank) when using a Verglas skill that kicks, or the Kick maneuver.

Targets an Ice Point or Ice Point Guard within 5 Range and turns it into a shield of ice, granting several bonuses (5 rounds):

*30+(Scaled SKI/2)% chance to parry martial weapon attacks/skills (30% reduction).

*Can use Guard.

*Can enhance certain Verglas skills.

*Using this skill while you have 4 Momentum or less grants Guard LV 30 for 1 round.

Must target an ice sheet in 1 Range. You then skate along the ice, stopping only when you fail to move or encounter a tile without an ice sheet on it, knocking aside all battle participants in your way, friend or foe. If you have skated for at least X (based on Rank) tiles, enemies knocked away will also be knocked down.

Dance skill. Dash along the ground like a figure skater with chilling grace. You target an unoccupied tile within 4 Range and move in a line to it. Every time you move across a tile, you deal Ice magic damage (based on your Ice ATK and Rank) to a random enemy within 2 range. Enemies hit multiple times take 50% damage from additional hits.

Places an ice trap at an unoccupied square within 2 range for 10 rounds. If an enemy walks within 2 cardinal squares of the trap, it triggers, which will cause all tiles in its Range to be covered in Ice Sheets for 3 rounds, as well as dealing Ice Physical damage to the one who triggered it. They may also be inflicted with Frostbite LV X (X = Rank * 10) for 3 rounds.

Traps become stronger every round they are active.

Fox Discipline technique. Targets 2 locations; Location 1 must contain an Ice Point or Ice Point Guard (or you with IPG active), Location 2 must be 1 tile adjacent to that location.

Transform the target Ice Point into a spear of ice that travels up to 5 tiles (tiles with Ice Sheets do not count), dealing Ice magic damage to all enemies it encounters and may inflict Frostbite LV25 for 3 rounds.

If the target is an Ice Point Guard, travels infinitely, the skill's damage is increased by 50%, but stops upon hitting one enemy, and inflicts them with Frozen LV 200 for one round.

Dance skill. A simple but invigorating dance that affects all allies and enemies within 5 Range. Affected units may be inflicted with Charm LV X and are given Battle Rush LV X (based on Rank) for 3 rounds each. You will step X times (X = Rank) in place, and each time you do, you will heal a random ally and deal Light magic damage to a random enemy within 5 Range (based on Rank). If a specific enemy or ally is hit multiple times, the effectiveness is reduced by 50%.

Consumes 10 Void Energy to use. Targets 1 summoned ally (Youkai, mechs, etc) within 5 Range. For 5 rounds, the target's basic attacks, on hit, will deal Dark magic damage equal to a percentage of your Dark ATK. However, they will also lose HP equal to 15% of their maximum HP every round.

Absorb the power from the nearby elements. At the start of a new round, gain +X Scaled Weapon Power for 1 round, where X is the number of a specific special effect tile in a certain Range around you. The special effect tile depends on your enchanted element, which defaults to Fire if none are present. (Fire = Cinder, Ice = Ice Sheet, Earth = Plants, Wind = Air Shaft, Lightning = Light Shaft)

Resonate: Attempts to inflict all enemies within effective range (+1) with Glowing LV X for two rounds.(X = Rank * Rune Level)

Engrave: Attempts to inflict the target with Glowing LV X for 2 rounds. (X = Rank * 5)

Trigger: Attempts to inflict Glowing LV X on all enemies in effective range for Y rounds. (X = same as Resonate LV, Y = higher of 3 or 1 + half the rune level)

The light of divinity grants not only the sureness of one's steps, but the clarity of one's mind.

Passively increases FAI and GUI, based on Rank. If you are monoclassing Solblader, you start battles with Solcharges equal to Rank.

Hex skill. Hex skills can only target those with a specific status effect, and it will then reset the duration of the status effect (based on Rank; the duration of the Hex is the same) and inflict a Hex on the target. Imagin will cause a sense of overwhelming despair in the target, preventing Fear from being cured and increasing all damage the victim takes by 10%.

extras: No longer takes up a skill slot when equipped
text.description: Lantern Bearers can cause strikes they make to hold the power of their lantern. Basic attacks with Spear weapons will, while this skill is toggled on, change their damage type to your currently active Eternal Flame's damage type.

extras: When you summon a youkai, you cause enemies within 2 Range of that space to be knocked back 1/2/3 square(s)
text.description: Creates a gust of wind when you summon a Youkai, causing enemies within 2 Range of that space to be knocked back X squares, based on Rank.

extras: When you unsummon a Youkai manually, it creates an elemental explosion that damages enemies within 1/2/3 Range for damage equal to the Youkai's level. The damage type varies based on the Youkai
text.description: When you unsummon a Youkai manually, it creates an elemental explosion that damages enemies within X Range (based on Rank) for damage equal to the Youkai's level. The damage type varies based on the Youkai, and has Great Accuracy.

Grab something, anything to use as a weapon from nearby, replacing your main weapon with a random object (Rock, Glass Shard, or Pointy Stick) from nearby, for 2+Rank rounds. This weapon does not count as a specific weapon type, and it always has 5 Power, 85 Accuracy, and 10 Critical. It's better than having a broken weapon, for sure, and you can always throw it away when you don't need it (during your turn).'

Use the power of the void to boost your magic. Upon taking Fire, Ice, Wind, Lightning, or Earth damage, gain Impure Element of the same element. Impure Element increases your Elemental ATK of that element by 10 (if monoclassing Void Assassin, by your Void Energy instead). However, using any skill that uses that Elemental ATK causes you to take damage equal to half of that amount. (Taking damage will reset the status to a new element.)

Sword or Dagger skill. Targets 1 enemy within 1 Range and deals Pierce physical damage to them, as well as inflicting Lingering Pierce Damage LV X (based on Rank) for 2 rounds. Daggers deal only 80% normal damage, but use 1 less Momentum, and cause the Lingering Damage's LV and duration to be increased by 50%.

If the target of this skill already has Lingering Pierce Damage, its duration will be reset and its LV will be increased by only 25% of the normal value.

Hiding yourself is a pretty useful thing to do in the midst of monsters. Monsters in battle will treat you as a low priority target, making them more likely to attack and approach your allies, summons, or associates.

An unrelenting will that numbs pain. If you are wearing Heavy Armor with 10 or more Weight: Reduces physical damage taken and your total Battle Weight by 1+(Rank*3)% (10% at max rank). Against enemies that you have inflicted with Fear, the reduction is doubled.

Axe skill. Elemental compatible. Targets a 3 Range line, summons the first alive and unsummoned Bonded Youkai available, and sends it along that line. If the Youkai encounters an enemy along its path, it will stop, deal damage (type based on Youkai) to them. If you have only one Bonded Youkai, the Youkai will also perform a basic attack on that target.

Grants access to Install summons. The cost of an install is equal to twice the cost of summoning the youkai and lasts 2 rounds ( +1 for Mechanations). Installed Youkai cannot be summoned, but the following happens: * Your race's base stats are replaced with the Youkai's racial base stats, excluding FAI, SAN, and APT. * You gain access to all of that Youkai's skills.. * Affinity statistical boosts are effective for you (max +1). Some Youkai may have special skills that apply if they're installed.
Natural affinity with your Youkai increases your elemental powers. When installed with a Youkai, increases the Elemental ATK of the element associated with that Youkai by X (based on Rank).

Targets 1 ally within 3 Range and protects them from the harshness of the cold, increasing their Ice Resistance (based on rank) for 3 rounds. For the same duration, they do not trigger any Ice Sheets by walking on them. It will also cure Frostbite and provide immunity to it for the duration.

This skill requires a Rank D Invocation (see the Invocation talent for more details).

Targets 1 enemy within 6 Range and rapidly freezes the air around them, dealing Ice magic damage. The target also gains a 50% Weakness to Ice for 3 rounds. If enchanted with Kraken, the target is also inflicted with Frostbite LV (20+ 10 * Rank) for 3 rounds.

"Be scarred by this arctic claw's embrace..."

Shell: 3 x S.P. FP Reduction. Bonus: If target is a summoned unit, unsummons them. Otherwise, inflicts Spelldaze/1 round. High Charge: Within 4 Range: Unsummons summoned enemy units. Breaks enemy invocations. Inflicts Interference for X rounds (50% of HP). Can inflict Stun on Machines, Mechanations, Dullahans, and Liches.
Fills a target ally with a powerful confidence, increasing their STR and WIL for the duration. Lasts 3 rounds.

Illusion skill. Wraps yours or an ally's weapon(s) in mystery, making them almost completely transparent. While under this effect, the target's weapon's identity will be hidden. Targets attacked by invisible weapons have reduced Evade based on Rank (if they have Blind Fighting, the effect is halved).

Perform hand signs rapidly a number of times equal to Rank (up to a max of 4 - current elemental marks), gaining an elemental mark of your choice each time, and gaining Enhanced Art (1 round). Afterwards, if you have 4 elemental marks, you will invoke an Elemental Art.

If you have a Lossened Body, this skill costs 1M less.
Matador stance. Prepare yourself to weather the worst, raising your arms to defend yourself; this skill behaves just like the Guard skill normally does, but does not require a Shield.
A master of defense can fend off attacks no matter what the condition. Passively increases your DEF. If at max Rank, further increases DEF by +1.

extras: Can be enhanced with weapon charges.
text.description:
Targets a 2 size circle around the user and deals Earth Magic damage to all enemies inside of it; Enemies within 1 range of the center take bonus damage. All enemies magnetized by the users are drawn one square toward the center before damage is dealt. If enchanted with Galren, the magnetization is stronger, pulling enemies in 3 squares, and increases the area of effect by 2 tiles.

This spell can be enhanced with the usage of weapon charges.

This skill requires a Rank D Invocation (see the Invocation talent for more details).

Raises sharp stones in a 6 Range Circle around yourself, dealing Earth magic damage. Airborne enemies within 3 range that are also magnetized by the user are slammed into the ground taking +(Rank*5)% damage, become knocked down, and the Damage has Great accuracy.

If enchanted with Galren, all enemies Magnetized by the user are drawn in 3 tiles prior to damage.

"Rage and pierce, spears of earth..."

Engulf an enemy within 6 Range in a strong spinning water torrent, dealing Water magic damage and knocking them back by 1 tile.

Aquae Crest: If LV 3 or higher, the knockback is increased to 3 tiles.
Fire up a jetpack stored somewhere on you, quickly launching yourself to a tile within a certain Range away.

extras: If the target is a Youkai, or installed with one, the damage is increased by Rank*5%.
text.description: Cut your target with a dimensional blade. Deals Slash magical damage to target enemy within 3 Range. If the target is a Youkai, or installed with one, the damage is increased by Rank*5%. Additionally, if the target is a summoned unit, the damage is increased by Rank*5% (stacks additively if both conditions met).
Everything becomes new again when you do it in the air. Once per Round, using Leaping Lizard will reset Repeat Action tracking, as well as remove Combination Fighter.

Consumes Ki, up to a max, and unleashes a ball of it that travels up to X (5+1 per 5 Ki) Range away. ON hit, it deals Light magic damage (+Ki consumed% bonus damage). Gains bonus effects if it consumes enough Ki.

10 Ki: Grows in size, hitting a wider area. Pierces enemies instead of being destroyed. (3 tile width)

20 Ki: Explodes when the projectile ends, dealing 75% of its damage to enemies who weren't hit within 3 Range.

30 Ki: Inflicts Knockdown.

If Ki Awoken is active, this skill will not consume any Ki.

Genpo skill. You manipulate your shadow and create a Kagebunshin at your current location, gain Sneak (2 rounds), and then swiftly dash towards another unoccupied tile within 5 range in a flexible line.

Kagebunshin: Kagebunshin are shadow clones of the user. They are illusion units, but do not receive turns, and will fade away at the start of the cloned unit's next turn (unless otherwise stated). Primarily, they are used as decoys.

If an enemy within 2 Range of a Kagebunshin defeats it, and you have the Evasive Strike skill equipped, that enemy will receive its damage.

Kensei Combo Skill. Dash forward in a 3-5 Size line, and slash all around you faster than the eye can see, dealing Slash damage. If the sword you are using is a Katana type, the Momentum cost is reduced by 1.

If Voltiger is available, it can be consumed to change the pattern into flexible line.

Sacred Art Effect: Darkness physical damage.
