Combo Effect: Ignores evasion. After the dash, you turn around towards the way you came.

When you attack an enemy unit and trigger a counter-attack skill (such as Riposte) while the tile behind them is unoccupied, if 4 Magical Feathers are available, they are consumed. You then create an elemental copy of yourself at your current location, which takes the attack in your place and explodes, dealing elemental magic damage equal to 100% of your elemental ATK to all enemies in 2 Range of that location. Meanwhile, you appear behind your opponent and create an Air Shaft there for 3 rounds. (Element effect is based on your current elemental enchant, or Fire if none.)

Ninjutsu. Requires you to be standing on a Flooded Water or Dark Water tile, and targets 1 ally within 5 Range. This ninjutsu will conver all of those tiles within 2 Range around you into a healing aura, restoring the targets' HP by (Rank x 25) + (Rank x tiles absorbed), and grants them HP Regeneration LV X (X = 10 x tiles absorbed, 2 rounds).

Furinkazan: Gain 1 Forest Mark.

Ninjutsu. Focus your ki into your arms and swipe in a direction, creating a piercing projectile of sharp dust that travels 5 steps away (+1 per 25 Wind ATK, max 7). Enemies the projectile passes over take magic damage (weapon based + Earth). Empty tiles the projectile passes over will spawn attackable Rock Pillars (2 Rounds).

Furinkazan: Gain 1 Mountain Mark

Needless to say, Kensei are masters of the katana. Increases your Power with Katana-type weapons.

At the start of battle, If you only have a Katana Weapon(s) equipped, You gain a permanent status that boosts the power of your Katana Weapons, Touki, Sakki, and Kenki. This boost is lost if you swap weapons.
Release a jet of water around one target enemy within 4 Range, dealing Water magic damage to them.

Kenki is an aggressive type of spiritual energy that most Kensei possess. It is used offensively, projected towards enemies, to try and intimidate them, or trick them by confusing it with Touki or Sakki. When applied by Sharenzan or Wazabane, it reduces the target's Hit versus you for 3 rounds.

The shinobi is a master of unarmed combat, capable of flowing one blow into another like droplets of rain forming a stream.

Allows your Shinobi class Knepo skills, and Martial Artist base class Offensive skills to build and utilize Combination Fighter.

Must be Airborne. Dive in a line towards a target location, dealing damage to all enemies you encounter, before landing. If 10 Magical Feathers are available, consumes them and wraps you in an Elemental Kestrel for the duration of the skill, which has a variety of effects.

This is a bonus effect gained by Kestrel Dive for consuming a certain amount of Magical Feathers. It bestows the following benefits to the skill, based on your current elemental (or Fire, if none):

Once the flight ends, the Elemental Kestrel explodes in a 2 Range Circle around you, applying the skill's damage to all enemies in that radius, and creating field tiles based on your elemental for 2 rounds, with a LV equal to half of your Magical Feather LV.

Enemies can only be affected by this skill once per use, even if it misses.
Ideally, one shot, one kill. Aiming for vital points helps too. It's all about hitting that key shot.

A dangerous skill that boosts Ki Generation and the user's own capabilities by combining their bodies with the Ki itself. Increases all statistics (except VIT) and generates Ki by Rank every round. However, this comes at a risk; it drains HP every subsequent round, starting at 5% of max HP and doubling every round after that (but will never reduce you below 1 HP) while active.

Activate this skill again to end the effect before it's too late (Momentum will be refunded for the second use).

Concentrate your Ki into a small projectile blast. Uses 5 Ki. Targets 1 enemy within 6 Range and performs a basic attack on them with your Fist weapon, which deals magic damage. If Ki Awoken is active, the damage is increased by 15% and is done over 3 hits.

Dance skill. Play your instrument while you hop forward, kicking your foot outwards. Every time you move, you deal Sound damage to a random enemy within 2 Range. Stops upon encountering an occupied or dense tile - if an enemy is in that tile, you apply the Kick skill to them automatically.

Trickery - You play the first Bard Song skill you have equipped automatically for free.

Sometimes you want to be gentle. Sometimes not.

When toggled on, damage you deal will not bring enemies below 1 HP.

Ninjutsu. Targets 1 tile containing a non-dense plant and teleports to it, then cloak yourself in ki-fueled camouflage, blending in with your surroundings, giving yourself Kiomite Moriomizu (LV X, 3 rounds, +1 per 25 Earth ATK, max 5 rounds).

Furinkazan: Gain 1 Mountain Mark.
Knocking you down just gives you an opportunity to flip yourself back to your feet. Reduces the Momentum needed to get up from a Knocked Down status effect. Kip Up has no effect in Heavy Armor.

Black Knights have a reputation for being intimidating figures, even saying to give those who know no fear a taste of it. You can inflict Fear on enemies who are normally immune to it (excluding Boss monsters). In addition, defeating a unit will attempt to inflict Fear on all other enemies for 3 Rounds.

Main Class only.

extras: This skill does not take up a Skill Pool slot.
text.description: Block blows with your forearms, letting your enemies know you mean business. While you are in Matador Stance, you gain a chance to parry monster weapons & non-ranged weapons (skills & attacks, excluding spells) (as long as you are facing the attacker). (25% + half of Scaled DEF chance to activate, 50% damage reduction.) Successful activation generates 15 Rage Energy.

text.powerRaw: 100%/110%/120% Fire ATK, 100% Scaled WPN ATK, LV: 4/7/10
text.description:
Ninjutsu. Conjure ki explosions near all enemies in a 3 Size Diamond (+1 Size per 25 Light ATK, max 5). They explode in a bright flash, dealing Fire magic damage and may inflict Glowing (LV X, 2 rounds). After, shadows of those enemies dance and attack enemies not hit by the fire (in skill Range around them), dealing Dark magic damage and may inflict Blind (2 Rounds).

Furinkazan: Gain 1 Fire Mark.
A strong forward charging punch in an adjustable X Range line (X = 1 + Schwarz Sturm level) that must end in an empty square. All enemies in the line take Blunt damage and are knocked airborne.
The storm only gets worse if you anger it. When you evade a basic attack, your Schwarz Sturm level raises by 1.

For the god, see Kraken (God).

Enchants yourself or a target party member with an elemental, increasing Ice ATK, DEF and SKI. However, hosting an elemental also has its drawbacks; you take 1.25x Wind damage while enchanted. This effect lasts for 3 rounds. You cannot cast this spell on a character already enchanted with an elemental.

Sword skill. Attack your target with a dark slash, putting the fear of the grave into them. Performs a basic attack on the target which deals Dark physical damage. If successful, they are also Feared for 2 rounds (3 on a Critical Hit). (Enemies suffer -30 Hit if attacking an enemy that they Fear.)

Performer Song skill. Adieu, bonsoir, farewell!

Targets 1 Converted Enemy within 5 Range. Play your instrument, filling them with magic energy, until they burst, dealing massive elemental magic damage that ignores evasion based on your Starsign (Fire by default; Elemental ATK scaling is based on your Starsign) in a 5 Size Circle around them. As you might expect, your new 'friend' won't live through the experience, reducing their HP to 0 afterwards.

Spear skill. An extremely powerful single strike that is unavoidable. Deals physical Pierce damage to all enemies in a 3x3 grid (directly in front of you), but requires an extreme amount of focus, both mentally and literally. If the target is Guarding, they will be Guard Broken before damage is taken, and Evasion cannot be triggered. Cannot be used during the same turn as basic Movement.

extras: This skill does not take up a Skill Pool slot.
text.description: As a last ditch effort, the Ghost can absorb the Claret Calls from their attackers, leaving them one step above actually being dead. When the Ghost takes damage that leaves them at 0 HP or less from an enemy that is marked by the user's Claret Call, they instead remain at 1 HP. However, the attacker has their Claret Call marking removed, and cannot be remarked for 3 rounds.

extras: Affected enemies are also Knocked Down.
text.description: Drawing in such powerful arcane energies causes your invocations to release wind from the demon realm around you. When you begin casting an Invocation spell, enemies with 2 Range are knocked back X tiles (based on Rank).

Desperado stance. All enemies within a 3 Range circle are hit with a shower of projectiles, dealing damage based on your Gun's weapon damage type and applying on-hit effects to each of them once. If you are Airborne, the circle's size is doubled.

Cobra Stance. You spring into the air quickly, causing you to become Airborne.

Being within 1 Range of an enemy reduces the Momentum cost of this skill to 0.

Freeze a sword made of ice at target location and launch it in a line, dealing Ice magic damage to the first enemy hit. Each tile passed over will also be covered in an Ice Sheet that lasts for up to 3 rounds. If enchanted with Kraken, the enemy hit with this spell will suffer from Guard Break (if guarding) before damage is applied.

Excel Crash: Level 1 - 10% Damage per Charge level. Level 2 - Upon hitting an enemy, the sword dances to all other enemies within 3 range circle around the target, dealing slash and Ice damage to them using the spell's normal power. Level 3 - Ignore Evasion.

Airborne compatible. Spears can be used as casting tools. Slam your spear into the ground and create a magical burst of elemental energy, which deals elemental damage (based on element enchant - Fire by default) to all enemies in a 2 Range circle around you, knocking them airborne. If 5 Magical Feathers are available, they're consumed and all tiles in the area are covered by magical feathers, and the damage ignores evasion.
You can float through the air as if you were your namesake. Using Movement while you are Airborne and have at least 10 Magical Feathers available will change it to flight movement.

Targets an unoccupied tile within 5 Range. Rise like the sun, flying towards the target tile, then slam a hammer of light into the ground, causing all enemies within 1 Range to take Blunt/Light damage.

Airborne enemies may be inflicted with Knocked Down. Otherwise, they are knocked Airborne.

If you have Holy Aura, airborne enemies are always Knocked Down, and their Light Resistance is lowered by 15% for 2 Rounds.

Fist skill. Use your leg strength to quickly flip yourself into a quick kick at an enemy in 1 Range, dealing Blunt physical damage. Having a low weight Torso equipped will increase the damage. If you use this skill while Airborne, the maximum potential damage is doubled as you drop down on your enemy, ending your Airborne status.

Urawaza: Rank*20% chance to inflict Guard Break on guarding enemies.

It's so much easier to perform when your hands are as empty as your mind. When you only have 1 weapon equipped, and that weapon is an Instrument, FP costs for Bard base class skills are reduced by 10%

Targets all allies within a 5 Range circle around you (including yourself) and encourages them, filling them with inspiration and confidence, and more willing to shoulder burdens. Boosts affected unit's maximum Battle Weight by LV*5, Move by 1, and CEL by LV, for 5 rounds.

Given your flexibility, you're more than capable of ducking under something when necessary. If an enemy projectile would hit you, there is a chance (based on Scaled CEL and Rank) that you will duck under it, and it will pass over you as if it didn't hit you. (Only applies to projectiles created by skills, not projectile basic attacks.)

Targets 1 tile within 5 Range and plants a Listblume Sapling at it. If Mass is Active, you can target 2 tiles.

Growth Period: 3

Created by the Druid skill Listblume. A magical plant that can grow from druidic magics.

The fragrance of this plant's flower is said to lead animals to it. Once enchanted, the plant's pollen drives them to kill other animals attracted to the Listblume, where the remains feed its rooted soil with nutrients.

HP: 20

Bloom: All enemies within 5 Range are inflicted with Charm LV X (X = LV, 3 rounds) and perform their main hand weapon's basic attack skill on one of your enemies within 3 Range of them (or themself, if none) for 50% damage. Bosses will resist the compulsion to attack themselves.

On New Round: Attempts to inflict enemies within 3 Range with Charm LV X (X = LV, 3 rounds).

With the skill Druidic Tending, the plant gets the following bonuses:

Invigoration Tending - Effective LV is increased by 25%.

Quickness Tending - Effective Range is increased by 1.

Hex Skill. Hex Skill can only target those with a specific status effect, and it will then reset the duration of the status effect (based on Rank; the duration of the Hex is the same) and inflict a Hex on the target. Llunel will decay the target mentally, preventing Interference from being cured and instead causing it to reverse the effects of regeneration that the target has.

You work better alone, and so does your animal companion. But you work better alone together.

While you have only one Animal Companion skill in your Skill Pool, the CD of its skills (including Calls) are reduced by 1 round (min. 1). Furthermore, when it is summoned, the Animal Companion's level is increased by 10.

extras: Does not take up a SP slot.
text.description: The chain used to secure your Special Armament is a bit longer than the standard. Increases the range/size (where applicable) for chained skills by 1, but also increases your battleweight by 10, as it's a bit heavier.
Drawing your string takes more effort, but allows you to increase the Range of your Bow basic attacks by 4 for 1 turn.

Treating an illness is important, but it's also just as important to prevent it from happening again. When you use a Treatment skill on an ally (except yourself), they also become immune to the status type(s) it cures for X rounds (X = Rank). At Rank 5, when you use a Treatment skill on an ally or yourself, you also become immune to the same status type(s) for half the normal duration (rounded down).

Shell: Increases LUC by 1 x S.P. for 1 x S.P. rounds. Can stack up to LV 1000. Bonus: You may negate damage at (Lucky Shell LV)% chance for Bonus Power rounds. High Charge: Steals target's LUC equal to current LUC bonus for High Power rounds, then inflicts Pierce damage equal to your LUC. Cannot affect same target for High Power rounds.

Focus light into your casting tool and release it in an arc-shaped projectile, which travels in a line up to 6 tiles away. If it encounters your Solsphere, the projectile becomes enhanced.

Enemies hit by the projectile take Light magic damage. If enchaned, it explodes into a 3 Size Circle when it ends, dealing its damage to all enemies in that area (only once). If you have Holy Aura, the projectile also creates Light Shafts for 2 Rounds.

This skill requires a Rank D Invocation.

Targets a tile up to 8 Range away and fires a swift, destructive thread of light through it, in a flexible line. All enemies in the path of the beam take Light magic damage with Great Accuracy, and special effect tiles are razed. Critically hits against Glowing enemies for 25% extra damage.

Axe skill. Repeatedly smash your axe into a target in 1 Range, dealing Slash physical damage over several hits. The total damage is increased by 0.5% for every 1% of HP you are missing. (Can only be used once per round.)

Targets a 3-tile wide, 5 tile long line in one direction from you. Causes earthen spikes to erupt in that line, dealing Earth magic damage to all enemies hit. If enchanted with Galren, the tremor will also destroy Hardiness 1 Special effect tiles in the area of effect.

Excel Crash: Level 1 - 10% Damage per Charge level. Level 2 - Enemies you have magnetized, who are also in the tiles at your sides, are pushed 1 tiles in the direction you are facing before damage. Rock tiles in the area of effect will explode, and any enemies within 1 range of them will have a chance to be inflicted with Lingering Damage (Earth) Lv X (X = Charges*10) for 1 rounds. Level 3 - Ignore Evasions.

The Firebird is defined by magical feathers that aid them. You begin with 10 and generate 2 automatically every new round (max 30). Tiles you move on will consume 1 and cover it. At the end of the round, they resonate, dealing magic damage of your enchanted element (treated as Fire, if none) to any enemy in that tile, then expire. (Damage = Firebird LV + 5, ignores armor)

They also destroy special tiles in their location. (Fire = Ice Sheet, Ice = Cinders, Earth = Void Pollution, Lightning = Dark Water, Wind = Blows away instead.)

At Rank 2, this skill does not take up a skill slot.

Placed: If any Runes that can be linked are within 3 Range, draws them in and links them. (Only triggers on move effects once.)

Resonate: Moves towards the nearest enemy.

Engrave: Attempts to inflict Magnetize LV X (X = Rank * 5) for 2 rounds.

Trigger: Attempts to inflict enemies in effective range with Magnetize LV X (X= Rune Level * (Rank * 2)) for higher of 3 or 1 + Rune Level/2 rounds.

Shell: 5 x S.P. Armor-Ignoring Earth DMG, inflicts Magnetize LV X (3 x S.P.)/3 rounds. Bonus: 10 x B.P. Earth DMG. Pulls all Magnetized enemies up to 3 tiles towards the target. High Charge: 15 x H.P. Earth DMG and inflicts Attract Objects LV3/3 rounds.

Genpo skill. Cannot be used while Blind. Targets 1 unit within 3 Range. A type of trance induced through ki transfer via the user's eyes, it can cause paralysis of body and mind.

Allies gain Jine Ippo (5 rounds). Enemies may be inflicted with Mahi no Miwaku (LV x 2, 2 rounds), which can critically hit; if it does, they are also immobilized (2 rounds, or until your next turn for player characters).

Healing skill. Recovers the HP of all party members by a percentage of their maximum HP equal to Scaled FAI/2, up to a maximum of Rank*6%. The healing effect is only half as effective on summoned allies, such as Shine Knights, Youkai, Engineer machines, etc.

They won't notice if a little is missing from the top, will they?

Damage taken from spells is reduced by 1+X% (X = Rank*3) and stored as Leeched Energy (max LV: 10*Rank) for up to 3 rounds. Offensive spells you cast have increased Power equal to the amount of Leeched Energy you have, but after inflicting damage with one, the status will end.

extras: This skill does not take up any Skill Pool slots.
text.description:
Toggle skill. A two fold ability.

1) If toggled on, Pulling Shot will pull the nearest target towards the nearest trap (relative to them) you have set instead of you.

2) Enemies who trigger and/or are damaged by your traps become Trap Marked for 3 rounds. The mark is consumed when you hit the enemy with a basic attack, but causes the attack they're hit with to deal 15% extra damage.

extras: This skill does not take up a Skill Pool slot.
text.description: The rules are so boring. Toggle skill. While toggled on and you are in Reaver Stance, all Demon Hunter Sword skills, and all Soldier Offensive skills will use your Main Weapon, whatever that may be, instead of its intended weapon type. (For example, you could use Thousand Stab with a Sword, or Roundtrip with a Spear, etc.)
A holy prayer that involves more than just yourself. For 1 round, the area of effect for all your Curate support spells is increased.

The Matador is a wild berserker more like a bull than a tamer, storing Rage Energy from damage they take and unleashing it back on their enemies.

When you use this skill or a Matador stance skill, your active stance becomes Matador. Matador stance increases Armor/Magic Armor by 2, and 30% of damage you take is stored as Rage Energy.

This is a special resource generated for the Demon Hunter class, while in the Matador stance. Certain Matador skills will interact with it, or require a certain amount to use.

Rage Energy expires when battle ends, and if you are not in Matador Stance when a new round starts, you lose 5.

Cannot be used while Airborne. Enter a meditating state, focusing your ki and increasing the duration of all positive status effects you have by 1 round. At the start of the next round, you recover HP equal to 200% of your Scaled SKI, plus a bonus based on Rank (you also recover FP equal to half of this rank based bonus). Fear and being knocked back will halve the effectiveness of the heal.

Urawaza: Reduce incoming damage by a percentage equal to the bonus heal until the healing effect triggers.

Costs 5% of your maximum HP. Targets one of your summoned Youkai at a tile within 5 Range. You merge your form with theirs, teleporting to that tile, unsummoning the Youkai, triggering Chaotic Form with them, and gaining any beneficial status effects they have (excluding those you have).

Hex skill. Hex skills can only target those with a specific status effect, and it will then reset the duration of the status effect (based on Rank; the duration of the Hex is the same) and inflict a Hex on the target. Menovs will intensify the effects of a Poison on its victim, preventing it from being cured and causing it to deal 1.5x damage.

This skill requires a Rank D Invocation (see the Invocation talent for more details).

Mist skill. Upon being cast, the battlefield is covered in a light blue mist for 5 rounds, which grants all allies bonus HP regeneration equal to 25% of your Light ATK (or a Rank-based minimum, whichever is higher) and increases their Evade (based on Rank). Enemies gain a 3% weakness to Lightning damage (per Rank) while the mist is active. (Only one Mist skill can be active on the battlefield at a time; the last one cast will take priority and nullify previous ones.)

The way of Mercala teaches that healing magic should not be abused, because mankind would come to take it for granted, spurring on more aggressive or reckless pursuits. As such, her followers are taught that it is best to treat with non-magical methods when possible, and to use the magic only in emergencies or situations that do not act against this desire. When you use a healing item (except a Staff) on an ally, you regain FP, based on Rank.

Engage defensive mode, becoming a mighty wall for the enemies to crash on. For 3 rounds, increases your DEF and RES by LV, parry skill activation chance by LV%, and grants immunity to knockback effects. Additionally, until your next turn, you gain Arbalest Countershot. (When attacked in melee range, except behind, counter-attack for 50% damage. Reduces cooldown of Special armament by 1 afterward.)
When using Split Form, effects gained by Mimickry skills are not halved in duration.

The mystic qualities of summoning sometimes make foes less aware. Increases the FP cost of using the Summon skill by 5, but causes it to give you Sneak status for 2 rounds, which lowers your chance to be targeted by enemies.

extras: Can be enhanced with weapon charges.
text.description:
Launches a projectile that pierces enemies in a 4 Range Line. All tiles in the line are covered in ice, which will prematurely end movement by 1 tile for every ice sheet walked upon. If enchanted with Kraken, it also has a chance to inflict Frostbite LV (1 + Rank*3) for 3 rounds, which damages enemies who step on ice tiles.

This spell can be enhanced with the usage of weapon charges.

It's not uncommon for users of the sword or other weapons to mix in unarmed attacks in melee combat. For one thing, the 'sharp weapon' element makes them less weary of your fists, and for another, it gives you another avenue of attack, which is invaluable.

As long as you do not have a sub-weapon or shield equipped in your Hands slot, you can use Fist skills without having a Fist equipped (it will use your bare fists instead). Furthermore, if you have access to the Sub-Attack trait, you gain access to a Sub-Attack with your bare fists.

Targets an enemy within 5 Range and attempts to sow a deadly seed in their body, dealing 15 protection-ignoring Earth damage. If the attack hits, they will be inflicted with Mortefiore, the duration depends on an infliction check; if successful, 3 rounds, if not, 5 rounds.

Certain races may not be valid hosts for the plant. A unit can only be inflicted with Mortefiore once per Battle.

Sewn with a deadly plant. At start of new round, drain FP by LV. If duration is 1, painfully blooms, dealing Darkness damage based on LV (ignores Immunity/Absorb/Reflect); LV x 25 if causer level + 10 is greater or equal to this unit's level and this unit is a monster, or LV x 10 otherwise. Then inflicts Cursed Wound (LV = dmg dealt, 5 rounds) and Darkness Resistance Down (LV = level, 5 rounds).
What more is there to say? The healing aura of your tunes will spread their good vibes to allies. Your Bard song aura effects grant +5 HP regeneration to all affected units.
Some Bards just have the talent. Passively increases SAN, based on Rank. At Rank 5, SAN is further increased by +1.

A brief lull in activity can bait your opponent into making a mistake.

While toggled on, after using a Geist Schritt skill, you also skip your turn (unless the Geist Schritt skill activates, in which case you stop skipping.)

A sense of mysterious destiny that makes someone unpredictable and unreadable. Hides your HP, FP, equipped skills, and status effects from others. Of course, since monsters aren't particularly interested in details, it won't do much against them.
Attack an enemy within 1 Range with your dagger, dealing magic damage. If it misses, it will mystically attack again, dealing reduced damage, based on Rank.

Mimickry skill. Costs 1% of your maximum HP, can only be used by the Mystic race. Channel ancient arcane mysteries to boost the Scaled Weapon Attack of your next Offensive category Spell (or Youkai Evoke Spell) by 30 (expires afterwards, 5 rounds duration).

Knock the wind right out of them. Or into them. All around them.

While toggled on, when you damage an enemy with certain Boxer Offensive skills, you create an explosion of Wind magic damage around the target in a circle, damaging all enemies within it for 50% of the original damage dealt.
Honestly, if it didn't get any easier like this, you'd be worried. Reduces the FP cost of evoke skills of your currently installed youkai based on rank.

Targets 1 tile within 5 Range, and plants a Sweet Apple Sapling at that tile. If Mass is active, you can target 2 tiles. The second will create a Sweet Strawberry Sapling.

Growth Period: 3 Created by the Druid skill Nature's Bounty. A magical plant that can grow from druidic magics.

A relatively unremarkable plant, but with a remarkable fruit.

HP: Not Attackable

Bloom: Grows a Sweet Apple.

Special: Units (including enemies) within 1 Range of the Sweet Apple Sapling can eat the fruit to recover 25% of their maximum FP. Eating the fruit destroys the plant.

With the skill Druidic Tending, the plant gets the following bonuses:

Invigoration Tending - Recovery percentage increases by 10. Additionally, grants the eater Damage Amplified (LV 10, 5 rounds. Damage Amplified increases all damage dealt by LV%.).

Quickness Tending - Recovery percentage increases by 5. If an enemy tries to eat from the tree, they only have a (Enemy's CEL)% chance to successfully eat it. If they fail, they cannot attempt to eat it again for 1 round.

Growth Period: 3 Created by the Druid skill Nature's Bounty. A magical plant that can grow from druidic magics.

A relatively unremarkable plant, but with a remarkable fruit.

HP: Not Attackable

Bloom: Grows a Sweet Strawberry.

Special: Units (including enemies) within 1 Range of the Sweet Strawberry Sapling can eat the fruit to recover 25% of their maximum HP. Eating the fruit destroys the plant.

With the skill Druidic Tending, the plant gets the following bonuses:

Invigoration Tending - Recovery percentage increases by 10. Additionally, grants the eater Protection Up (LV 10, 5 rounds. Protection up increases Phys. and Mag. Defense by LV.).

Quickness Tending - Recovery percentage increases by 5. If an enemy tries to eat from the tree, they only have a (Enemy's CEL)% chance to successfully eat it. If they fail, they cannot attempt to eat it again for 1 round.

Serving as a conduit through which nature flows, you can use any weapon made of a Wood material as a casting tool for Nature, Isespian, and Sylphid spells.

Additionally, when you use Pray, all allied Saplings within X Range (X = Rank) receive Growth 2.

Unleashes a barrage of needles as projectiles in a line (4+Rank Range); one projectile per Rank. Each projectile that hits an enemy pierces them with needles and deals Light damage that ignores armor (based on Rank). The target remains pierced by the needles for the rest of the round, and if they take Light damage from any source except Needle, the needles will explode, dealing Light damage to the target equal to half the original amount, and releasing a healing pulse that recovers the HP of any ally within 2 Range by the same amount.

An otherworldly quality possessed by the user of the Black Wind. Blades and blows seem to veer off their course to lethal spots against the Black Knight. When wearing Heavy Armor, Passively increases your Critical Evade, lessening your chance of taking critical hits. Does not work against Tome weapons.

Work out a mutually beneficial deal with one enemy within 5 Range. If both you and the target have a negative status effect caused by an enemy, you and the target are both cured of one of those effects randomly. Then, this effect is repeated up to Rank times, as long as the condition is met.

Enchants yourself or a target party member with an elemental, increasing Fire ATK, STR and WIL. However, hosting an elemental also has its drawbacks; you take 1.25x Ice damage while enchanted. This effect lasts for 3 rounds. You cannot cast this spell on a character already enchanted with an elemental.

Creates a Nest at target location for 5 rounds. The Nest will help hide whoever is inside of it from monsters, slightly reducing the priority at which most monsters would attack them. Furthermore, being inside of the Nest will grant a Defense bonus, and reduce the FP cost of all Archer skills by 25%.

A quick and Elusive flight which allows you to travel in a 1-4 Range line behind you (which must end in an unoccupied tile, but can pass through enemies). If there is a plant field object in your destination, you use it to protect yourself, gaining bonus Evade for 1 attack, 3 rounds. If there is not, you instead become Airborne, ready to strike, and recover 2m.

Trickery - If Attrait is equipped, activate it automatically.
You're a master of nests. Increases the Range of Nest by 5 and extends the duration of its effect by 3 rounds.
With a reputation for never shutting up, perhaps to the benefit or anger of others, the Bard is a natural talker, increasing their Status Resistance versus the Silence status by 15%.
A truly skilled Summoner can bring out the power of their Youkai in a way that those who are not, cannot. Halves the FP cost of Summon Youkai.

Mimickry skill. Costs 1% of your maximum HP, can only be used by the Night race. You and all other Night allies coat yourselves in a veil of darkness, increasing your Evade by 25 for 2 attacks, 5 rounds. For each other ally affected, the number of attacks the effect lasts for increases by 1.

Desperado stance. Unleash a volatile bullet as a projectile in a line that will travel up to your Gun's attack range away. Upon contacting an enemy or at the end of its range, the bullet will burst into a massive explosion, dealing Blunt physical damage that ignores evasion. All damaged enemies are also launched Airborne. If you are in the explosion radius, you also become Airborne.

Regaining your physical senses can lead to a more stable body, but it makes you more predictable. At the start of a new round, if Chaos Reflex is active, its LV will be reduced by 8, and you will recover 1% of your maximum HP.

Gain the blessing of the harsh northern winds, granting you bonus Critical. If you are closer to the north edge of the battlefield than the south edge, you gain additional Critical. This bonus lasts for 3 rounds.

Curse skill. Curse skills will apply a curse to yourself for 3 rounds, and while active, you will suffer the effects of the curse. However, if an enemy damages you while a Curse is active, it will transfer to them. (Once transferred, the curses remain on the victim and the duration is refreshed.) Noshka's famine will cause the STR and WIL stats of the victim to decrease.

Engrave: Status infliction based chance to dispel 1 buff from the target.

Linked Runes will not be triggered.
Shell: 5 x S.P. Armor-Ignoring Null DMG Bonus: 10 x B.P. Null DMG and lower target's elemental resistances by 10%/3 rounds High Charge: Dispells up to 4 beneficial status effects.

extras: Equipping this skill does not take up a Skill Pool slot.
text.description:
Magically induced photosynthesis is not normally effective, but these are not normal plants.

Upon using Brighten, any Druid Plants in its target area which do not already have a Light Shaft atop them receive Growth 1.

Spear skill. Airborne compatible. Targets 2 locations within 2 Range. In Location 1, there must be an enemy, and Location 2 must be an unoccupied tile. The enemy in L1 takes Pierce physical damage. If you are not airborne, you then move to L2, you pull the target to your old location. If you are airborne, you slam the enemy into L2 instead.

Dark Bard Song skill. Play your instrument towards two different locations up to 5 Range away. Applies to all tiles in a line from your position to those locations, depending on if there is a unit or not in it:

Unit - Deals Sound magic damage. (Enemies take full damage and may be inflicted with Confusion for 2 rounds, allies take Kickback Damage.)

No Unit - Creates a Shadow Mosh (if none exist in that tile).

When activated, the Void Assassin hides themselves in obscurity, removing certain status effects that would pinpoint or bring attention to themselves. (Affected Statuses: Glowing, Enemy Evaluation, Analyze Weakness, Hunted, Claret Call, Marked for Death, Watchful Eye)

You cover your armament's chain in oil for 5 rounds. If you use a cannon skill during this time, the friction of the chain will ignite the oil, dealing physical fire damage in a line (in the direction you are facing, or a line from you to the target for Straight cannon). It also leaves behind a burning trail for 2 rounds, which will deal fire damage equal to half that to any enemy that walks through it.

Instrument skill. Put an enemy or another ally within 7 Range on a leash of fiery chains, dealing Fire magic damage to them (allies take Kickback Damage), and pulling them 2 tiles towards you. Enemies may be inflicted with Immobilize until your next turn. Allies are instead inflicted with On A Leash for 5 Rounds (if the target was an ally with this effect already, the effect ends and you regain 2M).

On A Leash: This is an effect given by the skill of the same name to allies. While active, the ally is treated as if they were Immobilized, and at the start of a new round they take Kickback Damage, but they also gain or power up Freakish Frenzy by 1 LV/3 rounds (max: LV 5, 3 rounds).

Freakish Frenzy increases Move by LV, Critical by LV * 10, and Critical Damage by LV * 5%.'

extras: Equipping this skill does not take up a Skill point slot.
text.description: Give your allies the boost they need by giving them orders to follow. At the start of a battle, automatically applies your first Order skill you have equipped. Additionally, increase the duration of your order skills by 1 round (they still only apply once).

True Boxers will take every advantage they can get when the enemy has their back to the wall.

While not at the edge of the battlefield, any enemy who is, or has a dense object behind them, takes 15% extra damage from you.
Opportunities to blast your opponent in the face are rare, so it's best to make the most of them. Increases Power with Shotgun-Type weapons based on Rank.

True Duelists excel at just that; dueling. While they are still competent fighters in larger battles, they are better trained against single opponents. While there is only one enemy in the battle, you gain a bonus to all damage you deal. While you are the only living unit in your party, you reduce all damage taken by the same amount.

Dance skills that deal damage to an enemy also give them a status called 'One-Two (X)' (X = damage type) for 3 rounds. When they are hit by a basic attack, that status is consumed to deal armor-ignoring bonus magic damage of the same type to that enemy and all other enemies within 2 Range of the target.

(Different damage types will stack.)

A powerful spinning attack. Targets an X Range circle (2 + half of Schwarz Sturm level). All enemies in that area are drawn in X tiles, based on Rank, towards you, and then deals Blunt physical damage to all enemies within 1 Range of you.

Overloads the Gun with Focus energy, dramatically increasing its power output. In this state, the next basic attack with a Gun that hits will trigger both the bullet's Bonus Effect and High Charge effect. However, afterwards, this skill is put on a 3 round cooldown. While this skill is on cooldown, magic shell effects will not activate.

Targets an Engineer device and sends it into overdrive. Upon activation, the target immediately gains 2 Momentum, and will gain that much more every round. However, after every action it takes, it will lose 10% of its maximum HP. If destroyed while Overclocked, it will burst into a lightning explosion that leaves no scrap behind, dealing Lightning damage to all enemies in 3 Range. You can undo this effect by using the skill again.
Your gun may be hot, but the bullets are hotter. While Overcharge is on cooldown, your Scaled Weapon Attack and Critical Damage with Gun weapons increases.

This skill requires a Rank D Invocation (see the Invocation talent for more details).

Targets 1 enemy within 6 Range and deals Lightning magic damage to them. The damage is further increased by X (based on Rank) for every bonus statistic point they currently have. If enchanted with Redgull, the lightning damage may critically hit.

"Judgmental thunder, turn power into pain..."
Since it's not yours, you don't know its limits as well. Increases the Power of Copy spells by 2*Rank.

Some people just aren't good at fighting, but that usually means they're good at other things, like supporting the ones who are. At the start of battle, you gain a permanent status that increases the duration of your Curate support spells and grants FP Regeneration, and reduces the cooldown of Curate class (including promoted classes) that heal HP by 1 round. The status will immediately end if you deal any damage to any enemy.

Ghosts are used to having to deal with shedding blood - sometimes their own. They can operate effectively in less ideal circumstances (and with less blood) than others, increasing their Hit Points. At max Rank, further increases maximum HP by 8.

Costs 10% of your maximum HP to use. Cause damage to yourself in order to lessen the pain you feel from enemies, granting X% Physical and Magical Defense until your next turn versus targets marked by your Claret Call.

When summoned, your Bonded Youkai gain a permanent status that increases their damage dealt by 15% and halves their Maintenance and Skill FP costs, but your Youkai cannot bring enemies below 15% of their maximum HP (Any excess damage that would bring them below that is ignored).

Gun skill. Jump back and away from an enemy, guns blazing. By targeting an enemy in 3 Range, you attack them with your Gun as per normal, but with a small penalty to hit. You also jump away X tiles, where X = Rank.

Most terrifying is not the ruler quickest to lash out, but the one who strikes hardest. Casting a mage/ruler enchant spell grants or power up Patient scourge LV10 (Max Lv50 for 5 Rounds. Patient scourge boosts the damage, and critical of your next whip basic attack and is consumed on hit.
What goes around comes around. When an enemy deals damage to you, they gain a status that reduces their Status Resist for one infliction instance, for up to 2 rounds.

Fist skill. Spin your body in a somersault, while simultaneously punching and kicking any enemies you pass. You perform this attack in a line that must end in an unoccupied square, and deal Blunt physical damage to every enemy you pass over, or within 1 cardinal tile of a square you pass through.

Urawaza: All enemies hit are also thrown Airborne.
The Kensei are both respected and feared for their immense prowess with a blade, but also their incredible speed and skill with it. Passively increases STR and SKI.

extras: If you do not learn this skill, your Tactics Rank will be stuck at D.
text.description: Tacticians are only as good as their tactics. In battle, a gauge will appear in the bottom left, displaying a ranking from D to SSS, known as your Tactics Rank. Some Tactician skills will be influenced by your Tactics Rank. Your Tactics Rank increases in different ways when you use Tactician skills. It will be reset to D if an ally is reduced to 0 HP. It will also drop by 1 level every time you take damage (as long as that damage is greater than 5% of your maximum HP).

extras: No longer take up a skill pool slot.
text.description: A true Performer is made better just by putting on a show. While you are Singing, your HP and FP Regeneration are increased by 5.
A type of mastery that increases the quality of ice created through spirituality. Increases the duration of all Ice Point skills by Rank.

Bathes allies in the warmth of the endless bird, healing allies in its area of effect. This healing can revive Downed allies within a certain Range.

(Damage/Heal and Effect Power/Duration/Chance from Lantern Activations are more effective when close and less effective when far.)

Eternal Flame: Restores HP every round.

Enchants your kicks for 5 rounds, causing your kick attacks on Airborne targets to deal Light damage (based on Rank) that ignores armor. Being within an allied Lantern Bearer's Phoenix Aura boosts the damage by 50%. When triggered, you recover HP equal to the bonus damage.

Requires 1 Solcharge. Targets 2 tiles in 6 Range. Location 1 must have an enemy, Location 2 can be any other tile.

Creates a circle of light that wraps around the enemy in L1, dealing Light magic damage, and pulls them 3 tiles towards L2. If the target's Scaled STR is higher than your Scaled WIL, they resist the pull, reducing it by 1 tile.

Spear skill. Targets 1 enemy within 1 Range and stabs at them in a unique manner, dealing Pierce physical damage. Additionally deals 50% of your Light ATK as Light magic damage that ignores Evasion, but requires a hit check, 3 times. If all 3 hit, a rose of light blooms and all enemies within 4 Range of that target have a chance to be inflicted with Charm LV (Rank*5) for 3 rounds.

Spear skill. Thrust your spear forward harshly, performing a basic attack on all enemies in a 3 Range line in front of you, with a bonus to Hit. Each enemy beyond the first takes reduced damage; 75% for the second, 50% for the third. If more than one enemy is successfully hit, all enemies hit are inflicted with Immobilize until your next turn.
A good priest isn't good nor a priest without faith guiding them. Increases FAI based Rank. At Rank 5, FAI is increased by an additional +1.

Targets an empty tile within 5 range and teleports to it. If there is an enemy within 1 Range of that tile you attack them; they are knocked back 2 + Rank tiles. Any bonded youkai within 1 Range of them while being knocked down automatically attack them,with bonus hit.

Targets a single tile within 5 Range, as well as all tiles that enemy units which your Analyze Weakness and Enemy Evaluation skills are affecting (regardless of Range). Enemies in those tiles take Lightning magic damage. For each enemy that is weak to Lightning, your Tactics Rank increases by 1 level.

Performer Song skill. A charming melody inviting foes to doom.

Play your instrument, attempting to inflict Charmed LV X (based on Rank) and Confusion for 3 rounds each to all enemies within 5 Range.
Pizza is a Demon Hunter's best and most loyal friend. Doubles the HP and FP Regen of all Pizza foods.

Mimickry skill. Costs 1% of your maximum HP, can only be used by the Plant race. Use the focus around you to trigger a rapid regeneration, healing you for 2% of your maximum HP and reducing the duration of a random negative status effect caused by an enemy by 2 rounds. If no such effects exist, the HP recovery is doubled instead.

Curse skill. Curse skills will apply a curse to yourself for 3 rounds, and while active, you will suffer the effects of the curse. However, if an enemy damages you while a Curse is active, it will transfer to them. (Once transferred, the curses remain on the victim and the duration is refreshed.) Plisfa will make the target unable to dodge attacks. Its LV will then be reduced by 1 (and if it reaches 0, the effect ends.)
Mainclass Only Skill. As a true Firebird, your feathers are magical enough to get another go. Your Magical Feathers do not expire after the first time they resonate (but will the second time).

Reach into your pocket, grab a fist full of sand, and throw it in the eyes (or whatever seems the most like them) of 1 enemy within 2 Range, Blinding them for 2 rounds. Afterwards, your pocket will be empty of sand, meaning you can only use this skill once per battle
Bear Discipline technique. Targets 1 enemy within 1 Range and deals physical Blunt damage. This kick puts your target into the air as if they were a ball waiting to be punted, making them Airborne.

To have poise means to have the upper hand and it requires quick reflexes. When you are attacked, you gain a bonus to your Critical for your next attack within 2 rounds.

If you evaded the attack, the duration is increased by 1 and you gain Perfect Poise, which doubles the bonus and keeps it active for multiple attacks. Perfect Poise will end if you are hit by a basic attack, and both will be reduced in duration and level (1/3 respectively) if you take any damage exceeding a threshold, based on Rank.

text.powerRaw: Move one tile in any direction.
text.description: Dance skill. The sign of a skilled dancer; being able to get into place. You target any tile within 1 Range and step to it.
Sword skill. You unleash a strike with such form that it transcends normal strikes, causing it to deal bonus damage (based on Rank), and deal magic damage instead of physical damage.
Makes your power up even more of a power up, or maybe a power out. When you use Power Up, all enemies within 2 Range of you will be knocked back by 3 tiles.

extras: Equipping this skill does not take up a SP slot.
text.description:
Parry skill (but only active in certain conditions). Allied units, including yourself, within 1 Range of one or more Shadow Moshes, gain a chance to parry enemy damage, reducing it by 35% (50% if the attacker is Confused). The chance is equal to 15% per Shadow Mosh in 1 Range (+25% for the owner of this skill).

When triggered, a random Shadow Mosh in 1 Range will be blown away.

Raise your arms and focus your power. Uses up all of your available Momentum, to a minimum of 3, and restores your FP and generates Ki based on the amount consumed, based on Rank. If 6 or more is consumed, both effects are increased by 50%. (The values listed are per point of Momentum).

Cannot be used while silenced. Drop to your knees and offer prayers for help to the divine while forsaking all other actions that round. First, this prayer restores FP Equal to your FAI + Rank (max: Rank*6). Second, the duration of all positive status effects you have caused for all combatants are increased by 2 rounds. Third, it increases your LUC by half of your FAI for 4 rounds. This skill can then no longer be used while the LUC bonus is active. Finally, there is a chance based on your FAI that a bonus effect might occur.

extras: Equipping this skill does not take up a Skill Pool slot.
text.description:
One hunts, the other feeds. Animal Companion skills (including Calls), Wild Shape skills, and basic attacks of Animal Companions (and you in Wild Shapeshift), gain a Vampiric (10%) effect. Your Dhessence spell recovers twice as much HP.

In exchange, you have -15 Status Resistance VS Hunted, and the LV of Hunted applied to you increases by 5.
Take your free moments to make sure everything is straight and even. Converts your unused Momentum into Magical Feathers at a ratio of 1:1.

You are skilled at avoiding the risks involved with this dangerous art.

HP costs associated with Shapeshifter skills and effects are halved. If Shapeshifter is both your Main Class and Sub Class, they are instead negated. (Has no effect when used with Self-Destructive Shifting.)

Arcane skill. Fires a powerful water jet as an arrow that deals Water magic damage over 3 hits to 1 enemy within 5 range. Alternatively, it can target an allied Rain Trap, destroying the trap but applying this skill's effects and creating flooded water (3 rounds) in it's AoE.

Annorum: Washes away a number of positive status effects from the target(s) equal to the number of successful hits.
Piece Style Skill. Changes the appearance (But not the skills, etc) of your Servant Automatons to be more akin to Golems rather than chess piece statues. This does not take up a skill pool slot.

Requires 9 Geomaterial. Target 1 of your Pawn Automaton and puts it in Geostatis until its turn, granting it 2 LVs of Automaton Energy and transform it into a Queen Automaton. Cannot be used while you already have a Queen Automaton.

Prepare yourself to fend off the worst. Creates a group of counter-attack tiles at all tiles within 1 Range of you. When an enemy steps on one and you are within 1 Range of that tile, you perform a basic attack (treated as a counter attack) with a bonus to your Critical Damage equal to X (X = Rank * 10%). If the attack hits and the enemy was using basic Movement, they stop.

The tiles will last for 2 rounds or until triggered.

Shield skill. Allows you to take basic attacks (or skills that perform them) in the place of an ally within melee range. When you intercept an attack, you gain DEF (based on Rank) until your next turn. Can be toggled on and off.
The ability to intercept arrows in flight from hitting you. You gain Evade VS Bow weapons based on Rank.

Bow skill. Fire an arrow tied to a rope, and use that rope to pull your target/fish in. Performs a basic attack on the target that deals bonus damage; if successful, the target is pulled towards you a number of squares based on Rank.

If Dynamic Shooting is at Rank 5 or higher, if the target is suffering from any status that decreases Move, they are inflicted with Knocked Down.
When preforming an attack with a Bow Weapon, or using an arbalest skill that requires a bow, if you have a Special Armament. You ignores up to X armor of your enemy (based on Rank).
Genius comes in two forms: inspiration and application. Only those who have both are really geniuses! At max rank, gives an additional 1 GUI.
The truly powerful don't need items. In fact, they just get in the way. For every equipment slot that isn't occupied, you gain a Power bonus to all spells you cast.

Treatment skill. Targets 1 ally (or yourself) within 1 Range and removes any Poison effect they are suffering from, as long as it has a LV equal to or lower than X (based on Rank). If you have a Staff-type weapon equipped, the Range of this skill is increased by 3.

Targets 1 ally within 5 Range and rushes them with purifying divine waters which wash away impurities. Reduces the duration of the negative status effect with the highest LV that was caused by an enemy by X (X = Rank) rounds. Does not affect status effects which are immune to curing. (Via Hex, etc.)

Aquae Crest: If LV 9 or higher, consumes 6 levels and affects all negative status effects caused by enemies instead.

Some prefer the power of magic to sharpen their blade, while others prefer the simple power of darkness and curses. But for some, the unhoned and unspoiled are the sharpest weapons. Unenchanted weapons you use gain bonus Power, Hit, and Critical based on Rank.

Dark Bard Song skill. Play your instrument, dealing Sound magic damage in a 2-4 size circle around you, then all tiles in a ring outside of the circle launch the pyrotechnics, dealing Fire magic damage (based on SWA + Fire ATK).

Enemies take full damage, while allies take Kickback damage.

Dance skill. Elegantly tap your feet on the ground below you, perhaps more strongly than expected. You will tap your feet 3 times, and every time, you deal Earth magic damage (based on your Earth ATK and Rank) to a random enemy in 7 Range (however, each enemy can only be damaged once).

Summon lightning from your lantern, shocking all enemies within 3 Range and dealing Lightning magic damage to them. It can also inflict Interference for 3 rounds on those enemies.

(Damage/Heal and Effect Power/Duration/Chance from Lantern Activations are more effective when close and less effective when far.)

Eternal Flame: LUC, GUI

Desperado stance. A fast burst of bullets to lighten up your enemy's day. Targets 1 enemy within 3 Range and performs a basic attack on them with an equipped Gun weapon, which deals only 20% of its normal damage.

A true Rogue always takes any small opportunity and turns it into an advantage for them, if possible. When you are Knocked Down, if you successfully Evade an attack, you are cured of Knock Down for free by quickly jumping to your feet.

Throw yourself into a slide at a target unoccupied location within 3 Range, quickly repositioning yourself.

Trickery: If you have a Trap skill equipped, automatically apply it at your current location before you slide.
Fills a target ally with a divine speed, increasing their CEL (based on Rank) and Move by 2 for the duration. Lasts 3 rounds.

Requires 3 Solcharges. Must target your Solsphere within 6 Range, releasing its magic and causing it to end, creating a wave of healing energy.

Restores the HP of all allies within 5 Range of the Solsphere based on Light ATK; half is applied as healing, and the other half as an HP Regeneration effect (over 2 rounds). +50% Range and Heal if the Solsphere was enhanced. If you are healed by this, you gain Holy Aura.

Requires 3 Solcharges. Must target your unenhanced Solsphere within 6 Range. Enhances the Solsphere, providing a variety of bonuses:

The enhancement will wear off after 5 rounds, reverting to a normal Solsphere.

Must target your Solsphere within 6 Range, releasing its magic and causing it to end, creating a destructive wave of energy.

In a 3 Size Circle around it, creates special effect tiles (based on elemental, Light Shafts by default, 2 rounds) with a LV of 15 and deals Light magic damage to enemies. If the Solsphere was enhanced, +2 Circle Size and +25% damage dealt. If you are within its effective range, you gain Holy Aura.
If you have Voidveil equipped, you absorb energy from the Void for yourself. Passively generate a small amount of Void Energy every round based on Rank.

The light from your lantern becomes hotter, burning those within its light. At the start of every round, enemies within your Lantern's range take unresistable damage (based on Rank) of your last invoked flame's element.

Dark Bard Song skill. Play your instrument, creating projectiles in all directions around you that travel up to 6 Range away. Enemies hit by the projectiles take Sound magic damage and are pulled two tiles towards you. (Allies the projectile passes through take Kickback Damage, but do not stop the projectile and are not pulled towards you.)

Kensei Combo Skill. Slash upwards at your target, and follow them into the air. Deals Slash damage to an within 1 range, making you both airborne. If the sword you are using is a Katana-type, the momentum cost is reduced by 1.

If the Voltiger is available, it can be consumed to target an enemy within 5 range, teleporting you to an unoccupied tile next to them before other effects.

Sacred Art Effect: Lightning physical damage.

Combo Effect: All enemies within 3 Range of the target are also hit by the skill.

Places a Rain Trap at a location within 2 range for 10 rounds. When triggered, and for 3 rounds, after that, it sprays water in an X (based on Rank) Range diamond, inflicting Soaked on all enemies in that area for 3 rounds. Soaked causes special effects when the target takes Fire, Lightning, Ice, or Earth damage.

Performer Song skill. Alternatively, one could call it the song of storms, played to call the rain.

Play your instrument, dealing Water magic damage and reduce the Fire ATK (3 rounds; LV based on Rank) of all enemies within 5 Range. If a Rainstorm is currently active on the battlefield, this song will affect all enemies instead.

Hare Discipline technique. Targets an enemy in 1 Range, or a tile in 1 Range (if you or that tile have Ice Point Guard) and kicks it X times (X = 3+Rank).

If the target is an enemy, it deals Blunt physical damage. Each kick applies half of Ice Point Greaves' damage. Otherwise, each kick launches three projectiles that deal Ice magic damage which ignore armor (50% Ice atk + bonus kick damage) and puts the skill on a 3 round CD. Reduces the duration of the Ice Point Guard it targets by 1.

Flourish your whip wildly. Hitting a 4 size crescent area within 3 range. Enemies in those tiles take Slash physical damage, and up to X ( X = rank) Natural Resources in that area cut up by your whip and refined (Ruler) into Geomaterial.

Resonate/Trigger: Deals X Slash magic damage to all enemies in effective range (+1), which ignores armour. (X = 5 * Rune Level)

Engrave: Deals Slash magic damage to the target.

Resonate effect will trigger every time the Rune moves.

Axe or Scythe skill. A deadly blade that cannot be protected against. Deals Slash magic damage to all enemies in a crescent pattern. If any of those enemies are marked by Claret Call, they can be guard broken, but become Unmarkable until your next turn.

(Guard Break: If the target is Guarding, it's removed and they take 15% more damage for 1 round.)

The Reaver is a mighty melee fighter that is not bound by the normal laws of soldiers, making combat look more like a bloody dance than a battle.

When you use this skill or a Reaver stance skill, your active stance becomes Reaver. Reaver stance increases your Scaled Weapon Attack by 5, and enhances some Offensive skills.

Spout water from your lantern, soaking all enemies within 3 Range and dealing Water magic damage to them. It can also inflict Soaked for 2 rounds on those enemies.

(Damage/Heal and Effect Power/Duration/Chance from Lantern Activations are more effective when close and less effective when far.)

Eternal Flame: Reduces the LV of Cinder tiles within the range of your lantern by EF * 3 every round.

Draw back and consumes all of your Claret Calls on all enemies, which sap HP and FP from those enemies equal to their LV, restoring your HP and FP for each (HP recovery is increased by X% of your Scaled RES).

Small Note: There might be a typo in 'Draw back and consumes all'; as opposed to this, it might be 'Draw back and consume all'.

The Magic Gunner is a risk taker. The thrill of danger is something they love, and have very little regard for the consequences. Upon activation, the Magic Gunner removes certain negative status effects from themself, and gain an immunity to them for 3 rounds.
Deals Lightning damage to all enemies within a 2 Range circle around you. If you are enchanted with Redgull, this damage cannot be Reflected.

Costs 5% of your Maximum HP. Creates a localized rainstorm of blood at a target location up to 5 Range away. When created, and at the start of every round, enemies in the rainstorm have Claret Call applied to them. At the start of a new round, if no enemies are in the area of effect, the rainstorm will creep towards the nearest enemy.

The rainstorm lasts for 2+Rank rounds, but can be dissipated by certain effects.

Enchants yourself or a target party member with an elemental, increasing Lightning ATK, CEL and LUC. However, hosting an elemental also has its drawbacks; you take 1.25x Fire damage while enchanted. This effect lasts for 3 rounds. You cannot cast this spell on a character already enchanted with an elemental.

You skillfully manipulate any deflected Gun attacks into bouncing back towards your enemies. When you successfully block a Gun attack with Blade Barrier, rather than cancelling the attack, it is reflected to a random enemy within X Range, based on Rank.

Targets 1 ally in 5 Range and surrounds them with magically-enchanted waters which heal wounds slowly. That ally gains Refreshing Flow LV X (based on Rank) for 3 rounds, which increases HP Regeneration by its LV.

Aquae Crest: If LV 3 or higher, consumes 3 levels and restores their HP immediately equal to Refreshing Flow's LV.

Fist Skill. A series of fast punches at the target that ignores protection. You hit the target a number of times equal to your Schwarz Sturm level +1, and the damage they each deal is based on Rank. (This skill will not trigger Nachbeben.)

extras: Restores all unsummoned Youkai's HP by 1/10/50/100/200. This spell is also effective on Youkai with 0 HP, reviving them.
text.description:
This skill requires a Rank D Invocation (see the Invocation talent for more details).

Invoke an ancient word, restoring all unsummoned Youkai's HP by X (based on Rank). This spell is also effective on Youkai with 0 HP, reviving them.

"Ether reformed..."

An invisible wind that follows yourself or target ally, increasing their CEL. In addition, knockback/pull effects that put enemies within 1 Range of you (whether it's you or them), it will suddenly push back, knocking back all enemies within 1 Range 2 times, and knock them down (once). Also grants a special skill called Quick Gale that uses up the buff to push nearby enemies away.

With every strike, you aim for better spots, honed and relentless. After performing a basic attack, you increase the damage dealt by your basic attacks by 2 for 1 round. (This effect can stack up to a maximum LV.)

Sometimes one need a second opinion to sort through any matters they find confusing. Targets one other allied unit in 5 range, and cures both the ruler and target of any non-permanent confusion effect and grants both confusion immunity for 3 rounds. Trickery - Automatically apply a mage defensive spell to the target that you have equipped for free (Preference to spells the target does not have effect of.)
Can only be used once per round. Fixes up broken machinery, which heals a target Engineer device or Mechanation for your Scaled GUI*2 HP. The heal is half as effective if used on yourself.

extras: Gains 2 FP for every enemy defeated by a party-member you buffed.
text.description: There's nothing quite like the satisfaction of good music while you fight. When an ally under the effect of one of your Bard song status effects defeats an enemy, you regain 2 FP for each of your song effects active on them.
Attacks the target with the intent of pushing them away. If the attack hits, the target is pushed back by 1 square. If the attack is a critical hit, it is increased to 3 squares.

Pull your ally away from a disadvantageous situation, summoning them to your side. Affected allies will be moved to an unoccupied tile next to you. (You must have at least one available spot per ally affected.)

Being flexible is usually a good thing. It's beneficial to anyone, most of all adventurers, to always have new tricks up their sleeve, and a resourceful rogue is just that. Flexible. This inate skill will increase your maximum possible equipped skills.

Dancing is hard work, so it's important to rest now and then. Requires Tempo. Restores HP and FP (based on Rank) and cures 1 negative status effect caused by an enemy for every 1 Tempo you have, and then resets it to 0.

Matador stance. Give one enemy cabrone within 1 Range the horns, dealing unresistable Dark damage to them equal to your accumulated Rage Energy. Afterwards, your Rage Energy resets to 0.

Gains 1 Range per 10 Rage Energy available, to a max of 10 Range. Using this skill on an enemy outside of 1 Range will spend 5 Rage Energy (per tile) to move you next to them, before triggering its effect.

Targets 1 enemy within 1 Range. You perform a flip off that target's body, becoming airborne and moving backwards 1-4 Range, which must end in an unoccupied tile, and become Airborne. You also perform a basic attack on the target, with a bonus to Hit, based on Rank.

Sword skill. A close range swipe as you fall back, dealing physical damage of your weapon's damage type to all enemies within 1 Range, except those behind you. Afterwards, if the tile directly behind you is unoccupied, you will jump backwards to it.

Don't let your goodies go to waste. If an Upgrade skill of yours would end prematurely (for example, the battle ending) you recover the 15 FP you spent on the skill. Similarly, if an Engineer Bot is alive at the end of a battle, you will recover 50 FP for each.
Outfit your veil with sharp blades. When you teleport to a Voidgate, after teleporting through it, you automatically Fray it.

(Swords, Axes, and Spears can be used as casting tools for this spell.) Can only be used if you have Bonded Youkai. For each Bonded Youkai, a projectile is launched in a 5 Range line in one direction. A projectile that hits the target will deal magic damage (damage type depends on the Youkai). If you have only one Bonded Youkai, the damage is also increased by half of that Youkai's Scaled WIL, and the Range is increased by 2.

Note: Projectile 2 will be fired at a 45 degree turn from your direction. Projectile 3 will be fired from a -45 degree turn from your direction.

Surround yourself with an enchanted ring of magical pearls for 5 rounds. While active, the pearls will intercept attacks, boosting your Evade (based on Rank), as well as increasing your success rate when Convert Enemy effects are applied to sea-faring races. In addition, at a chance equal to 30% + (half of Scaled SKI), the pearls may parry attacks made by swords, axes, spears, and fists, reducing their damage by 25% as well as increasing your success rate when Convert Enemy effects are applied to sea-faring races.

Aquae Crest: If LV 5 or higher, all enemies in 2 Range are knocked back 3 tiles.

Accepting attacks and then returning them is a basic form of swordplay. When you are attacked in melee range, there is a chance that you will perform an automatic attack on your attacker (but this attack will deal 50% of its normal damage). This skill will not trigger for attacks made directly behind you.

Abuse the ripples of dimensions to speed up your summonings. Hitting at least one enemy with Impact Call's effect will grant Ripple Dimension LV1 (stacks up to LV3) for 1 round, which lowers the momentum cost of Summon by LV.
Throw 2 Magical Feathers at the ground below any unit (including yourself) within 1 Range, which then creates a powerful gust that knocks that unit Airborne.

Targets 1 enemy within 1 Range and performs a rising basic attack on them (with increased damage), which makes you become Airborne. If the target is Airborne, you will quickly rise to the tile opposite of them (if a valid battle tile), otherwise they will become Airborne.

If Holy Aura is active, this attack cannot be parried and does not trigger 'On Attacked' effects.

The true strength of the Ghost that causes their combat parameters to significantly increases as death creeps closer. Something inside of them is honed with each step into the grave. Fortune smiles upon the reckless. This skill causes specific statistics to increase based on your missing HP. For every 15% of your HP that is missing, the affected stats increase by +1.
Bear Discipline technique. Targets 1 enemy within 1 Range and deals physical Blunt damage. As part of the motion, you rise into the air, making yourself Airborne.
Sword skill. Targets a single tile within 1 Range (it can be an empty tile). Any enemy in that tile takes weapon-based physical damage. Both you and the target then become Airborne.

Sword skill. Performs a basic attack on 1 enemy within 1 Range. If the target is successfully hit by the attack, you steal FP from the target, based on Rank. (If the attack was a critical hit, the FP steal is also increased.) If you have only one Bonded Youkai, you also summon that Youkai to your side. (If it is summoned already, it is moved to a random tile next to you. If the Youkai is already within 2 Range of the attacked enemy, this effect will not trigger.)
Fill all other allies units with a divine energy, applying the charge weapon skill to them once.

Imbue all allies within a 4 Range circle around you with a cry of the falcon, granting them a bonus to Sound ATK, based on Rank, for 5 rounds. In addition, the first basic attack or first time a Firebird skill damages an enemy, that enemy takes armor-ignoring Sound magic damage equal to 50% of the attackers Sound ATK (Guns attacks only apply this once, regardless of how many rounds it fires.

Mainclass Only Skill. When you recover from a knockdown, you unleash a quick burst of magical energy around you, dealing damage equal to your Magical Feather damage and of the same element to all enemies within 2 Range; enemies within 1 Range are also knocked back 1 tile. In addition, if at least 4 Magical Feathers are available, the Momentum penalty of the knockdown is reduced by 1 per 4 consumed. (IE, 4 feathers = -2M, 8 = -1M, 12 = -0M)

Dance skill. Throw a rose to a target tile within 4 Range, triggering One-Two Steps on all enemies. If the target tile is empty, all enemies within 3 Range of that tile have a chance to be Charmed LV X (based on Rank, 3 rounds). If it has an enemy, it only affects them, but also inflicted them with Holding Rose if successful.

If an enemy is defeated by One-Two Step triggered by this skill, you gain Boisterous Dancer for 5 rounds, and recover FP for each.

Holding a rose. Disables Two-Hand talent bonuses. Against enemies charming you, -LV Hit and -LV% Parry Activation chance.

You are just... so... COOL! +LV Critical, Evade, and Charm Infliction Rate. +10% Item Drop Rate.

Use your enemy as a springboard to flip yourself to a more useful location. Targets 1 enemy within 1 Range; if the tile on the other side of them is unoccupied, you will vault over them and land on that tile.

extras: Second hit pulls enemies towards you.
text.description: Axe skill. Throw your weapon in a line, dealing Slash physical damage to all affected. Then, the axe will return to you, dealing Slash physical damage again. (Half the damage is dealt on the first trip and the other half on the return trip)

Whip skill. Location 1 must be within 3 range, and contain a different allied unit that can move, and location 2 must be an unoccupied tile within 9 range. You whip that ally, and pull yourself to them dealing some kickback damage to them. Afterwards, they carry you up to X steps (based on rank) toward Location 2, and then set you down on an unoccupied tile within 1 range. If no such tiles exist, all enemies within 1 range are knocked back 3 tiles, and you are Knocked Down.

Rulers utilize a special resource called Geomaterial for some of their skills. They can have a maximum of 9 Geomaterials stored at once, and begin battle with 3 geomaterial plus per Geoheart enchantment they have on equipped items. When they score a critical hit with a Whip Weapon, they gain 1 Geomaterial.

True Rulers know how to assert their station, using it both as a shield and as a sword. Increase damage dealt to and reduce damage taken by Subservient enemies (Non-boss enemies, Curate/Soldiers, Pack Follower/Little Cheese) by 7% each. if Ruler is both your main class and sub-class, this is doubled. And all enemies except other Rulers are treated as subservient. In addition, increases your skill pool size by 0.5 for every enchant-class spell you have equipped.

Targets 1 ally within 8 range, and charge all of the non-permanent mage/ruler enchant spell effect that they been granted by you into arcane missiles. These missiles are elemental homing projectile that target random enemies within 10 range around them, which deal armor-ignoring armor damage with Great Accuracy (Can never be missed). The element is based on the domain of the spell that granted the buff.

extras: Can be enhanced with weapon charges.
text.description:
Calls down a thunderbolt at a target enemy within 7 Range, dealing lightning magic damage to them. Damage is slightly lowered near maximum range. If enchanted with Redgull, the lightning may critically hit, dealing extra damage.

This spell can be enhanced with the usage of weapon charges.

Call down a thunderbolt at a target enemy within 5 Range, dealing Lightning magic damage to them. This spell can critically hit like an attack. If enchanted with Redgull, it may also inflict Interference on the target for 3 rounds.

Excel Crash: Level 1 - +10% Damage per Charge level. Level 2 - Damage pattern becomes a 2-size diamond and create Static Fields LV X (X = 5 +Charge*5) for 2 rounds within that area. Level 3 - Ignore Evasion.

text.powerRaw: 100%/110%/120% Water ATK, 100% Scaled WPN ATK, LV: 4/7/10
text.description:
Ninjutsu. Targets 1 empty tile in 3 Range (6 if on water), vanish into the ground like mist, and reappear at it. After, water pillars damage enemies in a 3 Size Diamond (+1 Size per 25 Lightning ATK, max 5), knocks them Airborne, may inflict Soaked (3 rounds), and leave Flooded Water (3 rounds, in 1 range). If you teleported onto water, gain Ryumai Suikan LV X (3 rounds, +1 per 25 Water ATK, max 5).

Furinkazan: Gain 1 Forest Mark

Kenpo. Targets 1 Airborne enemy in 1 Range and slams them to the ground with the force of a dragon, dealing weapon-based damage. If you Grappled the target, gains Great Accuracy. If the target was Spinning, can critically hit.

If you have at least 50 Scaled STR, the impact creates a shockwave that deals Earth damage to enemies and field objects in 3 Range. If you have at least 50 Scaled GUI, the target may be Knocked Down.

extras: Equipping this skill does not take up a Skill Pool slot.
text.description: Kensei often utilize multiple techniques in succession, turning their sword play into an art rather than a skill. When you deal damage to an enemy using a Kensei Offensive Skill, the next Kensei Offensive Skill this turn does not require any FP to use, and if it hits an enemy, it will deal elemental damage based off of your elemental ATK (each offensive Kensei skill uses a unique element; if you have a Starsign, its element will be used instead).

Targets all tiles within 1 Range of yourself, and all allies. All enemies in those tiles take Light magic damage (each enemy can only be damaged once). All allies also gain X% Dark Resistance (X = 5+Rank*5) until your next turn. For each enemy that is weak to Light, your Tactics Rank increases by 1 level.

Sometimes strategic sacrifices are required to protect something important. Targets an ally within 1 Range. Until your next turn, if the target ally is within 1 Range of you and takes damage from an enemy, you take that damage instead.

Serves you right! The Hexer takes glee in hitting a target while they're down, causing them to recover FP (based on Rank) when they hit an enemy who is suffering from at least one negative status effect.

extras: Equipping this skill does not take up a Skill Pool slot.
text.description: By turning on the safety of your gun, you will not consume Charge Shot or Overcharge when you attack. This skill can be toggled on and off during your turn for free.
Summon Spectral versions of your weapon that launch at all enemies within 8 range. dealing its damage type as magic damage to them. Enemies above Parted Pain's threshold take only half damage.

Sakki is a type of spiritual energy that gives off the intent to kill. Kensei possess the ability to suppress this energy, hiding their killing intent from enemies. When applied by Kagekiri or Hirazuki, it reduces the target's Critical Evade versus you for 3 rounds.

Unleash the flames of a volcanic spirit from your lantern, engulfing all enemies within 3 Range and dealing Fire magic damage to them. It can also inflict Burn LV X (2*Rank) for 3 rounds on those enemies.

(Damage/Heal and Effect Power/Duration/Chance from Lantern Activations are more effective when close and less effective when far.)

Eternal Flame: STR, CEL

Might as well keep the parts that still work! Targets one of your Engineer devices and destroys it. The target's cooldown is reset and you gain Scrap LV X% (based on Rank). Best used when the Bot might be broken by an enemy.

Scrap reduces the cost of the next Deploy skill by LV%.

Letting no rune go to waste, you quickly recover them if they're left unused. At the end of a battle, for every Rune left untriggered, you recover FP equal to 10 times it's rune level, effectively refunding the cost.

Bard Song skill. A spicy melody that really cuts to the heart of the matter. Play your instrument, gaining the Samba of Strength aura (+2 STR, +2 SKI, 5 Range), and giving all allies in 5 Range a bonus to their Scaled Weapon Attack and Critical for 3 rounds (based on Rank).

Creates a Sanctuary in a 2-5 Range circle around your current location. At the start of a new round, if you are not within the Sanctuary, it is dispelled. While active, all allies within it receive a bonus to DEF and RES, and all enemies within it receive a penalty to STR and WIL. In addition, special effect tiles cannot be created within the Sanctuary's confines. (The Sanctuary will be last for 5 rounds or until dispelled. Casting this spell again will remove the first Sanctuary.)
Sword Skill. A flourish of sword strikes, dealing Slash damage plus bonus damage for every enemy in the area of effect that is marked by Claret Call.

Targets 1 enemy within 1 Range, which is Knocked Down or Grappled by you. You lift the target and pull divine energy from their body.

This ends those conditions, but you deal armor-ignoring Light magic damage to the target, and gain Solcharges (based on Rank.)

Costs 10% of your maximum HP. Targets a 2 range circle up to 3 range away. All enemies in those tiles are pulled 2 tiles towards the centre, and then all enemies in the circle take Dark and Wind damage (split evenly), and have Claret Call applied (twice if in 2 range of the center).

Size and pull strength are increased based on Rising Game level. Sword and Axe weapons are valid casting tools.

Focus your mind and energy.

Increases your Hit and Critical by X (based on Rank) * your Schwarz Sturm level for 3 rounds.

The Boxer is an entity that relies on momentum and prediction, to which they have a unique, authentic quality. Once a Boxer gets started, you need to stop them as soon as possible, or things will just get worse.

Schwarz Sturm is a gauge that will increase when using most Boxer Skills, up to a maximum. Using a non-Boxer skill, even ones like Movement (except End Turn), will reset it to 0. Boosts Boxer skill power by 5% per level, and some skills will change based on it.
