There's always a bigger fish. For sea-faring enemies: +10% Damage Dealt, -10% Damage Taken. Also half effective versus Theno and Shaitan enemies.

Targets 1 ally in 5 Range and instills them with the magical instincts of the sea for 3 rounds. While active, Sea Stride lets them ignore the movement penalties of Flooded Water, and they will not trigger tile effects.

Aquae Crest: If LV 6 or higher, duration is increased by 2 rounds.

Create a magic sigil that enchants an ally within five range. Granting them Seal of Fortunes for 5 rounds. Seal of Fortunes: Unit gains +(3 x number of Positive Mage And/or Ruler effects they have) FP regeneration. If a servant automaton, also generate 1 LV of Automaton energy at start of a new round.

Create a magic sigil that enchants an ally within 5 range, granting them Seal of Labors for 5 rounds. If the target is a Servant Automaton, they also recover HP equal to LV. Seal of Labor: When unit deals damage via basic attack, applies a vampiric effect equal to 5 + ( 2x number of positive mage and/or Ruler effects they have)%.

Create a firestorm at the target area, dealing Fire magic damage to all in the area. It will also create Cinders for 3 rounds in the affected area, with a LV equal to 50% of your Fire ATK. If enchanted with Nerhaven, the AoE size is increased slightly.

Excel Crash: Level 1 - 10% Damage per charge level. Level 2 - rapidly melts ice sheets in the area of effect, granting a chance to inflict Burn Lv X (X = 10 + Charges*5) for 2 rounds on any enemy standing on one. Level 3 - Ignore Evasion.

Give an ally a second chance to get back up and fight. By targeting an ally with 0 HP, they regain HP based on this skill's Rank. The heal is equal to a percentage of their maximum HP, or the flat value, whichever is higher.

Dark Bard Song skill. Play a refreshing tune with your instrument, giving all allies in the same battle enough energy for a second set. All allies with Darkness Hype consume it to restore HP equal to its LV plus a bonus based on Rank, and for every 50 LV, they gain one (or more) of the following buffs in order: +5 HP Regen, +5 FP Regen, +5 Scaled Weapon Attack, +5 Hit, +5 Critical, and +5 to all stats, for 5 rounds.

The second verse? It's the same as the first. If you are Singing at the start of a new round, there is a chance (based on Rank and LUC) that all allies will have your currently active Bard effects extended caused by you by 1 round.

Who cares about consequences?

HP costs associated with Shapeshifter skills and effects are increased by 50%, but their cool downs are decreased by 1 round. If Shapeshifter is both your Main Class and Sub Class, HP costs are instead increased by 100%, and their cool downs are instead decreased by 2 rounds.

Ninjutsu. Evoke the powerful gusts of a protective whilrwind conjured by ninjutsu, which creates a Sensui Shippu at your current location (Rank based LV, 2 rounds, can only have 1 active). All enemies within 2 Range are also knocked back 2 tiles by the conjuring force.

Furinkazan: Gain 1 Wind Mark.

Your spiritual energy augments your strikes. You gain Critical equal to your Ki when using Fist weapons. In addition, at 20 Ki or higher, your Fist basic attacks will get a serpent's bite, dealing Acid magic damage equal to 100% of your Acid ATK on hit.

extras: Equipping this skill does not take up a Skill Pool slot.
text.description: The Aquamancer is not necessarily a force of purity; sometimes, they may worship or serve something 'darker'. While equipped, changes the functionality of most Aquamancer spells:

Targets a 1-X Range circle within 7 Range, and launches a sun-like Ki sphere. It will hover there for 3 rounds until it expires (or this skill is used again), where it will descend, dealing Fire magic damage that ignores evasion to all enemies in its radius.

Ki: Can be resized, +1 maximum size per 5 Ki to a max. of 5. Damage increases by 25% per 1 extra range. Consumes 3 Ki per range, even at the default size. (IE, default = 3, 1+ size = 6, etc).

Toggle skill. While active, if you have Bonded Youkai summoned, any source that restores your HP triggers this skill. When triggered, the healing is reduced by 70%, but you and all summoned Youkai will receive that healing together.

Toggle skill. While active, if you have Bonded Youkai summoned, damage taken by you or your Bonded Youkai triggers this skill. When triggered, the damage taken is reduced by 30%, but you and all summoned Youkai suffer that damage together.

Kensei Combo Skill. Strike your target with forceful sword blow. Deals Slash damage to 1 enemy within 1 range, and knock them back 3 tiles (this knockback ignores immunity effects.) If the sword you are using is a Katana-type, the Momentum cost is reduced by 1. If you are airborne, the damage is increased by 1.25x. If the target is airborne, they are also knocked down. (Airborne Compatible)

Sacred Art Effect: Earth physical damage.

Combo Effect: The target is swung around, hitting all enemies within 1 Range for half damage and knockback, then the normal skill effect takes place.
Hones your skill, boosting the effectiveness of your weapon, Grants a bonus to all weapons you use for 3 rounds. At Rank 5, the duration is 5 rounds instead.

Sword skill. Targets 1 tile in 5 Range. Put your sword in your sheath after facing target location; if it is a Katana, you also gain Quick Draw (LV X, until your next turn). If an enemy is in the target tile, you inflict them with Watchful Eye (1 round).

Quick Draw will be expended at the start of your next turn or after successfully triggering. If it doesn't trigger, you will gain Sacred Art at the start of the next round, if it is equipped.
Targets 1 of your bonded Youkai in range and instantly swaps places with them.

Costs 1% of your maximum HP. Can only be used if you are Installed with a Youkai. Making use of your shifted form, you perform a basic attack with a weapon unique to your Installed Youkai, which gains bonus Critical (based on Rank).

The special weapon's scaling tags are identical to your main hand weapon's, but it may have unique effects.

This skill requires a Rank C Invocation (see the Invocation talent for more details).

Summons a Shine Knight is summoned next to the caster. At Rank 1, they have the Protect skill. At Rank 2, they boost stats for nearby allies. At Rank 3, they reduce the Hit of nearby enemies. At Rank 4, basic attacks receive damage and range. (Shine Knights last until defeated.)

Rank 1: LV:20

Rank 2: LV: 30, Gains immunity to Dark/Light

Rank 3: LV: 40, gains Blinding aura.

Rank 4: LV: 50, Alondite weapon upgrade.

Rank 5: LV: 60, summons 2 Shine Knights instead of 1.

Targets 1 enemy within 5 Range away from the caster and deals Light magic damage to them. In addition, a Light Shaft is created at the target location for 3 rounds with a LV equal to half that. (A Light Shaft decreases the Hit of anyone who stands within it by LV.)

Sword skill. Swipes your sword against the ground, creating a gust of sharp wind that will travel up to 5 tiles, starting behind the tile directly in front of you. If it hits an enemy, they take Slash physical damage. In addition, if there is an enemy directly in front of you in the direction you use this skill in, you will perform a basic attack on them. If no enemy is attacked, the projectile's base Range is doubled. (Bonus damage is given to both based on Rank.)

The shinobi is adept at moving as swiftly as the wind. Targets 1 onuccupied tile within 3 Range and quickly teleports to it.

If you are not wearing Heavy Armor: +2 Range while on a Nest, +1 Range under Shukuchi, and +1 Range and -1 Momentum if monoclassing Shinobi.

If you are in a Nest, and step into another Nest, recover 1M.

Spend a few moments to shore up your defense, and prepare for the next attack. Can only be used while the Special armament is on cooldown. Resets the Special Armament's cooldown, restore your HP (based on rank), and reduce the duration of random negative status effect caused by an enemy by 3 rounds.

The true reward of a Performer is nothing but the gratitude of the listener. Boosts EXP gained, Murai found, and chance to find items after a battle by 10%. (Does not stack with skills of the same name.)

One of the most important parts of illusions are making them less obvious, which is easy enough with a shuffle of the deck. When toggled on, when you cast Create Shade, you switch places with one of the illusions at random.

A special martial art, named such because masters of it appear as if they use magic to get rid of the distance between themselves and their enemy. Increases your Move for 1 round, and causes your movement type to become Teleport.

While under the effects of Shukuchi, Geldoren and Light Tomahawk's Range is increased by the Move bonus. Using one of those skills on an enemy will teleport you next to them.

A shuriken wrap, when unrolled, allows a shinobi quick access to a valuable throwing weapon.

For Shinobi skills and Ninjutsu subtalents that can use a Shuriken, if no other valid item is equipped, a Shuriken in the Item Belt can also be used instead (if possible). Additionally, Shuriken in the Item Belt also count for Shinobi effects that care about the number of them equipped.
Sword skill. A quick forward stab in a line. You will attack all enemies in the line. The last square must be unoccupied, as you will end your travel there.

Your dances sometimes leave their own 'autograph' behind.

Dance skills that deal elemental damage have a chance to inflict an appropriate status effect (per damage hit) for 2 rounds, using a percentage of your normal infliction rate (based on Rank). The LV of these statuses are predetermined based on the type.

extras: If Silence is cured, immunity to Silence for 2 rounds
text.description: Offer a quiet prayer to Mercala, asking her to remove a specific hex. If the caster is under the effect of 'Silence', the effect is instantly cured. At Rank 3, if Silence is cured, the caster also gains immunity to Silence for 2 rounds.

Possesses 1 target enemy within 3 Range and forces them to attack you with their main weapon. If the main weapon is out of range, this skill will fail. You take reduced damage from this forced attack based on Rank.
Spear skill. Pull your spear in a quick motion along a diagonal line, performing an attack on all enemies in it as you move along it. The last tile in the line must be unoccupied.

Targets an enemy within X range (based on rank), causing your whip to wrap around them like a snake, dealing Blunt Physical damage to them. If it hits, you infuse your whip with geomancy and make the target Crystalized for 3 rounds.

Dance skill. An unarmed dance in a 1-3 Range line that must end in an unoccupied tile. You spin through the line, punching and kicking enemies, and every tile you move, you deal Blunt physical damage (based on Rank) to a random enemy within 1 Range. (Kick damage boosting effects apply to this skill's damage. Enemies can only be hit once per skill use.)

A crashing drop kick that slams into one enemy in 1 range, dealing blunt physical damage to them.

Ki: If used while airborne, and you have 5 or more Ki, 5 is consumed, increasing the damage dealt by 15% and knocking down the target. If the target is already knocked down, the damage is increased by 30% instead and target is inflicted with Immobilize for 2 rounds. Your airborne status then ends.
Spear skill. A swift spear move that launches a target upwards. Deals Pierce physical damage to the target, and makes them Airborne.

Kenpo. Create a circular cut in the shape of the moon, dealing Slash damage to all enemies in a 2 Size Circle around you. If you are Airborne you can target a unoccupied tile up to 3 Range away and teleport to it before performing the attack.

Dance skill. Spin your whip in a wild motion around yourself as you dance in a 3-5 range line that must end in an unoccupied tile. Everytime you move, a random enemy and 1 natural resource within 2 range are affected. Enemies take Slash Magic Damage (based on rank), while resources are Refined.

Trickery - Gain Ranged Attack Deflection Lv. 1 until your next turn.

Illusion skill. Creates a harmless but obstructive 3-6 length horizontal line of smoke up to 3 Range away. The smoke cannot be seen through, and anyone standing in it suffers a penalty to Hit (based on Rank). The smoke screen will last up to 3 rounds, but if you cast this spell while a smoke screen is active, or if the smoke screen would be moved by an effect, it will disappear.

Placed: Creates Smokescreen tiles LV X for 2 rounds in effective range (+1) if none exist. (LV = Rank x 3 + Rune Level).

Engrave: Attempts to inflict the target with Blind for 2 rounds.

Trigger: Attempts to inflict Blind for (1 + half of Rune Level) rounds to all enemies in effective range.

extras: This skill does not take up a Skill Pool slot.
text.description: Dance around your foe's attacks, frustrating them. While in Cobra Stance, when you evade an attack; Trickery - All Cobra skills' Momentum costs are reduced by 1 for 2 Rounds. (While the effect is active, it cannot be reapplied.)
Cobra Stance. Can only be used while Airborne, and must target an Airborne enemy. Applies the Grapple skill to the target (but does not activate bonus Grapple effects).

Bow Skill. Fire an arrow coated with poison at the target, performing a basic attack on them. If it hits, the target takes armor-ignoring acid magic bonus damage and may be inflicted with Poison LV X for 3 rounds (based on Rank).

If Dynamic Shooting is at Rank 4 or higher, if the target is already Poisoned, this skill instead inflicts Snake Wrap by twisting a rope around their legs, which halves Move until your next turn.

Performer Song skill. A song said to make even snakes dance with delight.

Play your instrument, dealing Acid magic damage and attempting to inflict Poison LV X (3 rounds; LV based on Rank) to all enemies within 5 Range. Affected enemies who are Charmed Snakemen or Serpentkind also have a chance to be inflicted with Confusion for 3 rounds.
Prepare to steal a spell. If you are targeted by an enemy spell which can be stolen before your next turn, you negate its casting and steal it as if you have Spell Snatched it.
They'll never see it coming. Damage dealt while you have Sneak active is increased by 10%.
The training to hit far-off marks, a proper 'snipe' requires precision and distance. Increases your Hit and Range with Bows.

Spear skill. Cannot be used while airborne. Take careful aim at an airborne enemy in 10 Range (but further than 2 Range) and throw your spear at them, dealing a large amount of Pierce physical damage to them. The powerful impact also applies or powers up Cursed Wound by half of its damage dealt for 3 rounds.

The Solblader utilizes the art of solmancy in a special way, focusing them into 'Solcharges', encapsuled fragments of light magic that they store in their weapons, which appear like miniature stars.

Allows you to gain Solcharges (max 6). Using this skill will convert the Momentum spent on it into an equal amount of Solcharges. Solcharges are used by Solblader skills and effects, but passively give +1 Light ATK per Solcharge.

Spear skill. Unleashes a piercing spear of solid light at a target enemy within 5 Range. On impact, it deals Pierce physical damage to the target, and the spear will remain in the target for up to 3 rounds. If the target takes Fire or Light damage, the spear will glow red and explode when the status expires, dealing Fire magic damage (100% Fire ATK).

You snap your fingers, causing a target Rune within 7 Range to fly forward in it's current direction up to 5 tiles. Moving this way can cause the rune to link up with other runes, as well as trigger on enemies in it's effective range.

Deals 10 damage to the rune after forcing it to move.
Targets two locations. Location 1 must contain one of your Runes. When used, the selected rune will turn to face Location 2.

The blessed art of the Solblader. Targets 1 unoccupied tile within 3 Range and creates a sphere of light called a permanent Solsphere at it. You can only have 1 active at a time.

This is a special, sun-like field tile that is created by the Solblader class. Only 1 can be active at a time, it can't be destroyed, and its placement can't be stopped by effects like Priest's Sanctuary.

When you enter the same tile as your Solsphere, you gain Holy Aura until your next turn. When your Solsphere and an enemy encounter each other, they take armor-ignoring magic bonus Light damage equal to X + 50% of Light ATK (X = half of Solblader level). This can only occur once per action.

The Solsphere can be interacted with by many Soldier base class skills. If you target the Solsphere with one, the following effects will occur (this will apply even if an enemy and the Solsphere are in the same tile).

Performer Song skill. A haunting tone that invites darkness.

Play your instrument, inflicting all enemies in 5 Range with Song of Susceptibility, which lowers their Status Resistance by LV (based on Rank), for 3 rounds.

Arcane skill. A fast, magical arrow that screeches painfully past enemies. Deals Sound magic damage to 1 enemy within 5 Range. If the target is wearing heavy armor or is your Marked Target, or an ally who is singing, the arrow resonates, applying to all other units in 3 range. Allies affected gain Sound ATK Up LV (Rank * 5, x1.5 if Annorum enhanced) for 3 rounds.

Annorum: Chance to inflict Silence for 3 rounds, and shatters ice sheets.

Shell: 5 x S.P. Armor-Ignoring Sound DMG. Bonus: 10 x S.P. Sound DMG, chance to inflict Silence/2 rounds. High Charge: If Safety is Off: Attack becomes an auto-hit. Chance to inflict Knocked Down. User gains Sonic Speed LV X (2 x H.P.)/5 rounds.

extras: Target cannot recover FP for the 2/2/3/3/4 Rounds
Target is treated as if they were Installed with a Youkai. For the same duration, you cannot summon the Youkai
text.description: Can only be used if you have a Youkai installed. The Youkai's astral form jumps to target enemy within 3 Range for X rounds (based on Rank), ending the Install. During this time, that enemy cannot recover FP, and is treated as if they were Installed with a Youkai. For the same duration, you cannot summon the Youkai.
Must be used by an Instrument weapon. Unleashes a wave of sound in a 4 Range line as a projectile, which will pierce through enemies and deal Sound magic damage.

Gain a blessing from the southern winds of avoidance, increasing your evasion. If you are closer to the south edge of the battlefield than the north edge, you gain additional Evade. This bonus lasts for 3 rounds.

A special modification to an arcane gun that allows it to steal focus from enemies. At a percentage based on rank, when you land a Critical Hit on an enemy with a Gun weapon, you will automatically become charged as if by Charge Shot. Once activated, this skill is put on a 2 round cooldown.

Allows the Arbalest to equip any Sword, Axe, or Spear as a sub-weapon. When a weapon of one of those types (or any type if monoclassing Arbalest) is equipped a sub-weapon, it is fired when using Cannon skills. See Arbalest Cannon Skills for more details.

These skills have special requirements in order to be used; you must have a Bow or Rifle weapon in your main hand, and a sub-weapon of certain types (Sword, Axe, Spear) equipped.

After using one of these skills, you enter a Reloading state for 4 rounds. This is essentially a global cooldown for all Arbalest Cannon skills; they cannot be used until the cooldown ends. You may end it prematurely by using Shore Up.

While on cooldown, your sub-weapon will be inaccessible, as if it weren't equipped; you won't be able to use it with skills, and its item effects won't apply.
What is the point of being able to use something if you can't use it from really far away? Increases the Range of Item, Upgrade, and Deploy skills.

Solblader Style skill (only 1 can be equipped, doesn't take up a skill pool slot). A quick and tricky type of Solblading.

Passive: Allows Solblader and Soldier Offensive skills (except spells) to utilize Combination Fighter, successively reducing Momentum costs but also damage for those skills. Holy Aura Bonus: Also increases your Evade by 15. Holy Aura Triggered: Immediately gain 1 stack of Combination Fighter (max 2).

The trademark skill of the Spellthief. Targets 1 enemy within 1 Range and attempts to steal a spell from them. Bosses are immune. If successful, you steal the spell and add it to your skill pool as a Copy spell, and the target loses it.

Copy spells are lost if unequipped and do not take up any skill pool slots, but function normally otherwise. You can have a maximum of 1+Rank Copy spells (stealing another one while at max will remove the oldest). All Copy spells will be lost if you begin a battle without Spellthief as one of your classes.

extras: This skill does not take up any Skill Pool slots.
text.description: Turning the shot into spell energy, the Ranger is capable of using their well placed shots to amplify the Arcane. When you score a critical hit with Bow weapons, you generate 1 Annorum charge.

Requires a Rank D Invocation. When cast, summons an invisible spectre that will loom around the battlefield for 5 rounds. At the start of each Round, a random enemy will be possessed by the spectre. If a possessed unit attacks, the attack will be negated, and they will suffer Dark damage that ignores armor based on Rank. You will also recover HP equal to the Dark damage.

extras: Every round, Youkai who are unsummoned and not at 0 HP regain 2/4/6/8/10 HP and FP.
text.description: As beings that live in the ether, youkai are more quickly able to recover when in it. Every round, Youkai who are unsummoned and not at 0 HP regain HP and FP based on the Rank of this skill.
The Grand Summoner's body and soul are much like a well, only it collects Focus instead of water. Increases maximum FP based on Rank. At max Rank, maximum FP is further increased by +3.

Allows you to have Bonded Youkai and increases their maximum possible level (max. 60). The following conditions are required to have a Bonded Youkai.

Your total contracts must not exceed the Rank of this skill.

The friendship of that Youkai must be above average (50%).

If you do not satisfy the first condition, no Youkai you have will be treated as Bonded. If you do not satisfy the second condition, only the Youkai with low friendship will not be treated as Bonded.
Pure spiritual power, to put it simply. Increases WIL passively. if at max Rank, further increases WIL by +1.

You generate a special energy called Ki, which is a type of spiritual energy. You gain Ki based on Rank every round, to a maximum of 30. The rate is doubled if Monk is both your Main Class and your Sub Class.

Targets 1 enemy within 6 Range and inflicts Water magic damage to them, which inflicts Soaked on them for 5 + Tactics Rank rounds. Soaked enemies will cause Lightning damage taken by them to jump to adjacent allies who are also Soaked. If the enemy is weak to Water, your Tactics Rank increases by 1 level.

Costs 5% of your maximum HP, and can only be used while Installed with a Youkai. Split your installed Youkai from you and summon them to a target unoccupied location within X Range (based on Rank), increasing their Momentum to 3 (if possible). The split also causes your copiable, non-permanent beneficial status effects to have their duration halved, but the split Youkai will receive all of them as well.
Utilizing staves gives the Priest a unique source of power, which causes their WIL and FAI to increase by 1 for every Staff Battle Item they have equipped in their Item Belt.

Parry skill (only one takes effect at a time.)

Grants the ability to parry attacks and skill damage (excluding spells) from Sword, Axe, Spear, or monster weapons, at a chance equal to half of your Scaled DEF + a bonus based on Rank. When triggered, damage is reduced by 50%. If the attacker was within 1 Range, and you have a weapon with 15 Weight or more equipped, they are also inflicted with Flatfoot LV 1 until their next turn.

You can only parry attacks you can see.

extras: Equipping this skill does not take up a Skill Pool slot.
text.description: Defensive Knowledge skill. Used to holding their ground, the Magic Gunner's confidence allows them to intercept attacks made at them, increasing Phys. Def by 1% by 20% of your Scaled WIL. (Multiple Defensive Knowledge skills will not stack).

Requires 3 Solcharges. Targets the tile in front of you, which must be unoccupied. Creates a Fading Solsphere at that location, which moves forward up to 3 tiles, activating if it encounters an enemy.

Fading Solspheres are the same as regular Solspheres, but last only the round they are created. You can have 1 Solsphere and 1 Fading Solsphere active at the same time.

extras: Can be empowered by Weapon Charges.
text.description:
A trickshot, launching several arrows into the air and raining them down long-range onto the targets. Deals Pierce physical damage to all within the Area of Effect. Additional ranks in the skill will increase its range.

If Dynamic Shooting is at Rank 3 or higher, the damage is increased by 35% of your Scaled SKI.

LV1 - +10% Damage per Charge Level

LV2 - Arrows explode after a short delay, dealing Fire magic bonus damage to all enemies in those tiles equal to 100% Fire ATK. You also attack any attackable field objects in those tiles.

LV3 - Ignores Evasion.

Any weapon that uses this skill can consume active Weapon Charges to gain these effects, depending on the amount consumed.

Charges the air around yourself or target ally, increasing their LUC. In addition, it will deal Lightning damage equal to Rank*5 when you evade an enemy attack (once). Also grants a special skill called Static Excel that uses up the buff to quickly activate Charge Weapon.

Take something from another for yourself! But only the good things. And only status effects. At a chance equal to your Scaled CEL + a bonus based on Rank, you can take up to 1 beneficial status effect from the target for yourself.

extras: Equipping this skill does not take up a Skill Pool slot.
text.description: Traps can be effective in certain situations. Even if your enemy knows there's a trap, that doesn't mean they can ignore [it]. Hidden traps are even better. When you place a trap, after a short arming animation, the traps disappears from the view of everyone.

Target a tile containing Flooded Water or Dark Water, or a unit with Soaked or Frozen status and quickly heats the water, causing it to evaporate rapidly. Ends Flooded Water, Soaked, and Frozen on that tile, and if an enemy, then deals Fire magic damage to them. It may also inflict Burn LV X (X = Rank * 5) for 3 rounds.

Aquae Crest: If LV 5 or higher, +10% Status Infliction and +25% damage to Jammer enemies.
The Black Knight gains the power of Negation, preventing weapons with On Hit and On Critical effects from utilizing them when attacking the Black Knight for X rounds (based on Rank).
Either through a magical ability or sheer will, the Black Knight purges all Poison effects with a LV equal to or less than X, based on Rank.
The Black Knight takes a moment to re-evaluate their defenses. Reduces the duration of all negative status effects caused by another unit that reduce your Defense or Phys defense by Rank rounds.
The knights' code lets the Black Knight remove certain mental status effects from themself. Depending on the Rank of this skill, more status effects are removed.

Does not cost SP to equip. While equipped, Wild Shape skills will not change your appearance.

The Druid has the ability to use Wild Shape skills to Wild Shapeshift into various animal forms, changing their appearance and giving them access to certain skills while in that form.

While in a Wild Shape, you cannot cast spells, your race changes to match that of your new form (changing your base stats), and you gain access to a special basic attack, as well as certain skills (similar to those possessed by an Animal Companion). If those skills reference Rank, they are treated as max Rank (3) instead of whatever your Animal Companion skill's rank would be, as you are using the skill as an animal, not a companion.

You can change from one animal form into another without changing back. You can also use End Wild Shape, a 0M skill, to exit your form. However, bear in mind that End Wild Shape has a 1 round CD, so you will be stuck in your Wild Shape should you use it and then transform again. In battle, you will remain in your chosen Wild Shape until you transform again or end it manually.

You cannot use Wild Shape while you are Installed with a Youkai, and attempting to install a Youkai while in Wild Shape will fail.

If you want to use this in your RP, please keep the following in mind:

Druids that are in Wild Shape appear to be animals, but their presence is easy to notice and it is obvious to anyone on sight that they are not a normal animal (excluding brief glances, or the dimwitted). This form requires concentration to maintain, and can be kept for 1 hour concurrently at most, after which the Druid will require rest equal to the amount of time spent shapeshifting before the ability can be used again. Using Wild Shape to shift between forms, or briefly revert to a humanoid form, is treated as one continuous 'use'.

Animals are incapable of speech and therefore cannot talk in a way that is understandable, hence why they cannot cast spells.

You cannot partially Wild Shape yourself; you must take on (or revert from) the full form of the animal. IE, you can't use this ability to grow animal ears or tails, you can't turn only your head into a snake's, and so on.

Special Arrows skill.

Stone Arrows increase the power of Bow attacks and skills that use Special Arrows by 2* Rank, but reduce the range of those by 1 and increase your Battle Weight by 5. Being enchanted with Galren will increase the Power by 1 per Rank, and will negate the Battle Weight penalty.

Send a dragon made of stone flying from the earth in a line from target location. The longer the distance it travels, the more Earth magic damage it will deal to the first enemy hit. If the dragon travels within 1 square of someone under the effect of Astral Belt, it boosts the damage by its LV*4. If enchanted with Galren, the dragon will crumble into dense rocks that last for 2 rounds, after it finishes.

extras: Perform Basic attack with Special Armament
text.description:
Arbalest Cannon skill.

Raises your special armament and fires it at a target within 6 Range, performing a basic attack with a Hit penalty based on its Weight. If it hits, you also perform a basic attack with the Special armanent on the same target, which cannot miss but deals 50% normal damage.

Hex Skill. Hex Skill can only target those with a specific status effect, and it will then reset the duration of the status effect (based on Rank; the duration of the Hex is the same) and inflict a Hex on the target. Etacof will strangle the target from beyond the gates of death, preventing Silence from being cured and causing it to reduce the victim's HP and FP by 5% of their maximum values every round.
A new twist on an old favorite. When playing the Samba of Strength, all affected allies also gain +X Critical for 2 attacks/3 rounds. (X = 3*Samba of Strength's Rank.)

Treatment skill. Targets 1 ally (or yourself) within 1 Range and removes any Fear effect they are suffering from. If you have a Staff-type weapon equipped, the Range of this skill is increased by 3. At Rank 2, Hesitation is also affected. At Rank 3, Knockdown is also affected.

extras: +10 (+20 if your Main and Sub Class are both Rune Magician)
text.description:
Having refined your rune crafting skills, your runes are sturdier than normal, granting them +10 HP (Or +20 HP if both your Main and Sub Class are both Rune Magician)

Runes start with 10 HP and each attack on them takes away 10 HP.

Fist Skill. Deals a hard blow to the gut of an enemy within 1 Range, inflicting Blunt damage and reducing their FP by your Schwarz Sturm level. It can also inflict Silence for 2 rounds at a rate of 30% of your normal Status Infliction, plus 10% per Schwarz Sturm level. If the target is Flatfooted, this skill can critically hit (25% damage).

It is painfully obvious when a Black Knight is unaffected by a strike. When an enemy deals physical damage equal to or less than your Scaled SKI+5, they are Feared for 3 rounds. In addition, enemies who you have Feared suffer -15 Critical Evade versus you.

Grants you access to an Animal Companion, the Bear, a bulky and disruptive momma bear. Passively grants access to the skills Bear Bash (Call), Bear Hug (Call), and Bear Zerk (Call).

Targets 1 tile within 5 Range and summons the Bear to it, or targets the Bear and unsummons in. Unsummoning the Bear recovers 2M, but puts it on a 1 round CD (+1 round if the Bear was at less than 50% HP).

Grants you access to an Animal Companion, the Hawk, a flying eye in the sky. Passively grants access to the skills Hawk Strike (Call), Hawk Glide (Call), and Hawk Gale (Call).

Targets 1 tile within 5 Range and summons the Hawk to it, or targets the Hawk and unsummons in. Unsummoning the Hawk recovers 2M, but puts it on a 1 round CD (+1 round if the Wolf was at less than 50% HP).

Grants you access to an Animal Companion, the Viper, a sneaky and swift snake. Passively grants access to the skills Viper Venom (Call), Viper Antivenom (Call), and Viper Wrap (Call).

Targets 1 tile within 5 Range and summons the Viper to it, or targets the Viper and unsummons in. Unsummoning the Viper recovers 2M, but puts it on a 1 round CD (+1 round if the Wolf was at less than 50% HP).

Grants you access to an Animal Companion, the Wolf, a powerful hunting beast. Passively grants access to the skills Wolf Run (Call), Wolf Howl (Call), and Wolf Agility (Call).

Targets 1 tile within 5 Range and summons the Wolf to it, or targets the Wolf and unsummons in. Unsummoning the Wolf recovers 2M, but puts it on a 1 round CD (+1 round if the Wolf was at less than 50% HP).

extras: Summon 2/3/4/5/6 unsummoned Youkai at random, to random unoccupied squares on the battlefield.
text.description:
This skill requires a Rank D Invocation (see the Invocation talent for more details). Create a massive explosion of focus around you, summoning X unsummoned Youkai (based on Rank) at random, to random unoccupied squares on the battlefield..

"Open the gate to another world..."

You put your hands in front of your face and release a blinding flash of light. Requires and consumes 15 Ki. All enemies within 1 Range are inflicted with Blind for 2 rounds. All other enemies have a luck-based chance to be inflicted with Blind for 2 rounds. All enemies also take armor-ignoring Light magic damage equal to 15 * Rank.

The ability to control and contain your ki is highly valuable for a Monk. While toggled on, offensive skills (excluding Kadouha and Setting Sun) that utilize Ki will treat your Ki as 0, and won't consume any Ki when used.
Caster and target swap positions, faced directions, and airborne states, as if both had stepped on the new location. If the target was Airborne and the target was not, the target is Knocked Down.

Spin your body and rock it back and forth unpredictably.

Targets yourself or 1 unoccupied tile within 1 Range; you being Swaying (LV X, until your next turn) and move to that tile (without changing directions).

As a master of speed and hand to hand combat, the shinobi is quite effective at grappling.

Targets 1 enemy within 1 range and applies the Grapple skill to them (no bonus effects). If you are in the tile behind the target, the Grapple success rate increases by 25%
Accelerates your movements, allowing you to quickly set the stage. For one round, your Rune spells cost 1 Momentum less. (To a minimum of 1.)

Spear skill. Can only be used while airborne and must end in an unoccupied tile. You fly forward, sweeping over a 2-5 Range line, dealing Pierce physical damage to all enemies in it, blowing them airborne with a powerful gust of wind.
Being a Bonder means putting your trust in your Youkai allies to cover your weaknesses. As such, this skill increases the WIL and FAI of the character, based on Rank.

extras: Allows you to use the Youkai's Evoke-Active skill.
Allows you to use the Youkai's Evoke-Passive skill.
text.description: An advanced summoning method called 'Evoking', whereby a Youkai is only partially summoned, and its powers are channeled through the Summoner. This allows the Summoner to utilize some of the Youkai's power themself. (You do not gain any benefits while the Youkai's HP is 0.)

Synchronize your mind with your Youkai's, granting them bonus stats (based on Rank) for 3 rounds after being Summoned. If you have only one Bonded Youkai, you also gain the effects of this skill when applied.

Enchants yourself or a target party member with an elemental, increasing Wind ATK, CEL and Move. However, hosting an elemental also has its drawbacks; you take 1.25x Earth damage while enchanted. This effect lasts for 3 rounds. You cannot cast this spell on a character already enchanted with an elemental.

Fill your arcane tattoos with power, allowing you to re-activate Arcane Tattoo trait effects. You also gain Tattoo Refresh for 2 rounds, which doubles the effectiveness of your Arcane Tattoo Evoker skill.

extras: Increases Skill Pool size by 0.5 for every Engineer skill equipped.
text.description: Knowing your designs in and out, doing things over and over to get them right to the point of insanity. What word could you use besides 'marvelous'?

extras: Equipping this skill does not take up a Skill Pool slot.
text.description: Toggle skill. A term used in Oniga for someone who is holding back. While toggled on, damage you deal will not reduce an enemy below 1 HP.
A type of physical stamina that works well in long, drawn-out battles. You regain HP every round.

You strike the ground with your fist at a location within 1 Range. Any enemy there takes physical Blunt damage and inflicts them with Slow LV3 until your next turn. Also destroys enemy-created tiles in that tile.

Ki: Gains 1 Range per 5 Ki, (max. 6). If the tile is more than 1 Range away, you launch a Ki dragon towards that location, applying its effect at it, dealing Earth damage instead and increasing damage by 100% of Earth ATK. (Costs 1 Ki per range).

extras: Allows you to enter summoning houses and converse with youkai.
text.description: An agreement with an unknown entity, stating that you choose this fate of your own free will. It grants you the title and abilities of a 'Summoner'.

Time to teach them what a real show is like.

Targets a 2-4 Size Ring of tiles around you and creates a Shadow Mosh at each of those locations (except locations occupied by a unit, dense tile, or Shadow Mosh).

Leave a little mark when you pass, just like bumping against a thorny vine. While you have at least one Dagger weapon equipped, when you move over a tile, any enemy located in that tile will be slashed by you, dealing up the X damage (based on Rank) equal to your Dagger's Power, of your dagger's damage type. This damage ignores protection.

If both of your classes are Rogue classes, the damage cap is doubled.
Spear skill. Pierce an enemy within 2 Range with a flurry of stabs, dealing Pierce physical damage, plus 100% of your Scaled STR. (Elementals may substitute STR for a different stat if it's higher.)

The rush you get from stealing something is not an experience everyone gets. For those who do, however, it is a strong rush of adrenaline. When you successfully steal something from an enemy, you gain +2 to all stats for 2 rounds.

Toss your daggers as if they were projectiles. You can utilize 1 LV of Throwing Daggers to increase the basic attack range of your Dagger weapons by 3. You start battle with LV X (based on Rank), and gain 1 at the start of a new round, up to a maximum of 3. (If both classes are Rogue classes, you gain 2 at the start of a new round instead.)

Arcane skill. Targets a 5 Range cross pattern and deals Lightning damage to all enemies in it. If you are airborne, it can target up to 10 range away.

Annorum: Leaves behind a quaking bolt at the center, which explodes next round, dealing Sound magic damage to all enemies hit and knocking them down.

extras: Equipping this skill does not take up a Skill Pool slot.
text.description: A further augment to the Spark Drive that causes it to draw too much energy from the target. If Spark Drive would trigger while you already have a Charge Shot prepared, you become Overcharged.

Dance skill. Leap into the air and crash down with the awe-inspiring effect of thunder. Targets 2 unoccupied tiles; you will leap to the first one, and then the second one. Each time you land at one of these locations, you deal Lightning magic damage (based on your Lightning ATK and Rank) to a random enemy within 2 Range.

If there is not an enemy within 3 range of you after using this skill, it is put on a 2 round cooldown.

Sometimes it's best to know when to go. A retreat is a much less costly strategic move than a defeat. When escaping from battle, the success rate is increased by 20% for every player character's HP that is below 25%. If at Tactics Rank S or higher, the success rate becomes 100%.

Launches a spinning wind blade projectile up to 6 Range away, dealing Wind magic damage to the first enemy it hits. They will also be inflicted with Titan Ghost LV X (X = Wind ATK) for 10 rounds. (Titan Ghost transfers upon the unit being defeated, which refreshes its duration to 5 rounds. After doing so at least once, if the person with the status is an ally, it increases their Scaled Weapon Power by LV.) If the enemy is weak to Wind, your Tactics Rank increases by 1 level.

Kensei Combo skill. Draw your sword with such precision and speed that it kicks up razor-sharp wind that deals Slash damage to all enemies in a crescent pattern. If the sword you are using is a Katana-type, the Momentum cost is reduced by 1. The size of the pattern can be changed using the +/- keys.

Sacred Art Effect: Wind physical damage.

Combo Effect: Affected tiles that have field objects are blown away 3 tiles away from you.

Nothing beats a good tome, and there as many as there are Mages. Grants +5 Hit with Tome weapons. When dealing damage with a Tome of a damage type that matches the Tome's, or its material's element, grants an additional +5 Hit.
An Engineer is only as good as their belt, which is often filled with tools, gadgets, or emergency items. Increases the size of your Item Belt.

Touki is a type of spiritual energy that shows the will to fight. Hiding it from your enemies will make them feel less threatened just before your attacks, causing their evasion to be sloppy or mistimed. When applied by Toiken or Raijinken, It reduces the target's Evade versus you for 3 rounds.
A Bard is used to loud noises - music, singing, the crowd cheering (or booing...). As such, sound has a lesser effect on them, increasing their Sound damage resistance by 10%.
Throwing punches and kicks all the time tends [to] make you good at it. Increases Hit when attacking with a Fist weapon.

Targets 2 tiles in 8 Range. Location 1 must contain one of your plant tiles (except non-Bloomed Druid Plants), and Location 2 must be an empty tile containing no plants. A flash of druidic magic instantly relocates that plant to a new location.
Imagine the look of surprise on your enemy's face when there's suddenly three of you. When toggled on, at the start of a battle, if Create Shade is in your skill pool, you cast it for free.

extras: No longer take up a skill pool slot.
text.description: Instruments get worn out, just as much as the person playing them; a little maintenance here and there goes a long way. At the end of a battle, any Instrument weapon(s) you have equipped regain 1-3 durability.
Spear skill. Stab your target, dealing Pierce physical damage, and slam them into the tile directly behind you. Turning enemies over onto battle field objects, such as rocks, may have bonus effects.

On the battlefield, true Rogues tend to prefer to strike quick and often. When you Attack or Sub-Attack while you have two non-Bow weapons equipped of the same weapon type, you will attack with the other, but this attack deals significantly reduced damage if it hits. (Attack target must be in 1 Range unless using Shuriken weapons. Mutated weapons may not qualify.)

Fires two shots from your bow which travel diagonally in the direction you are facing. The first enemy hit by each projectile will take Pierce physical damage, which can critically hit, based on Rank. If the projectile hits an enemy, it also applies on-hit effects of the bow weapon that fires it.

Active: Can only be used if you are installed with a Bonded Youkai. Ends the Install.

Passive: Increases install duration with bonded Youkai.

If you have only one bonded Youkai, and you are Install with it. You gains the effect of Fight As One.

Releases a gust of wind from the king of the skies, dealing Wind magic damage to all enemies within 3 Range and knocking them back. If a knocked back enemy is Airborne, they are also Knocked Down.

(Damage/Heal and Effect Power/Duration/Chance from Lantern Activations are more effective when close and less effective when far.)

Eternal Flame: CEL, SKI

Requires 2 Geomaterial. Create a permanent Tyrant's throne under you (only 1 can be active). While on your throne, you can use the Sit on Throne skill. While sitting on your throne, you gain a bonus to DEF/RES/CEL/LUC/STR equal to it's LV x 2, immunity to knockback/pull, and knocked down and gain LV attack range for whip attack, but you are immobile. This effect lasts until your next turn.
Martial Artists typically do not like armor weighing them down. This skill grants them bonus Evade while using an Unarmored torso.

Unleashes a burst of purple flame at a target enemy within 4 Range, dealing magic damage split between Fire and Dark. There is also a chance that enemy will be inflicted with Burn LV X (8*Rank) for 3 rounds.

The holy light pierces all it reaches.

While you have Holy Aura active, your Light damage pierces Absorb, Reflect, and Immunity affinities.

Solmancy and Solblading go hand in hand. A rather natural talent, only used by certain spellblading types.

Once per round, casting a Mercalan domain spell from a non-Solblader class, using Pray, or scoring a critical hit, automatically grants 1 Solcharge.

Dance skill. Slide along the ground, on your knees (or whatever is appropriate, if you don't have knees), playing your instrument as you do. You target an unoccupied tile within 4 Range and move in a line to it. Every time you move across a tile, you deal Dark magic damage (based on your Dark ATK and Rank) to a random enemy within 2 Range.

Trickery - You play the first Bard song you have equipped automatically for free.

Every move a Black Knight makes should be deliberate. Until your next turn, inflicts Immobilize and Unmoving on yourself. Unmoving prevents pull and push effects from affecting you, and grants immunity to Vydel's movement effects (though you still take damage).

Upgrade skill. Targets an ally within 2 Range. Equips that target with a shield module, which allows them to use the Electro Shield skill. (The skill level for it will be equal to your skill level, or the target's skill level, whichever is higher). They also gain a bonus to Critical, based on rank.

Upgrade skill. Targets an ally within 2 Range. Equips that target with a flamethrower module, which allows them to use the Flamethrower skill. (The skill level for it will be equal to your skill level, or the target's skill level, whichever is higher). They also gain a bonus to Power, based on rank.

Upgrade skill. Targets an ally within 2 Range. Equips that target with a jetpack module, which allows them to use the Jetpack skill. (The skill level for it will be equal to your skill level, or the target's skill level, whichever is higher). They also gain a bonus to Evade, based on rank.

Upgrade skill. Targets an ally within 2 Range. Equips that target with a grenade launcher module, which allows them to use the Grenade Launcher skill. (The skill level for it will be equal to your skill level, or the target's skill level, whichever is higher). They also gain a bonus to Hit, based on rank.

extras: This skill does not take up any Skill Pool slots.
text.description: Toggle skill. What's better than having a special attack? Having a secret special attack. While toggled on, when you use a Martial Artist Offensive skill (or Meditate), you will be prompted to enter a series of directions. If you enter them all successfully, the skill will gain some manner of bonus effect. (Failure has no penalty.)
The ability to use staves effectively. Further ranks increase your Staff Effectiveness, which reduces the FP Cost and increase the maximum Range of Staff skills by the same value.

Genpo skill. Give life to the shadows, investing uncertainty in the mind of 1 enemy within 3 Range, attempting to inflict them with Usuake (LV X, 3 rounds, +1 per 25 Dark ATK, max 5), which can critically hit; if it does, they are also inflicted with Confusion (2 Rounds)

Standing in Darkness doubles the Range. LV is doubled against non-boss monsters.
Does not cost SP to equip. While equipped, Chaotic Form will not change your appearance.

Spear skill. Uses 3+M (1+M if Firebird is your main class). Airborne compatible. Flourishes your Spear around you defensively, granting Guard LV X (X = 10 per Momentum used). If at least 3 Momentum is used, you will also deflect up to 1 Bow or Gun attack. If you are Airborne, you gain the ability to avoid Guard Break once.

Shell: 5 x S.P. Armor-Ignoring Dark DMG and restore HP equal to half DMG dealt Bonus: 10 x B.P. Dark DMG and steal FP equal to half the DMG dealt High Charge: 10 x H.P. Dark DMG, and steal 2 of all the target's stats (except VIT)/3 rounds.

Dagger skill. Consumes 10 Void Energy. Targets 2 locations. In Location 1, there must be an enemy, and Location 2 must be an unoccupied tile. The enemy in L1 takes Pierce damage, based on Rank, and is teleported to your current location. Afterwards, you teleport to L2.

Removes your Voidveil and consumes the energy it collected, gaining Critical equal to the stored energy for X turns (based on Rank). Your Void Energy then becomes 0. While you are under this effect, Voidveil's effects are negated.

A flowery, two-weapon style using both sword and spear. When you have a Sword and Spear equipped at the same time (must be two weapons), you gain a bonus to SKI and DEF, and reduce the FP cost of all Duelist base class skills by 2+Rank. (Min. FP Cost: 0)

When you get your hands on a lot of completely legitimate items, you get interested in them. So much so that you effortlessly do what most mages can't, memorizing and mastering the art of magic through pure talent.

Spells do not take up skill pool slots.

Utilize your power to cause the flames created by your chain's oil to destroy everything. When created, causes oil chain's fires to destroy Hardiness 1 Field Objects made by enemies, leaving behind a smokescreen Lv20 for 3 rounds if it does.
Create a circuit of void energy back into your veil through lightning. When you score a lightning critical, you generate Void Energy, based on Rank.
Carried into the air by another dimension. When a unit, including yourself, is teleported by a Void Assassin skill, that unit becomes Airborne.

When an allied projectile encounters one of your Voidgates, it disappears, but a copy of that projectile will shoot from every other Voidgate you own in a cardinal direction towards the nearest enemy.
Retain your energy as much as possible, at any cost. If you would consume at least 2 Void Energy, reduce the amount by half, but take Null damage equal to the amount reduced.

Targets an empty location or Voidgate in Range. Location: Creates a Voidgate at the target location for X rounds (based on Rank). Voidgate: You leap into the Void and instantly reappear at the Voidgate's location. Teleporting refunds 2M and half the cost of the skill.

If, instead. The Voidgate is Frayed, you manipulate it into firing, but also reduce its duration by 1.

While wearing an armor made of a Cloth material, it is covered in an almost invisible mesh called the Voidveil. When you take magic damage, you reduce the damage by X% of the damage and gain a special Void energy equal to twice that amount (based on Rank; if Void Assassin is not your main class, no damage reduction is applied). Void Energy is used by other Void Assassin skills, and it persists through multiple battles.

Tactical Formation skill. Create a ranged formation at a location within 5 range. Which boosts the attack range (and range before Farshot penalty applies), and critical of ranged weapons for allies inside of it for 3 rounds.

Range increased by 1 per scaled GUI. Duration increased by 1 round if a tome is equipped.
Crank up the volume. For 3 rounds, boosts your Sound ATK, and the range of your Bard class Song skills (based on Rank).

extras: Equipping this skill does not take up a Skill Pool slot.
text.description: The owner of this skill is familiar with traversing water as easily as land. Ignore the movement penalty caused by walking on Flooded Water.

extras: Can be enhanced with weapon charges.
text.description:
Creates a sharp gust of wind around a target enemy within 4 Range, dealing Wind magic damage to them. If enchanted with Talvyd, it also has a chance to inflict Lingering Damage LV (10 + Rank * 5) for 3 rounds.

This spell can be enhanced with the usage of weapon charges.

This skill requires a Rank D Invocation (see the Invocation talent for more details).

Creates a tornado that rampages through a 3 tile wide, 12 tile long line. Enemies in the path of the tornado are sucked up and taken along for the ride. Afterwards, they are spit out to a random, unoccupied tile, and take Wind magic damage. If enchanted with Talvyd, all enemies are knocked down when they are thrown from the tornado.

"Cut and scatter, fly and disappear..."
Those who walk in darkness prepare themselves for pain unlike any other. Passively increases your DEF and RES based on Rank.

Solblader Style skill (only 1 can be equipped, doesn't take up a skill pool slot). A slow and sturdy type of Solblading.

Passive: Reduces the Range of Solblader Offensive skills that move you by 1 or 2 Range, but increases the damage they deal by 15%. Holy Aura Bonus: Also increases Armor and Magic Armor by 5. Your Protect skill gains +3 activation Range. Reduces redirected damage you take by 10%. Holy Aura Triggered: Gain Swift Guard LV 20 until your next turn.
A protection against magic that the Lantern Bearer's lantern leaks, increases RES passively. If at max Rank, RES is further increased by +1.

Place/Resonate: Creates stone pillars on certain tiles without units on them for 1 round within it's effective range (Max range: 4). At Rune Level 2 or higher, the tiles are not created in the same column as the rune.

Engrave: Knocks the target back in the direction they're facing X times. (X = Rank).

Performer Song skill. Beat the drums of war.

Play your instrument, and in 5 range around you; deals Sound magic damage to enemies, and boosting the Scaled Weapon Attack of all allies by X (based on Rank) until your next turn.

Bow/Gun skill. Fire a warning shot at a target in your weapon's attack range, which doesn't deal any damage, but inflicts Fear on the target for (1+Rank) Rounds.

If Dynamic Shooting is at Rank 1 or higher, the frightened target also jumps away 1 tile.

Consumes 20 Void Energy to use. Targets 1 Enemy or 1 Ally (or yourself) in 2+Rank Range. Enemy: Dispels 1 beneficial status effect. Ally: Cures 1 negative status effect.

Targets 1 enemy within 7 Range and focuses on them intently (you can only focus one target at a time with this skill) for 5 rounds, granting a bonus +5 Hit against them. Summons water from the ground into a 1-3 Range horizontal wall at a location within 4 Range for 3 rounds (any enemies in those tiles are knocked back 1 tile). If the sword you are using is a katana-type, the momentum cost is reduced by 1.

When you're trained to use weapons, and then trained to repair those weapons, you get a feel for using it in a way that won't damage it nearly as much. Reduces the durability cost of using weapons, skills, and casting spells by a percentage, based on Rank.

True Martial Artists treat their body as a weapon and armor, having no use for the over-encumbering metal sheets of other fighters. While you have an Unarmored torso with base Armor + base Magic Armor of 4 or less, are not using a shield, and have a sub-weapon that counts as a Fist weapon (or no sub-weapon), all damage you receive is reduced by 10%.

Defensive Knowledge skill. Knowledge is power. The power to defend yourself.

Increases your Phys. Def by (20% of your Scaled WIL)%. (Multiple Defensive Knowledge skills will not stack.)

Gain a blessing from the western winds of fleeting, increasing your Move for the duration. If you are closer to the west edge of the battlefield than the east edge, you gain additional Move. This bonus lasts for 3 rounds.
Allows you to use the simple Offensive spells offered by the Mage base class even while you are Silenced, but increases their FP cost by 50% while under that effect.

Summons a 3-6 Range horizontal line of walls up to 3 Range away, for 3 + Tactics Rank rounds. The walls can be attacked to destroy them (+10 HP if enchanted with Galren). Any enemies in the target location will be pushed away and take Earth magic damage. For each enemy that is weak to Earth, your Tactics Rank increases by 1 level.

If at Tactics Rank A, cooldown is reduced 1 round. If at SSS, it is further reduced by 1 round.

If you're flexible enough, even longer steps pose no challenge.

Increases the maximum Range of most Dance skills by 2.

The enemy you are riding on will trigger special effect tiles, but you will not, and after the ride ends, they will be knocked away 3 tiles and cured of Knocked Down.

This skill requires a Rank D Invocation.

Targets a 2-Size Circle up to 5 Range away and causes water to rush down enemies in that location, dealing Water magic damage, knocking them down, and creating Flooded Water tiles for 3 rounds.

Aquae Crest: If LV 3 or higher, also inflicts Soaked for 3 rounds.
A mastery of calling upon the four winds. Will increase the duration and reduce the cost of Northern Wind, Eastern Wind, Southern Wind, and Western Wind based on Rank.

Spear skill. Airborne compatible. You spin your spear wildly while targeting an enemy within 3 Range. If the target is within 1 Range, the wind from the spinning pushes them back 2 tiles. Otherwise, they are pulled 2 tiles towards you. Afterwards, you generate 5 + Rank Magical Feathers for yourself.

Dance skill. A rapid spinning dance move while staying in place. You will spin in place 3 times, and every time, you deal Wind magic damage (based on your Wind ATK and Rank) to a random enemy within 3 Range.

Arcane skill. Unleashes a windy arrow in a 5 Range line, dealing Wind magic damage and knocking back all enemies hit 1 tile.

Annorum: Becomes a 2-7 Range line that must end in an empty tile. You fly on top of the arrow, becoming Airborne. Enemies hit are knocked back 1 tile and knocked down. In addition, if you have a melee weapon equipped, you attack enemies you pass in 1 range of with it (50% damage).

Creates a sharp blade of wind in a line that cuts through all enemies, dealing Wind magic damage to all enemies hit. The first enemy hit also takes Slash physical damage based on Rank that ignores armor. The size of the line can be resized.

If enchanted with Talvyd, the first enemy hit may be inflicted with Lingering Damage (Slash) with LV equal to the Slash damage, for 3 rounds.

Excel Crash: Level 1 - 10% per charge level. Level 2 - Increases minimum and maximum size by amount of Charges. Level 3 - Ignore Evasion.

When you fight up close and personal all the time, it's important to be able to move quickly, especially if you're on the offensive.

Increases your Evade by your Schwarz Sturm level * 2.

Cobra Stance. Can only be used while Airborne. You dash in a 2-X Range line (based on Rank), flying over all enemies, obstacles, and hazards. (The last tile of the line must be a valid battle tile.)

If this skill is not subject to Repeat Action yet, it costs 1 Momentum to use.

Targets an enemy within 3 Range. For 3 rounds, any properties that grant certain effects against Ice damage are negated. The types negated are based on Rank. In addition, the target takes additional Ice damage equal to 1+Rank for the duration.
Focused, you are a source of positive energy for yourself and allies. When your Ki is 10 or more, you generate an aura that gives all allied units in Range a bonus to STR and WIL.

Creates a ghostly spirit that is tied to you at a target location within 3 Range. When you take damage, it is reduced by 30% and that reduction is subtracted from the Wraith's HP instead. The Wraith can still take damage normally and gets no turn, so try to keep it away from the action.

Throws your weapon as a projectile in a 5 Range Line. If it encounters an enemy, you teleport to unoccupied tile within 1 Range of them and preform a basic attack that does magic damage. Otherwise when it stops, if it is on a valid tile, you teleport to it.

A spell which bubbles black mud from beneath the ground. Targets all enemies within 5 Range and inflicts magic damage split between Earth and Dark. There is a chance that all enemies damaged will also suffer from Poison LV X (6*Rank) for 3 rounds.

Yomidori is the act of predicting your opponent's movements with such precision that it becomes akin to mind-reading. When you are attacked by a person who has already attacked or damaged you this turn, your parry skills have a higher chance to activate, based on Rank.

extras: Melee weapons gain +5/10/15/20/25 Power if the target is a Youkai (or treated as one).
text.description: As a being who must always interact with Youkai, the Grand Summoner is well versed in the ways to discipline them. Melee weapons gain a bonus to Power based on Rank if the target is a Youkai (or treated as one).

text.description: Calm your center, and restore strength. When using a Sheath sword with more than 3 momentum, you recover 15 FP per momentum point exceeding 3 (IE, 4 Momentum would restore 15, 7 Momentum would restore 60.) After activating, this effect have a 3 round cooldown, unless Kensei is BOTH your main class, and sub-class.

A tactic that forces enemies to make moves they don't really want to. Enemies affected by your Forced Move, Flatfoot, or Fear status effects have their Parry skill's reduction effectiveness halved and suffer -5 Evade (versus you only).
